auto_merge.commit_title: feat(mods): run prompt.submit hooks in the OpenTUI terminal (#16195)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(mods): run prompt.submit hooks in the OpenTUI terminal

The OpenTUI live turn now raises prompt.submit for each prompt the person
types, before its row, the input history, @ references and the send. A
rewrite stands in the sent prompt, the row, the input history, the
provenance and turn.start; images stay attached and a paste kept whole stays
collapsed. A drop shows its reason and hands the prompt back to the
composer. While a Mod hooks prompt.submit, queued prompts wait for the turn
to end instead of steering it, so they pass the hooks too.

* fix(mods): keep a returned prompt while a dialog hides the OpenTUI composer

A prompt the prompt.submit hooks drop, or one Esc cancels without a
composer to settle with, went back through the composer handle. A dialog
opened mid-turn (/settings, /theme and other commands that run while a
turn responds) unmounts the composer, so the handle was empty and the
prompt, never shown or recorded, was lost. It now waits on the entry's
composer slot and returns when the composer mounts again.

prs.title: test(integration): compare the ACP parity workspace home to its pre-run listing
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The ACP agent-loop parity suite guards that the session runtime never writes into the test workspace. That guard currently compares the workspace's home directory against a hardcoded pair of file names. This change takes a listing of that directory before the agent starts and compares the post-run listing against it, so the guard states its own invariant instead of repeating another module's fixture contents.

## Why it's needed

The hardcoded pair is a hand-copy of what the shared test harness seeds into the workspace home, and that seeding is new: it arrived with #16196 on 2026-11-03, the same harness change that caused the release failure this guard was added for. An inventory that fresh is still moving, and the parity suite should not have to track it. Nor is a third artifact hypothetical — the CLI already writes an `installation_id` into whatever its home directory points at, which an existing integration case pins. The next time the harness seeds one more file, every scenario in the parity suite goes red at once, with a failure message sitting directly under a comment about keeping runtime state out of the workspace. Whoever makes that harness edit is not editing the parity suite and has no link to the assertion, so the diff reads as a runtime leak that is not there, while the scratch directory that would show the real answer has already been cleaned up.

This was raised on #16254 and the thread was still open when that PR merged. The round that addressed it pushed commit `1923e184` after the merge had already happened, so the improvement never reached main. This carries that change forward onto current main; the leak fix itself, the corrected rationale comment and the `KEEP_OUTPUT` post-mortem guard are all already in main and are untouched here.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Build the bundle the suite spawns, then run the parity file:

```
npm run build && npm run bundle
cd integration-tests && RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts --retry=0
```

All 24 cases pass. Three probes show the guard still catches the original leak, no longer depends on the fixture inventory, and narrows nothing today. Each was run against the focused case `-t 'plain text'`, and the tree was restored afterwards.

1. **The leak is still caught.** Remove the `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` override from the spawned agent's environment. The guard fails, naming both leaked directories:

   ```
   AssertionError: expected [ 'settings.json', 'tmp', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'settings.json', …(1) ]
     [
       "settings.json",
   +   "tmp",
       "trustedFolders.json",
   +   "usage",
     ]
   ```

2. **An unrelated harness edit no longer reds this suite.** Make the shared harness seed a third file into the workspace home (a `writeFileSync(join(qwenHome, 'installation_id'), …)` next to the two it already writes), then compare the two guards under that same edit:

   | Guard under the harness edit | Result |
   | --- | --- |
   | Pre-run listing (this PR) | **passes** — 1 passed, exit 0 |
   | Hardcoded pair (main today) | **fails** — `+ "installation_id"`, exit 1 |

   That pair of runs is the point of the change: the same harness edit is harmless here and fatal on main.

3. **The two guards are equivalent today.** Temporarily assert that the pre-run listing equals the hardcoded pair, alongside the real assertion. It passes, so this change narrows nothing on the current harness — it only stops the parity suite from having to know the harness's file names.

`KEEP_OUTPUT=true` still keeps both the test directory and each run's scratch runtime for post-mortem; the kept workspace home holds only the two seeded files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-harness change, no user-visible output. Every row below was measured at `c937c81e37`; the pre-commit hook ran prettier and eslint on the staged file and the committed diff is byte-identical to the tree these runs used.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build && npm run bundle` | passed |
| `npm run typecheck` (includes `tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json`) | exit 0 |
| `npx prettier --check` on the changed file | exit 0 |
| `npx eslint` on the changed file | exit 0 |
| Full parity file, `RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted QWEN_SANDBOX=false` | **24 passed (24)**, 1 file passed, exit 0, 49.63s |
| Mutation 1 — runtime override removed | **exit 1**, 1 failed \| 23 skipped, received `tmp` and `usage` |
| Mutation 2 — harness seeds a third file, this PR's guard | **exit 0**, 1 passed \| 23 skipped |
| Mutation 2 — same harness edit, main's hardcoded guard | **exit 1**, 1 failed \| 23 skipped, received `installation_id` |
| Mutation 3 — pre-run listing equals the hardcoded pair | **exit 0**, 1 passed \| 23 skipped |
| `KEEP_OUTPUT=true` focused run | exit 0; kept workspace home = `settings.json trustedFolders.json`; scratch runtimes kept for post-mortem |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

Source build on macOS (Apple Silicon, Node 22.23.3, pnpm 11.24.0); `QWEN_SANDBOX=false` and `RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted`, matching the release test step. The suite spawns the worktree's own `dist/cli.js`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guard now states "the agent changed nothing in the workspace home" rather than "the home holds exactly these two names". The two are equivalent on today's harness, measured above. They diverge only if the harness itself pre-seeded a runtime-looking directory before the run: the old literal would red, the new comparison would not. Such a directory is present identically for both compared surfaces before either starts, so it cannot reintroduce the mid-run race this guard exists to catch — and a child writing into it during the run still changes the listing and still fails.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux locally, and the release host itself. The parity file is the only place in the integration suite that reads a listing of the workspace home, so no other suite is affected; nothing outside this one test file changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16254, carrying forward its unmerged round-3 commit `1923e184` and answering the review thread left open there. #16251 is already closed by that merge; no closing keyword here.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

ACP agent 循环对等性套件有一道守卫，确保会话运行时绝不写入测试工作区。它目前把工作区 home 目录与一对硬编码的文件名比较。本改动改为在 agent 启动前先取一次该目录的清单，运行结束后与这份清单比较，于是守卫陈述的是它自己的不变量，而不是复述另一个模块的夹具内容。

## 为什么需要

那对硬编码文件名是共享测试框架写入工作区 home 的内容的手抄副本，而这套种子写入本身是新的：它随 #16196 于 2026-11-03 落地，正是引发本守卫所要防的那次发布失败的同一处框架改动。这么新的清单仍在变动，对等性套件不该被迫跟着它走。第三个产物也不是假想——CLI 本来就会往它的 home 目录写入 `installation_id`，这一点已有集成用例钉住。下次框架再多写入一个文件，对等性套件里的每个场景都会同时变红，而失败信息正好落在一段讲「把运行时状态挡在工作区之外」的注释下面。做那处框架改动的人并没有在改对等性套件，也没有任何线索指向这条断言，因此这个 diff 读起来就像一次并不存在的运行时泄漏；而能揭示真实答案的临时目录此时已被清理掉。

这一点在 #16254 上被提出，该 PR 合并时线程仍未解决。处理它的那一轮在合并已经发生之后才推送了提交 `1923e184`，因此这项改进从未进入 main。本 PR 把该改动带到当前 main 上；泄漏修复本身、已纠正的理由注释以及 `KEEP_OUTPUT` 事后排查保护都已在 main 中，此处一律不动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

先构建套件要 spawn 的 bundle，再运行对等性文件：

```
npm run build && npm run bundle
cd integration-tests && RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts --retry=0
```

24 个用例全部通过。三个探针说明这道守卫仍能抓住原始泄漏、不再依赖夹具清单，且在今天没有收窄任何东西。每个探针都针对聚焦用例 `-t 'plain text'` 运行，跑完即还原代码树。

1. **泄漏仍被抓住。** 从 spawn 出的 agent 环境里移除 `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` 覆盖。守卫失败，并点名两个被泄漏的目录：

   ```
   AssertionError: expected [ 'settings.json', 'tmp', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'settings.json', …(1) ]
     [
       "settings.json",
   +   "tmp",
       "trustedFolders.json",
   +   "usage",
     ]
   ```

2. **无关的框架改动不再让本套件变红。** 让共享框架往工作区 home 多写入第三个文件（在它已写入的两个旁边加一句 `writeFileSync(join(qwenHome, 'installation_id'), …)`），然后在同一处改动下比较两种守卫：

   | 该框架改动下的守卫 | 结果 |
   | --- | --- |
   | 运行前清单（本 PR） | **通过** —— 1 passed，退出码 0 |
   | 硬编码文件名（当前 main） | **失败** —— `+ "installation_id"`，退出码 1 |

   这一对运行正是本改动的意义：同一处框架改动在这里无害，在 main 上却致命。

3. **两种守卫今天等价。** 临时在真实断言之外再加一条断言，要求运行前清单等于那对硬编码文件名。它通过，说明在当前框架下本改动没有收窄任何东西——只是让对等性套件不再需要知道框架的文件名。

`KEEP_OUTPUT=true` 仍会同时保留测试目录与每次运行的临时运行时以供事后排查；被保留的工作区 home 只含两个预置文件。

### 证据（修改前后）

N/A —— 测试框架改动，无用户可见输出。下表每一行都测于 `c937c81e37`；pre-commit 钩子对暂存文件跑了 prettier 与 eslint，提交的 diff 与这些运行所用的代码树逐字一致。

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run build && npm run bundle` | 通过 |
| `npm run typecheck`（含 `tsc -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json`） | 退出码 0 |
| 对改动文件跑 `npx prettier --check` | 退出码 0 |
| 对改动文件跑 `npx eslint` | 退出码 0 |
| 完整对等性文件，`RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted QWEN_SANDBOX=false` | **24 passed (24)**，1 个文件通过，退出码 0，49.63s |
| 变异 1 —— 移除运行时覆盖 | **退出码 1**，1 failed \| 23 skipped，收到 `tmp` 与 `usage` |
| 变异 2 —— 框架多种一个文件，本 PR 守卫 | **退出码 0**，1 passed \| 23 skipped |
| 变异 2 —— 同一框架改动，main 的硬编码守卫 | **退出码 1**，1 failed \| 23 skipped，收到 `installation_id` |
| 变异 3 —— 运行前清单等于硬编码文件名 | **退出码 0**，1 passed \| 23 skipped |
| `KEEP_OUTPUT=true` 聚焦运行 | 退出码 0；保留的工作区 home = `settings.json trustedFolders.json`；临时运行时被保留以供事后排查 |

### 测试平台

|    系统     | 状态 |
| :---------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境

在 macOS（Apple Silicon，Node 22.23.3，pnpm 11.24.0）上从源码构建；`QWEN_SANDBOX=false` 与 `RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT=self-hosted`，与发布测试步骤一致。套件 spawn 的是本 worktree 自己的 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：守卫现在陈述的是「agent 没有改动工作区 home 里的任何东西」，而不是「home 里恰好是这两个名字」。在当前框架下两者等价，已实测。只有当框架自己在运行前就预置了一个形似运行时的目录时两者才会分叉：旧的字面量会变红，新的比较不会。这样的目录在两个被比较的界面启动前就已同样存在，因此不可能重新引入本守卫要防的那种运行中竞争——而子进程若在运行期间往其中写入，仍会改变清单、仍然失败。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：本机未验证 Windows 与 Linux，也未验证发布主机本身。对等性文件是集成套件中唯一读取工作区 home 清单的地方，因此不影响其他套件；除这一个测试文件外没有任何改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

#16254 的跟进，带回其未合并的第 3 轮提交 `1923e184`，并回应该 PR 上仍未解决的评审线程。#16251 已随那次合并关闭，此处不使用关闭关键字。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): repair desktop RPM dependency and teardown checks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Pins the RHEL 10 EPEL bootstrap download to a versioned RPM with its verified SHA256, rather than combining a moving `latest` URL with a fixed checksum. Packaged desktop smoke teardown now treats Linux zombie processes as stopped while retaining termination and failure reporting for running daemons. Adds focused regression coverage for both contracts.

## Why it's needed

[Desktop Checks run 41478346286](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41478346286) failed in two RPM lanes. RHEL 10 stopped at an EPEL checksum mismatch. Fedora 44 reached packaged-runtime readiness, then reported that the daemon survived teardown even after SIGKILL. Linux containers can retain an exited orphan as a zombie when PID 1 does not reap it; a PID-existence probe alone incorrectly reports that process as alive. The failing job did not capture its process state, so this change addresses that mechanism without claiming the original PID was conclusively a zombie.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm the RHEL 10 lane downloads the versioned EPEL RPM, verifies its checksum before installation, and completes dependency installation. A checksum mismatch must still stop the job.
- Confirm the Fedora 44 packaged application reaches readiness and teardown completes when the daemon has exited into zombie state. A genuinely running daemon must still be terminated or reported as a leak.
- Confirm process-liveness behavior on macOS and Windows remains unchanged and does not read Linux process metadata.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the RHEL 10 dependency step logged `computed checksum did NOT match`; Fedora 44 logged readiness followed by `the packaged runtime survived teardown`.

After: the versioned upstream RPM was downloaded and its pinned SHA256 verified locally. Both focused script test files passed: 17 tests total. Formatting checks and `git diff --check` passed. Full RPM packaging has not been rerun.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused script tests and checksum verification |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not run on Windows |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ No Linux host or full RPM packaging rerun; Linux process-state cases covered by focused unit tests |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.4 on macOS, using existing dependencies. No dependency installation, full build, or typecheck was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Linux zombie detection depends on process metadata; unreadable metadata keeps the existing conservative liveness behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the complete Fedora 44 and RHEL 10 desktop packaging lanes, signing, and publishing. The original Fedora process state was not captured.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no product runtime behavior changes.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16152

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

将 RHEL 10 的 EPEL 初始化下载固定为版本化 RPM，并使用已验证的 SHA256，不再将会变化的 `latest` 地址与固定校验值组合使用。桌面打包冒烟检查的清理阶段将 Linux 僵尸进程视为已停止，同时保留对实际运行 daemon 的终止操作和失败报告。为这两个契约添加聚焦回归覆盖。

## 为什么需要

[Desktop Checks 运行 41478346286](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41478346286) 的两个 RPM 分支失败。RHEL 10 因 EPEL 校验值不匹配而停止。Fedora 44 已确认打包运行时就绪，但在 SIGKILL 后仍报告 daemon 未退出。Linux 容器的 PID 1 不回收孤儿进程时，已经退出的进程可能保留为僵尸状态；仅检查 PID 是否存在会错误地认为它仍在运行。失败任务未记录进程状态，因此此改动修复这一机制，但不声称已确证原 PID 是僵尸进程。

## 审阅者验证计划

### 如何验证

- 确认 RHEL 10 分支下载版本化 EPEL RPM，在安装前验证校验值，并完成依赖安装。校验值不匹配时仍必须停止任务。
- 确认 Fedora 44 打包应用能够就绪，且 daemon 已退出成为僵尸进程时清理能够完成。实际仍在运行的 daemon 仍必须被终止或报告为泄漏。
- 确认 macOS 和 Windows 的进程存活判断保持不变，不读取 Linux 进程元数据。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：RHEL 10 依赖步骤记录 `computed checksum did NOT match`；Fedora 44 在就绪后记录 `the packaged runtime survived teardown`。

修改后：已实际下载上游版本化 RPM，并在本地验证固定 SHA256。两个聚焦脚本测试文件全部通过，共 17 个测试。格式检查和 `git diff --check` 通过。尚未重跑完整 RPM 打包。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 聚焦脚本测试及校验值验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在 Windows 上运行 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在 Linux 主机验证或重跑完整 RPM 打包；聚焦单元测试覆盖 Linux 进程状态场景 |

### 环境

macOS 上的 Node.js 22.23.4，复用已有依赖。未安装依赖，未运行完整构建或 typecheck。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Linux 僵尸进程判断依赖进程元数据；元数据不可读取时保留原有保守的存活判断。
- 未验证或范围外：完整 Fedora 44 和 RHEL 10 桌面打包分支、签名和发布。原 Fedora 进程状态未记录。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；不改变产品运行时行为。

## 关联 Issue

修复 #16152。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): run desktop smoke headless on rpm roots without Xvfb
prs.body:
## What this PR does

RHEL 10 removed `xorg-x11-server-Xvfb` from every repository, so the rpm build-root dependency step fails there. This PR moves Xvfb to the Fedora 44 leg only and gives the RHEL 10 smoke a real headless display: a weston compositor (EPEL) running the headless backend, with rootless Xwayland (AppStream) bridging WebKitGTK's X11 path.

## Why it's needed

RHEL 10 dropped Xvfb upstream in favour of Xwayland — verified against current BaseOS, AppStream, CRB, extras and EPEL 10 primary metadata, which contain no `xorg-x11-server-Xvfb` build. After #16154 fixed the EPEL bootstrap, the RHEL 10 rpm lane fails one step later at `No match for argument: xorg-x11-server-Xvfb` ([run 41642580745, job 125940965630](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41642580745/job/125940965630)).

An earlier attempt on this branch ran the smoke under `GDK_BACKEND=dummy`, but GTK3 has no dummy backend — both rpm lanes exited 101 in `Smoke packaged application` ([run 41647493340](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41647493340)). WebKitGTK 4.1 needs a real display server, so the RHEL 10 leg now starts `weston --backend=headless-backend.so` plus rootless `Xwayland` and points `WAYLAND_DISPLAY`/`DISPLAY` at them. Fedora 44 still ships Xvfb and keeps its existing `xvfb-run` path unchanged.

The packaged smoke script also reports captured child output when the runtime exits before readiness; the previous opaque `exited before readiness (code 101)` hid the missing-display error.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm the RHEL 10 rpm lane passes `Install rpm build-root dependencies` (weston + Xwayland instead of Xvfb) and completes `Smoke packaged application` against the headless compositor.
- Confirm the Fedora 44 rpm lane still installs Xvfb and runs its smoke through `xvfb-run`.
- Confirm the non-rpm Linux legs (AppImage/deb on ubuntu-22.04) still install `xvfb` and smoke unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: RHEL 10 rpm lane fails dependency installation with `No match for argument: xorg-x11-server-Xvfb`; with a dummy-backend fallback both rpm lanes exit 101 in the smoke step.

After: RHEL 10 installs weston + Xwayland and smokes against a headless Wayland/X11 display. Focused workflow meta-tests pass locally (10 tests in `scripts/tests/desktop-isolation.test.js`), plus Prettier and `git diff --check`. Each new assertion was checked against the mutation it names, and all of them turn red on the mutation while the unmutated tree stays green.

CI evidence, stated precisely: `desktop-release.yml` is not collected on `pull_request`, so no PR-side CI run covers this workflow. The last manual Desktop Checks dispatch cited for this branch ([run 41652880267](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41652880267), commit `98c881e8`) is **superseded** — it predates the mandatory X11 bridge, and its RHEL 10 job shows `could not connect to wayland server` while the lane still reported success, which is exactly the false-green this change removes. [Run 41683832729](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41683832729) on `9d93a863` exercises the weston + Xwayland smoke wiring but predates the matrix-keyed install arm. A Desktop Checks dispatch on the current head is the outstanding evidence for the install-arm keying; this description will cite it once it runs.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Workflow meta-tests |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A (workflow + smoke script path untouched on Windows) |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Wiring verified locally (meta-test + mutation arms); no CI run on this head yet — `desktop-release.yml` is not collected on `pull_request`, and [run 41652880267](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41652880267) is on the superseded commit `98c881e8` |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.4 on macOS, existing dependencies. No dependency installation, build, or typecheck run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: weston's headless backend proves the daemon starts and serves the Web Shell, but not that a real RHEL 10 desktop session renders it; windowing regressions would need manual testing.
- Not validated / out of scope: rendering inside a real RHEL 10 desktop session.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; CI-only change.

prs.title: feat(serve): allow configuring the Conversations working-directory root
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `--conversations-dir` to `qwen serve` and `qwen daemon start`, with `QWEN_CONVERSATIONS_DIR` for launch environments and user-level `.env` files. Embedded launchers can use `ServeOptions.conversationsDir`. The explicit CLI/API value wins over the environment; omission preserves `~/Documents/Qwen Code/Conversations`.

The selection is fixed at daemon startup. Project environment files, top-level `settings.json` `env` at every scope, reloads, and session requests cannot redirect it. Explicit values must be nonempty, fully qualified absolute paths without NUL; invalid syntax fails before listening without fallback. Directory creation and filesystem acceptance remain lazy for both configured and default roots.

Standalone and Live retain their shared Conversations runtime and deterministic private session children. Current discovery records retain the selected root across `daemon restart`, including when the restarting shell's environment changes; older records continue resolving from environment/default. Automatic update relaunch also receives the pinned selection. Intentional reconfiguration uses stop followed by start with the new value.

This PR requests maintainer review of naming and semantics; automated triage is not approval. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Containers can place working files on persistent volumes independently of OS home. Mounting the default path or changing home remain valid alternatives. `QWEN_HOME` selects global Qwen configuration, while `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` and `advanced.runtimeOutputDir` select runtime storage; neither selects this working root.

Working files and shared root configuration stay under the selected Conversations tree. Transcripts and sidecars remain in runtime-base storage keyed by canonical Conversations cwd. Deletion journals and stable Live discovery retain their home-based locations. Persisting only one storage category does not preserve the others.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start without an override and check health: the unused default root should remain absent. Select a custom root through the environment, then provide a different CLI root: the explicit option should win. Empty, relative, and unexpanded-tilde values should fail before listening.
2. Supply a user-level `.env` root and competing project `.env`/`settings.env` values. Create a standalone session and confirm its actual shell cwd and written file are in the selected private child. Registering that root or child should remain rejected; an unrelated workspace should still register.
3. Restart with the same home, runtime base, and canonical root; list/load the session and read the original file. Separately use `daemon start` and `daemon restart` with a changed ambient root and confirm the recorded selection wins.

Validation passed: **520 focused tests**, **107 CI-wiring metatests**, **8 Linux process E2E cases**, repository build, typecheck, bundle, startup bundle closure checks, and lint. The process suite is selected by the no-AK integration CI gate. **Full `npm run preflight` did not pass.** Clean installation, repository-wide formatting/lint, build, and typecheck completed. The unchanged Browser Use missing-runtime test failed because ambient `NODE_PATH` supplied a global `playwright-core` after the fixture deleted its staged dependency. The same isolated case passed with `NODE_PATH` unset, without changing source or assertions. After diagnosing that failure, the remaining workspace test run was stopped; this preflight invocation did not reach its subsequent script-test and final bundle-closure stages. The 107 CI-wiring tests and the earlier bundle-closure check passed separately.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the unmodified source launcher rejected the new flag; isolated helper checks confirmed that the environment variable was ignored and the existing default remained lazy. No installed global `qwen` was available, and the baseline did not exercise a usable daemon or recovery.

After: the fresh bundle passed all eight process cases: ACP shell cwd/files, same-root history restoration, project-injection rejection, and discovery-backed restart preservation. No real model request was made. Screenshots are N/A: this changes headless deployment configuration, with command/API evidence. See the [separate E2E report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16105#issuecomment-6568615171).

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Focused tests and process E2E |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node.js 24.19.0, bundle, isolated temporary home/config/runtime/work directories, loopback synthetic credentials.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changing the canonical root changes history discovery/storage namespace and shared root configuration. Existing ownership, permissions, identity, direct-child, link/reparse, writer-lease, ordinary-workspace isolation, and recovery checks remain in force, with their existing platform limits.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows runtime behavior, Live voice, pending-deletion-journal recovery, and actual automatic-update relaunch were not exercised end to end. Update handoff has unit coverage; the prior focused verification did not run complete shared-runtime/recovery suites. No browser/per-session selector, global workspace policy, configurable locks, or migration is added.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: default placement is unchanged. No working files, history, shared configuration, or control state migrate automatically. Resolve pending recovery against the original root and stop all its writers before switching; changing roots does not repair recovery failures or guarantee old-history visibility.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15298.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 `qwen serve` 和 `qwen daemon start` 增加 `--conversations-dir`，并支持启动环境和用户级 `.env` 文件中的 `QWEN_CONVERSATIONS_DIR`。嵌入启动方可以使用 `ServeOptions.conversationsDir`。显式 CLI/API 值优先于环境变量；都未配置时保留 `~/Documents/Qwen Code/Conversations`。

目录选择在 daemon 启动时固定。项目环境文件、所有作用域的顶层 `settings.json` `env`、重载及会话请求都不能重定向它。显式值必须是非空、不含 NUL 的完全限定绝对路径；无效语法会在监听前失败，不回退到其他位置。配置路径和默认路径的目录创建及文件系统接受都保持惰性。

Standalone 和 Live 保留共享的 Conversations runtime 及确定性的会话私有子目录。当前发现记录使 `daemon restart` 保留选定根目录，即使发起重启的 shell 环境已经变化；旧记录仍按环境变量/默认值重新解析。自动更新重启同样接收固定的目录选择。有意重新配置时，先 stop，再使用新值 start。

此 PR 请求维护者审阅名称和语义；自动 triage 不代表批准。设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/135847076ff06dce326a3d4e92fc89f3377f1672/docs/design/conversations-working-directory-root.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

容器可以将工作文件放在独立于操作系统 home 的持久卷上。在默认路径挂卷或调整 home 仍然是有效替代方案。`QWEN_HOME` 选择全局 Qwen 配置目录，`QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` 和 `advanced.runtimeOutputDir` 选择运行时存储；它们都不选择此工作根目录。

工作文件和共享根配置保留在选定的 Conversations 目录树下。Transcript 和 sidecar 仍位于按规范 Conversations cwd 定位的 runtime-base 存储中。删除 journal 和稳定 Live 发现状态保留基于 home 的位置。只持久化其中一类存储并不能保存其他类别。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不提供覆盖配置并启动，检查 health：未使用的默认根目录应仍不存在。通过环境变量选择自定义根目录，再提供另一个 CLI 根目录：显式参数应优先。空值、相对路径和未展开的波浪号路径应在监听前失败。
2. 在用户级 `.env` 中配置根目录，并在项目 `.env`/`settings.env` 中提供冲突值。创建 standalone 会话，确认实际 shell cwd 和写入文件位于选定的私有子目录。注册该根目录或子目录仍应被拒绝；无关普通工作区仍应能注册。
3. 使用同一 home、runtime base 和规范根目录重启；列出/加载会话并读取原文件。另外通过 `daemon start` 和 `daemon restart` 验证：即使环境中的根目录改变，记录中的选择仍然优先。

验证已通过：**520 项定向测试**、**107 项 CI 配置元测试**、**8 项 Linux 进程级 E2E 用例**、仓库 build、typecheck、bundle、启动 bundle 依赖闭包检查及 lint。进程测试套件已纳入 no-AK 集成 CI。**完整 `npm run preflight` 未通过。** 已完成干净安装、全仓格式/lint、构建和类型检查。未改动的 Browser Use 缺失运行时测试失败，原因是继承的 `NODE_PATH` 在 fixture 删除临时依赖后仍提供了全局 `playwright-core`。仅对该进程移除 `NODE_PATH` 后，同一单独用例通过，没有修改源码或断言。确认原因后停止了剩余工作区测试；本次 preflight 未到达后续脚本测试及最终 bundle 依赖闭包阶段。107 项 CI 配置测试和此前的 bundle 依赖闭包检查分别通过。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：未修改源码的启动入口拒绝新参数；隔离的 helper 检查确认该环境变量被忽略，原默认路径保持惰性。环境中没有已安装的全局 `qwen`，基线也未验证可用 daemon 或恢复行为。

改动后：新构建的 bundle 通过全部八项进程用例：ACP shell cwd/文件、同根目录历史恢复、项目注入拒绝，以及基于发现记录的重启保留。未发送真实模型请求。截图不适用：本改动调整无界面的部署配置，证据来自命令/API。详见[独立 E2E 报告](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16105#issuecomment-6568615171)。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 定向测试及进程级 E2E |

### 环境（可选）

Linux、Node.js 24.19.0、bundle、隔离的临时 home/config/runtime/工作目录、回环地址上的合成凭据。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：改变规范根目录会改变历史发现/存储命名空间及共享根配置。现有所有权、权限、身份、直接子目录、link/reparse、writer lease、普通工作区隔离及恢复检查继续生效，并保留现有平台限制。
- 未验证或范围外：未对 macOS/Windows 运行时行为、Live voice、未完成的删除 journal 恢复及实际自动更新重启执行端到端验证。更新交接有单元覆盖；此前定向验证未执行完整共享 runtime/恢复测试套件。不增加浏览器/按会话选择、全局 workspace 策略、可配置锁位置或迁移功能。
- 兼容与迁移说明：默认存储位置不变。不自动迁移工作文件、历史、共享配置或控制状态。切换前应在原根目录完成未结束的恢复并停止所有使用它的 writer；改变根目录不能修复恢复失败，也不保证旧历史继续可见。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #15298。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): honor tool result admission when resuming new recordings
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keep withheld tool output out of resumed model history for recordings written by the new implementation. Completed output remains available in the transcript, while recovery requires a durable admission receipt before exposing it to the model. A blocked or cancelled round uses a synthetic closure, and a process interrupted before admission leaves its calls for orphan repair. Allowed results retain their original content and call pairing.

## Why it's needed

A tool can finish and have its output recorded before a UserPromptSubmit hook permits the next model request. Previously, resuming that recording exposed the output even when the live request was blocked or the process died before the hook decided. The admission receipt binds the decision to the exact recorded completions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With a new recording, block the tool-result round after two reads complete. Continue live and resume in a fresh process. Confirm both model histories omit the original file contents and close each tool call once.
2. Kill the process after results reach disk while the hook remains pending. Resume and confirm the results stay absent from the entire model request.
3. Permit the round and resume. Confirm the original outputs remain paired with their correct call IDs. Repeat through headless, ACP and cross-entry recovery.
4. Cancel ACP while the tool-result hook is pending. Confirm live continuation and cold recovery use equivalent synthetic results.
5. Load preserved old recordings. Their prior behavior remains, including disclosure of previously withheld results. This is an explicit compatibility limitation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On main at 9b1fcb87, seven blocked or interrupted cases disclosed withheld output and four normal-delivery controls passed. The same 11-case matrix passes on candidate f1b3cc73. Full request capture confirms one closure per original call ID and no withheld fixture content. A real ACP cancellation test also fails on main and passes on the candidate, with equivalent live continuation and fresh-process recovery.

Eight Cron and background-notification component cases cover blocking, cancellation and preservation of prior decisions. Four recorder cases cover complete result matching and first-decision preservation, including compression checkpoints. Local build, typecheck and changed-file checks pass. The Linux official entry completed core and side lanes, but a duplicate bail argument prevented CLI startup. The complete CLI supplement passed 48,048 tests with 116 skipped. Across the two runs the complete Vitest scope totals 121,017 passed, one original failure and 158 skipped. The supplemental run is marked cancelled following a stale partial-log diagnosis, but its CLI step and artifact upload both completed successfully. Core reported one MemoryManager timing assertion failure. The unchanged baseline and candidate both pass that original file in a separate Ubuntu comparison. A controlled clock experiment reproduces the same failure on both trees, but the original CI clock sequence is unknown. Windows passed 32 integration cases and failed two terminal-startup cases, both also failing on unchanged main. [Current candidate CI](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/41753012912)

Historical results, separate from this candidate: the original candidate passed the 434-case Web Shell smoke run, 375 no-key integration cases and nine Hosted cases. Exact-final Linux workspace totals were 120,084 passed, two failed and 158 skipped. The 25 ms timer interruption remains unexplained despite passing isolated baseline/candidate reruns. The notification-order failure reproduced on both trees with controlled asynchronous completion order. [Original candidate CI](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/41587158851)

Real-model coverage was 42/43 cumulative passes across several 4B configurations. The ACP plan-mode test accepts a timeout and did not establish exit-plan behavior. A 9B single-case comparison produced the correct edit, then exceeded the original 300-second deadline before the final answer. These outcomes remain limitations. [Final single-case diagnostic](https://github.com/LyleLiu666/qwen-code/actions/runs/41746517991)

### Tested on

| OS | Current and historical scope |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Current f1b3cc73: build, typecheck, changed-file checks, 11 recovery scenarios, real ACP cancellation and targeted components pass. Historical production-identical 659331ef workspace, standalone and script runs. 119,965 passed, seven failed, 272 skipped. Two outdated test expectations were corrected in 09283f38. A connection interruption remains unexplained despite later baseline/candidate passes. |
| Windows | Current f1b3cc73: build, 9 core checks, 77 ACP component checks and 32 integration checks pass. Two interactive terminal startup failures also reproduce on unchanged main. Historical targeted build and recovery checks: Both baseline and candidate failed the default-temp Code Mode fixture. With runner temporary storage each passed 2/2, and seven additional candidate core checks passed. A complete Windows workspace run was not performed. |
| Linux | Current f1b3cc73: 34 integration cases pass. The official entry completed core and side lanes with one memory timing failure; CLI supplemental coverage passed all 48,048 executed tests. Historical exact 09283f38 build, typecheck, workspace tests and targeted checks. The full run contains the two failures above. Docker ARM64 exercised four recovery scenarios. |

## Risk & Scope

Protection begins with new admission-aware records. Old-format records do not contain enough evidence to distinguish allowed output from withheld output and can still disclose it after recovery. An admission receipt records permission to include input, independently of whether the provider actually received it. The change crosses core recording, history projection and ACP cancellation behavior, so maintainer review is required.

The patch follows current main's shared prompt and automatic-round structure. Each result retains its first valid decision, so cancellation during post-admission setup does not change admitted results into withheld results or discard an earlier withholding reason. The first Cron and Notification requests retain their existing hook policy. Verification is complete with the exceptions stated above. prs.title: fix(channels): scope the poll cursor file to the workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the polling channels' cursor file (GitHub, GitLab and DWS) under the workspace-scoped channel state directory, `~/.qwen/channels/<workspace-scope>/`, next to the rest of each channel's state, and writes it with private permissions (0700 directory, 0600 file). A channel that finds no scoped cursor reads the previous global file once, so an upgrade keeps its position; the next save lands in the scoped path and the legacy file is left untouched for other workspaces and older versions to read.

## Why it's needed

Every other per-channel state file (pairing allowlists, the event journal, the GitHub inbound tasks, publication audit, pending deliveries and watch state) is scoped by workspace, but the poll cursor was still written directly under `~/.qwen/channels/` keyed by the channel name alone. The daemon runs one channel worker group per workspace and channel names are per-workspace configuration keys, so two workspaces running a channel with the same name shared one cursor and, for GitHub, one set of dispatched-comment dedupe rings: one workspace advancing the window could make the other skip comments it never processed. The file also carried default permissions in a directory whose sibling files are all private.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Configure the same channel name in two workspaces (any polling channel type) and let each poll once. Expected: two cursor files, one under each workspace's scope directory, and neither workspace's cursor value affects the other.
- Upgrade path: with a cursor file at the old location (`~/.qwen/channels/<name>-<hash>-poll-cursor.json`) and no scoped file, start the channel. Expected: the first poll window starts from the old cursor; after the first successful poll the scoped file holds the cursor and the old file is unchanged.
- With both files present the scoped one wins; a corrupt scoped file falls back to the initial cursor, never to the legacy file.
- Unit tests: `cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/PollingChannelBase.test.ts` (18 tests, five new). The GitHub, GitLab and DWS adapter suites pass unchanged against the rebuilt base.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user interface). Local test output:

```
packages/channels/base   src/PollingChannelBase.test.ts   18 passed
packages/channels/github 421 passed
packages/channels/gitlab  63 passed
packages/channels/dws    418 passed
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. The permission assertion is skipped on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the legacy cursor is read as a fallback but never deleted, so a channel that never completes a poll after upgrading keeps reading it, and a downgraded version reads a cursor frozen at upgrade time. Reading without moving follows the pairing store's migration rationale: another workspace upgrading later can grandfather the same baseline, and an older version running concurrently still finds its file.
- Not validated / out of scope: the GitHub adapter's own state files already use the scoped layout and are unchanged; their file-name helper duplicates the cursor's naming scheme and could share one helper in a follow-up.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for operators; the cursor moves to the scoped path on the first save after upgrade.

## Linked Issues

Related: #7017 (workspace scoping of channel state).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把轮询型 channel（GitHub、GitLab、DWS）的游标文件移到按工作区作用域划分的 channel 状态目录 `~/.qwen/channels/<workspace-scope>/` 下，与该 channel 的其余状态文件放在一起，并以私有权限写入（目录 0700、文件 0600）。找不到作用域内游标的 channel 会读取一次旧的全局文件，升级后不丢位置；下一次保存落到作用域路径，旧文件原样保留，供其它工作区和旧版本读取。

## 为什么需要

每个 channel 的其它状态文件（配对允许列表、事件日志、GitHub 的 inbound 任务、发布审计、待投递与 watch 状态）都已按工作区作用域存放，但轮询游标仍然只按 channel 名直接写在 `~/.qwen/channels/` 下。daemon 按工作区各起一组 channel worker，channel 名是各工作区配置里的 key，所以两个工作区各自配置同名 channel 时会共用同一个游标，GitHub 还会共用同一组已派发评论的去重环：一个工作区推进窗口，另一个工作区就可能跳过它从未处理过的评论。该文件还带着默认权限，而同目录下的其它文件都是私有的。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

- 在两个工作区配置同名 channel（任一轮询类型），各轮询一次。预期：两个游标文件，各在自己工作区的作用域目录下，互不影响。
- 升级路径：旧位置（`~/.qwen/channels/<name>-<hash>-poll-cursor.json`）有游标文件而作用域内没有时启动 channel。预期：第一轮窗口从旧游标开始；第一次成功轮询后作用域文件持有游标，旧文件不变。
- 两处都有文件时以作用域文件为准；作用域文件损坏时回退到初始游标，绝不回退到旧文件。
- 单元测试：`cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run src/PollingChannelBase.test.ts`（18 个用例，新增 5 个）。GitHub、GitLab、DWS 适配器套件在重建的 base 上全部通过且无改动。

### 证据（前后对比）

不涉及界面。本地测试输出见上文英文部分。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅；macOS、Windows 交由 CI（权限断言在 Windows 跳过）。

### 环境

仅单元测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：旧游标只作回退读取、不删除。升级后一直没有完成过一次轮询的 channel 会持续读旧文件；降级后的版本读到的是升级时刻冻结的游标。只读不搬迁沿用配对存储的迁移理由：之后升级的其它工作区还能继承同一基线，并行运行的旧版本也仍能找到自己的文件。
- 未验证 / 范围外：GitHub 适配器自己的状态文件早已采用作用域布局，本 PR 不动；它的文件名辅助函数与游标命名重复，可在后续 PR 合并成一个。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：对运维无影响；升级后第一次保存时游标自动落到作用域路径。

## 关联 Issue

相关：#7017（channel 状态的工作区作用域）。

</details>

prs.title: docs(managed-agent): reconcile structure-review ledger with the landed store decomposition
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reconciles the Managed Agent structure-review ledger (both language versions) with the store decomposition that has already landed on main. #16090 split the Agent and Session stores into immutable internal collaborators while retaining transaction facades and compatibility bridges, and #16142 trimmed the delegation boilerplate, but the ledger still listed `ManagedAgentStore` at 7,657 lines and `ManagedSessionStore` at 3,931 and called the physical aggregate split "the remaining work". This refreshes the god-class table to the current figures, marks the P1 store split done with credit and a link to the dedicated decomposition design, and records that `ManagedSessionStore` is decomposed while `QwenHostedHarnessConnector` remains. Documentation only — no code change.

## Why it's needed

The ledger is the committed planning surface for the P1 refactor slices. With the headline god class already decomposed (7,657 → 1,170 lines), stale numbers invite a redundant split — exactly the duplicate-work waste the structure review is meant to prevent. Reconciling it keeps the next slice (`QwenHostedHarnessConnector`) planned off accurate state, and gives the two store rows an honest "was X; now a decomposed facade" marker instead of deleting the tracked debt silently.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Documentation-only. Confirm the refreshed figures match `origin/main` and both languages stay synchronized. The god-class table was rechecked at `8d8217aeee`: `ManagedAgentStore` 1,170 and `ManagedSessionStore` 357 (now facades), `RuntimeBrokerService` 4,270, `WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventory` 3,329, `ToolPublicationDataStore` 2,709, `QwenHostedHarnessConnector` 2,349, `ManagedAgentService` 2,169, `HarnessCoordinator` 1,770; the table is re-sorted descending and the EN/ZH rows are identical as a set. The facade structure is real, not inferred from commit titles: `ManagedAgentStore implements AgentStateStore` and holds nine `private final Agent*` collaborators (admission, commands, lifecycle, execution, message projection, queries, policies, turn execution, event journal), and the cited `ManagedStoreDecompositionTest` / `SessionRowLockOrderTest` plus the [store decomposition design](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-store-decomposition.md) all exist on main. Prettier is clean (two passes, `--check` green), every relative link resolves, the EN doc links to the `.md` decomposition design and the ZH doc to the `.zh-CN.md`, and the only remaining 7,657 / 3,931 mentions are explicitly historical ("was" / "then" / 「原」/「当时」).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation reconciliation, no user-visible change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Prettier 3.6.1; relative-link, bilingual-count and measured-figure checks via script. No build or test is required for a docs-only change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none — documentation only; no code, schema, route or setting change.
- Not validated / out of scope: the module-layout production-line totals (~57.4K persistence etc.) remain the analyzed-revision snapshot; only the god-class table and store-split status were rechecked at `8d8217aeee`. The `QwenHostedHarnessConnector` physical split and the remaining P2 hygiene items are unchanged future work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Continues the structure-review ledger reconciliation of #16109 and #16118, and records the store decomposition that landed in #16090 and #16142 (constructor-injection prerequisite #16061).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 Managed Agent 结构评审账本（双语两版）与已经合入 main 的 store 分解对齐。#16090 把 Agent 与 Session store 拆成不可变内部协作者、保留事务门面与兼容桥，#16142 精简了委托样板，但账本仍把 `ManagedAgentStore` 写成 7,657 行、`ManagedSessionStore` 写成 3,931 行，并称物理聚合拆分是「剩余工作」。本次把上帝类表刷新到当前数字、将 P1 store 拆分标记为已完成并致谢＋链接到专门的分解设计文档，并记录 `ManagedSessionStore` 已分解、`QwenHostedHarnessConnector` 仍待处理。仅文档改动——无代码变化。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

仅文档。确认刷新后的数字与 `origin/main` 一致、双语保持同步。上帝类表已在 `8d8217aeee` 复核：`ManagedAgentStore` 1,170、`ManagedSessionStore` 357（现为门面），`RuntimeBrokerService` 4,270、`WorkspaceCsiApplicationInventory` 3,329、`ToolPublicationDataStore` 2,709、`QwenHostedHarnessConnector` 2,349、`ManagedAgentService` 2,169、`HarnessCoordinator` 1,770；表按降序重排，EN/ZH 行作为集合完全相同。门面结构是真实的、非凭提交标题推断：`ManagedAgentStore implements AgentStateStore` 并持有九个 `private final Agent*` 协作者（准入、命令、生命周期、执行、消息投影、查询、策略、turn 执行、event journal），所引用的 `ManagedStoreDecompositionTest` / `SessionRowLockOrderTest` 与 [store 分解设计](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-02-managed-store-decomposition.zh-CN.md)均在 main 上存在。Prettier 干净（两遍，`--check` 绿），所有相对链接可解析，英文文档链到 `.md` 分解设计、中文链到 `.zh-CN.md`，残留的 7,657 / 3,931 仅为明确的历史语境（"was" / "then" / 「原」/「当时」）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 文档对账，无用户可见变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |

### 环境（可选）

Prettier 3.6.1；相对链接、双语计数与实测数字校验经脚本完成。文档-only 改动无需构建或测试。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：无——仅文档；无代码、schema、路由或设置变化。
- 未验证/范围外：模块布局的生产行数总量（persistence ~57.4K 等）仍是分析基线快照；本次仅在 `8d8217aeee` 复核了上帝类表与 store 拆分状态。`QwenHostedHarnessConnector` 物理拆分与其余 P2 卫生项仍是未改动的未来工作。

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take session commands off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Fifteen Session commands stop acquiring the tenant placement guard, including model and approval changes, context compression, task cancel, action responses, management checks, mutation admission, and rename delivery/completion. Rename admission retains the guard: real MySQL verification found that its locking operation scans can deadlock concurrent first renames of different Sessions, even with an index hint scoped to each Session.

Mutation admission uses a nonlocking replay probe and resolves duplicate receipt inserts through the existing idempotency conflict rules. A stale-snapshot race still returns `409 idempotency_conflict` without writing a losing rename. The regression tests cover this race and concurrent first renames.

The synchronized design documents describe the audit, retained locks and acceptance criteria: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-commands-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-session-commands-tenant-guard.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-commands-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-session-commands-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

These commands otherwise queue unrelated Sessions behind Runtime placement, storage work, migration, maintenance, CSI work and retention on one tenant row. They already order their work on their own Session and, where needed, the storage fence. Retaining rename admission's guard avoids the confirmed MySQL regression while removing contention from the other fifteen commands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the tenant placement guard in another transaction; a model change must still complete.
2. Concurrently admit the first rename of two Sessions in one tenant under distinct keys. Both must succeed at revision one and leave their own pending delivery.
3. Pin a snapshot before another Session commits a rename under the same key. The losing rename must return `idempotency_conflict`, leave its title unchanged and add no delivery.
4. Verify the affected H2 and real-MySQL cases and the required full Java, Checkstyle, SpotBugs and relevant Hosted/fault CI gates. A passing fast tier alone does not establish full acceptance.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new stale-snapshot test failed before reaching the race because its fixture already contained two receipts, and actual concurrent first renames deadlocked on MySQL 8.4.11. After retaining rename admission's guard, the real-MySQL single-pair witness passes. Production Checkstyle passes across thirteen modules; 48 focused H2/model tests passed. The added concurrency test initially attempted another rename while previous work was pending and failed for that fixture error; it now checks a single first-rename pair, and that final JUnit source plus the inherited MySQL cases remain pending CI. Local Java verification has stopped at the module's shared budget; this is partial evidence, not completed acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | Partial: focused H2/model tests, production Checkstyle and a real-MySQL single-pair witness; final JUnit regression pending CI |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Pending CI |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16 and native MySQL 8.4.11 with a disposable task-owned database. The database process has been stopped.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: rename admission still serializes within a tenant. Guard-free commands retain their Session and storage-fence ordering; this change does not eliminate all contention or pre-existing cross-tenant operation-index risks.
- Not validated / out of scope: the final corrected JUnit regression, complete Java/H2/MySQL suites and relevant Hosted/fault gates remain pending CI. Removing the rename admission guard requires a separate solution to the shared empty-gap locks. Session creation and lifecycle locks remain.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no schema, API or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Related to #13800, which tracks the broader tenant-guard program and remains open for creation, lifecycle and rename admission follow-ups. Upstream #16223 has merged; this PR now targets `main`.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

十五个 Session 命令不再获取租户 placement guard，包括修改模型和审批、上下文压缩、任务取消、action 响应、管理检查、mutation 准入以及改名投递和完成。改名准入继续保留 guard：真实 MySQL 验证发现，其操作锁定扫描会让不同 Session 的并发首次改名死锁，即使指定按 Session 划分的索引也无法消除该问题。

mutation 准入使用非锁定重放探测，并按现有幂等冲突规则处理重复回执插入。快照过旧的竞争请求仍返回 `409 idempotency_conflict`，不会写入输掉竞争的改名。回归测试覆盖这种竞争以及并发首次改名。

同步的设计文档记录审计、保留的锁和验收标准：[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-commands-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-session-commands-tenant-guard.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/session-commands-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-session-commands-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

这些命令原本让无关 Session 在同一租户行上排队，等待 Runtime placement、存储工作、迁移、维护、CSI 和 retention。它们本来就在自己的 Session 上排序，需要时也会获取存储 fence。保留改名准入的 guard 避免了已确认的 MySQL 回归，同时移除其他十五个命令的这处竞争。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 另一事务持有租户 placement guard 时，模型修改仍须完成。
2. 同一租户的两个 Session 使用不同键并发准入首次改名。两者均须成功，revision 均为一，并保留各自待处理的投递。
3. 在另一 Session 以同一键提交改名之前固定快照。输掉竞争的改名须返回 `idempotency_conflict`，保持原有标题，且不新增投递。
4. 验证受影响的 H2、真实 MySQL 用例，以及必需的完整 Java、Checkstyle、SpotBugs 和相关 Hosted/fault CI。仅 fast tier 通过不能证明完整验收。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前：新增的旧快照测试因夹具中已有两条回执而在进入竞争前失败；实际并发首次改名在 MySQL 8.4.11 上死锁。保留改名准入的 guard 后，真实 MySQL 的单对并发验证通过。十三个生产模块的 Checkstyle 通过，48 项定向 H2/模型测试通过。新增并发测试最初在上次操作仍待处理时再次改名，因此暴露了夹具错误；现已改为验证单对首次改名，最终 JUnit 源码及继承的 MySQL 用例仍等待 CI。按模块共享预算，本地 Java 验证已停止；这些是部分证据，尚未完成验收。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 部分验证：定向 H2/模型测试、生产 Checkstyle、真实 MySQL 单对并发验证；最终 JUnit 回归等待 CI |
| Windows | 未在本地测试 |
| Linux | 等待 CI |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.16、原生 MySQL 8.4.11，使用任务独占的临时数据库。数据库进程已停止。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：改名准入仍在租户内串行。去掉 guard 的命令保留 Session 和存储 fence 排序；本改动不消除全部竞争，也不解决原有的跨租户操作索引风险。
- 未验证或不在范围内：最终修正的 JUnit 回归、完整 Java/H2/MySQL 套件及相关 Hosted/fault gate 仍等待 CI。去掉改名准入的 guard 需要另行解决共享空范围的间隙锁。Session 创建和生命周期锁继续保留。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：没有 schema、API 或配置变更。

## 关联问题

与 #13800 相关；该问题跟踪更完整的租户 guard 计划，创建、生命周期以及改名准入仍有后续工作，因此继续保持开放。上游 #16223 已合并，本 PR 现以 `main` 为目标。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): Make runtime backends optional Maven modules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Splits Local, SSH, Kubernetes, External and Static Runtime implementations into independent Maven artifacts. Services embedding the ordinary server library explicitly add only the same-version backends they need; all five backend dependencies are optional. The default standalone executable and operator artifacts remain complete, with their existing classifiers and reference packaging.

Selected backends are validated before resources are created. SSH-only assembly no longer initializes Local, and Spring owns shared SSH connection cleanup. Historical operations retain pending state and storage claims while their backend is unavailable, then resume when it returns. Maintenance requests the capability needed by each action while retaining SQL-only branches. Kubernetes workspace paths are validated as remote Pod paths independently of the control-plane operating system. The design and configuration reference are synchronized in English and Chinese.

## Why it's needed

The existing adapter bundle combines unrelated backend implementations, and SSH assembly requires a Local provider. An embedding service cannot choose its backend dependencies independently. This change establishes that boundary while preserving recovery, storage ownership and resource cleanup when available backends change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Acceptance remains pending. Local checks cover scripts, workflow contracts, documentation and static boundaries; the complete release-script test file passes all 56 cases after repairing its source-move fixture. The Java verification budget shared with the earlier Local/External work is closed at 599.048/600 seconds; the current Java module graph and runtime regressions require CI evidence.

### How to verify

1. Reference the ordinary server from another Maven application. Confirm no backend implementation is included transitively. Explicitly add a same-version backend and confirm it becomes available; a disabled Broker should need none. Check isolated classpaths for all five single backends, Local+SSH and full, including a missing-provider failure before resource allocation.
2. Build the normal standalone and operator artifacts. Confirm the fixed `exec` classifier, application configuration and metadata, five backend JARs and service registrations, Lombok exclusion and maintenance launchers remain compatible. The ordinary library should contain no standalone application YAML.
3. Exercise SSH-only and Local-only assembly. Unselected providers must not read credentials, initialize state or create clients/processes. Preserve SSH admission restrictions and already-admitted execution, close, recovery and permitted replay. Failed startup and normal shutdown must release SSH controller ownership. A Kubernetes Pod path such as `/workspace` must be accepted on Linux, macOS and Windows control planes while relative, dot-component and non-normalized paths remain rejected.
4. Persist unresolved Local uploads and SSH registrations, remove their backend and confirm pending state and storage claims remain intact. Restore the original backend and confirm reconciliation resumes with the original identity. Missing Kubernetes must reject physical CSI actions while retaining SQL-only maintenance; missing Local must reject Local-dependent maintenance before persistent side effects. Complete MySQL, Hosted/fault, real SSH/Kubernetes and cross-platform acceptance.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — backend modularization has no UI changes. A separate verification comment records local results, prior CI failures, their corrections and remaining acceptance work.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Script/workflow and static checks; current Java acceptance pending |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Local testing not performed; current CI acceptance pending |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node.js 26.12.1 and npm 11.20.0. Java acceptance requires JDK 21. Based on main `4dce337ea28d6b8718934b40b8a358cd362f1578`, preserving its Store constructor injection and configuration metadata support. Root build/typecheck/bundle and the 110 affected script tests passed again after rebasing onto this main revision; the profile-owned specialist test configuration is preserved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the internal provider SPI, Java package boundaries and assembly lifecycle change. Required runtime and infrastructure acceptance is incomplete; merge readiness depends on current-head CI and remaining real-environment qualification. Selecting backend dependencies does not remove shared database, Harness or messaging dependencies.
- Not validated / out of scope: current Java unit/H2, Checkstyle, SpotBugs, embedding, packaging, MySQL, Hosted/fault, real SSH/Kubernetes and complete platform acceptance remain pending. Selective standalone builds, variant archives/examples and their CI matrix are deferred; the PR contains no backend build selector. JAR hot-loading, Kubernetes scratch and prewarm removal are also out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: rebuild internal SPI providers at the same version and update imports of moved implementation classes. Embedding consumers enabling a backend must explicitly add its optional artifact. Persisted provider kinds, storage identities, SQL schema and wire formats stay unchanged. Drain work before removing its backend, or retain pending operations and storage claims until the original backend is restored.

The complete synchronized design is available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/08d6c1b24b697d0ab245ddcc035962bab1b9aae2/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-runtime-backend-modules.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/08d6c1b24b697d0ab245ddcc035962bab1b9aae2/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-runtime-backend-modules.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to merged PR #15871. No issue is closed by this PR.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

将 Local、SSH、Kubernetes、External 和 Static Runtime 实现拆为独立 Maven 产物。嵌入普通 server library 的服务只显式添加所需的同版本后端，五个后端依赖均为 optional。默认独立可执行包及运维产物保持完整，沿用既有 classifier 和参考打包方式。

选中后端在创建资源前完成校验。SSH-only 装配不再初始化 Local，共享 SSH 连接由 Spring 负责清理。历史操作在所属后端不可用时保留 pending 状态和存储占用，恢复后端后继续。运维按 action 获取所需能力，同时保留纯 SQL 分支。Kubernetes Workspace 路径按远端 Pod 路径校验，不依赖控制平面操作系统。设计及配置参考同步提供中英文版本。

## 为什么需要

现有 adapter 包混合了彼此独立的后端实现，SSH 装配还要求 Local provider，嵌入服务无法独立选择后端依赖。本次建立这一边界，同时保留可用后端变化时的恢复、存储所有权和资源清理行为。

## Reviewer 测试计划

验收仍待完成。本地检查覆盖脚本、工作流契约、文档和静态边界；修复源码迁移后的夹具路径后，发布脚本测试文件的全部 56 个用例通过。与前期 Local/External 工作共享的 Java 验证预算已在 599.048/600 秒关闭；当前 Java 模块图及 runtime 回归需要 CI 证据。

### 如何验证

1. 在另一个 Maven 应用中引用普通 server，确认不传递引入任何后端实现；显式添加同版本后端后确认其可用，Broker 停用时应无需后端。检查五种单后端、Local+SSH 和 full 的隔离 classpath，包括缺包时在资源分配前失败。
2. 构建正常独立应用及运维产物，确认固定 `exec` classifier、应用配置及元数据、五个后端 JAR 和服务注册、Lombok 排除及运维启动器保持兼容。普通 library 不应包含独立应用 YAML。
3. 验证 SSH-only 与 Local-only 装配，未选 provider 不得读取凭据、初始化状态或创建客户端/进程。保留 SSH 准入限制及已接纳任务的执行、关闭、恢复和获准重放。启动失败与正常关闭都必须释放 SSH controller 所有权。Linux、macOS 和 Windows 控制平面都应接受 `/workspace` 这样的 Kubernetes Pod 路径，同时继续拒绝相对路径、点分量及未规范化路径。
4. 持久化未决 Local 上传和 SSH 注册，移除所属后端后确认 pending 状态与存储占用完整保留；恢复原后端后按原身份继续对账。缺少 Kubernetes 时须拒绝物理 CSI 操作，同时保留纯 SQL 运维；缺少 Local 时，相关运维须在持久化副作用前拒绝。完成 MySQL、Hosted/fault、真实 SSH/Kubernetes 和跨平台验收。

### 证据（Before & After）

N/A — 后端模块化没有 UI 改动。独立验证评论记录本地结果、上一版 CI 失败及其修正，以及剩余验收工作。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 脚本/工作流及静态检查；当前 Java 验收待完成 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未在本地测试；当前 CI 验收待完成 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS arm64、Node.js 26.12.1、npm 11.20.0。Java 验收要求 JDK 21。基于 main `4dce337ea28d6b8718934b40b8a358cd362f1578`，保留其中的 Store 构造注入和配置元数据支持。rebase 到此 main 版本后，根目录 build/typecheck/bundle 和 110 项相关脚本测试再次通过；保留专项 profile 负责测试启用的配置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：内部 provider SPI、Java 包边界和装配生命周期变化。必需的 runtime 及基础设施验收尚未完成；是否具备合并条件取决于当前 head 的 CI 和剩余真实环境验收。选择后端依赖不会移除共享的数据库、Harness 或消息依赖。
- 未验证或不在范围内：当前 Java unit/H2、Checkstyle、SpotBugs、embedding、打包、MySQL、Hosted/fault、真实 SSH/Kubernetes 和完整平台验收仍待完成。选择性独立构建、变体归档/示例及对应 CI 矩阵后置，PR 不含后端构建选择器。JAR 热加载、Kubernetes scratch 和取消预热也不在范围内。
- 破坏性变化或迁移说明：内部 SPI provider 须按同版本重新构建，直接导入已移动实现类的代码须更新 import。启用后端的嵌入服务须显式添加对应 optional 产物。持久化 provider kind、存储身份、SQL schema 和协议格式不变。应在移除后端前排空其工作，或保留 pending 操作及存储占用直到原后端恢复。

完整且同步的设计提供[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/08d6c1b24b697d0ab245ddcc035962bab1b9aae2/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-runtime-backend-modules.md)和[中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/08d6c1b24b697d0ab245ddcc035962bab1b9aae2/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-runtime-backend-modules.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联事项

作为已合并 PR #15871 的后续工作。本 PR 不自动关闭任何 issue。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): drop the healthy-default apt gate and prefer the VPC intranet mirror
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Two changes to the apt-mirror probe added in #16218, both aimed at the same root cause — the pool's slow apt source:

1. **Removes the "only override when the default looks slow" gate.** The override now fires when a candidate mirror clears 1 MB/s and beats the sampled default 4x; there is no veto based on the default's own sampled speed.
2. **Adds the VPC intranet mirror `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com` as the first probe candidate.** It answers from inside the Alibaba Cloud VPC and consumes none of the instance's capped public bandwidth, so it sidesteps the egress throttling entirely rather than racing another public mirror across the same capped link.

The probe still measures every endpoint per build and logs its measurements; the empty `APT_MIRROR` default still keeps release and local sandbox builds byte-identical.

## Why it's needed

#16218 merged and turned the mainland docker E2E legs green, but one leg timed out again the next morning ([run 41743539611](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41743539611), host `ecs-qwen-hz4-2`):

```
apt probe: deb.debian.org=372394 B/s best=1972030 B/s (mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn)
apt mirror: deb.debian.org (probe found no faster mirror)   <- gate kept the default
Fetched 9296 kB in 3s (2887 kB/s)                            <- fast start
Fetched 84.5 MB in 31min 18s (45.0 kB/s)                     <- throttled mid-transfer
##[error]The operation was canceled.                         <- 60-minute cap
```

Two distinct problems:

- **The gate trusted a bimodal sample.** The mainland `deb.debian.org` path gave a fast 512 KiB burst (372 kB/s, above the old 250 kB/s threshold) then collapsed to 45 kB/s for the sustained ~200 MB. A short sample of the default cannot predict sustained throughput, so the gate vetoed exactly the override the host needed. The mirror's own measured speed is the reliable signal; the two remaining gates (1 MB/s floor, 4x factor) already protect the Hong Kong and both-slow cases.
- **Public mirrors share the capped egress.** `configure-maven-mirror.sh` documents the root cause for this exact pool: "the pool fetches from one egress with dozens of jobs at a time... the 100 Mbps egress cap that made concurrent dependency fetches drop packets", and prefers `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com` because it "answers from inside the VPC and does not consume the instance's public bandwidth." The apt probe was only racing public mirrors across that same capped link. The intranet mirror is the durable fix; it is unreachable off-VPC, so the probe measures 0 there and a public mirror wins — no host map needed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read `select_apt_mirror`: the candidate list leads with `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com`, and the override fires on the two mirror-side gates only. The contract test pins the intranet candidate's presence, the floor literal, the 4x factor, and the absence of any `slow_default` gate.

A fleet verification run is in progress on [`feat/e2e/apt-mirror-burst-16260`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41760983253): its docker leg lands on a real pool host and the `apt probe:` / `apt mirror:` lines plus the sustained `Fetched …` throughput will show whether the intranet mirror serves the Debian tree and how fast it is in practice. Will report the outcome here.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Behavioral simulation of the real selection function (curl stubbed):

```
VPC host (intranet 50 MB/s, default 15 kB/s, public 12 MB/s) -> mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com
Hong Kong (intranet unreachable, default 2.8 MB/s, public 3 MB/s) -> (no override)
hz4-2 burst (intranet unreachable, default 372 kB/s, public 1.97 MB/s) -> mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn
both slow (default 15 kB/s, public 300 kB/s) -> (no override)
```

Contract suite `scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js`: 164/164 green. Mutation witnesses (each reddens, then restored): `fast_mirror` ÷10, `* 4` → `* 1`, re-introducing a `slow_default` gate. `bash -n` clean, prettier clean. The intranet mirror's Debian tree and sustained speed are being confirmed by the fleet run above (it cannot be reached from outside the VPC).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local: contract suite, shell simulation, mutation checks. Linux marked not-tested pending the fleet run; the hz4-2 numbers come from its real run log.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the intranet candidate is unverified for the Debian tree from outside the VPC. The probe tolerates a dead endpoint (rate 0 → skipped → a public mirror wins), so a wrong path cannot break a build — the fleet run confirms it empirically. A Hong Kong host whose default samples low and mirror >4x higher could switch mirrors; the 4x factor makes that rare and a misjudgment costs one rebuild the next probe can reverse.
- Not validated / out of scope: sustained intranet throughput across every pool host (the probe re-measures each build); the release docker lane's separate cold-apt defect remains a follow-up on #16214.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Empty `APT_MIRROR` default keeps release and local sandbox builds byte-identical; no workflow YAML or host configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16214

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

对 #16218 引入的 apt 镜像探针做两处改动，都针对同一个根因——池内主机的慢 apt 源：

1. **移除"只有默认源看起来慢才覆盖"的闸门。** 现在当候选镜像超过 1 MB/s 且比采样默认快 4 倍时触发覆盖；不再有基于默认源自身采样速度的否决。
2. **把 VPC 内网镜像 `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com` 加为首个探针候选。** 它在阿里云 VPC 内部应答，不占用实例被限速的公网带宽，因此直接绕开出口限速，而不是和另一个公网镜像在同一条被限速的链路上赛跑。

探针仍然每次构建测量所有端点并打印测量值；空的 `APT_MIRROR` 默认值仍让 release 与本地 sandbox 构建逐字节不变。

## 为什么需要

#16218 合入后把大陆 docker E2E leg 转绿了，但第二天早上又有一条 leg 超时（[run 41743539611](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41743539611)，主机 `ecs-qwen-hz4-2`）：

```
apt probe: deb.debian.org=372394 B/s best=1972030 B/s (mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn)
apt mirror: deb.debian.org (probe found no faster mirror)   <- 闸门保留了默认源
Fetched 9296 kB in 3s (2887 kB/s)                            <- 开头快
Fetched 84.5 MB in 31min 18s (45.0 kB/s)                     <- 传输中途被限速
##[error]The operation was canceled.                         <- 60 分钟上限
```

两个不同的问题：

- **闸门信任了双峰采样。** 大陆 `deb.debian.org` 链路给出一个快的 512 KiB 爆发（372 kB/s，高于旧的 250 kB/s 阈值），随后在持续约 200 MB 传输中掉到 45 kB/s。对默认源的短采样预测不了持续吞吐，所以闸门恰好否决了该主机本需要的覆盖。镜像自身测得的速度才是可靠信号；保留的两道闸门（1 MB/s 下限、4 倍因子）已经保护了香港和两边都慢的情况。
- **公网镜像共享被限速的出口。** `configure-maven-mirror.sh` 为这个池子写明了根因："池子几十个 job 同时从一个出口拉取……100 Mbps 出口上限让并发依赖下载丢包"，并优先用 `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com`，因为它"在 VPC 内部应答，不占用实例的公网带宽"。apt 探针之前只是让公网镜像在同一条被限速的链路上赛跑。内网镜像才是治本之策；它在 VPC 外不可达，所以探针在那里测得 0、公网镜像胜出——不需要主机映射。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

读 `select_apt_mirror`：候选列表以 `mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com` 领先，覆盖只由两道镜像侧闸门触发。契约测试钉住内网候选的存在、下限字面量、4 倍因子、以及任何 `slow_default` 闸门的不存在。

真实 fleet 验证正在 [`feat/e2e/apt-mirror-burst-16260`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41760983253) 上跑：它的 docker leg 会落到真实池内主机，`apt probe:` / `apt mirror:` 两行加上持续的 `Fetched …` 吞吐会显示内网镜像是否带 Debian 树、实际有多快。结果会回报到这里。

### 证据（前后对比）

真实选择函数的行为仿真（curl 打桩）：

```
VPC 主机（内网 50 MB/s，默认 15 kB/s，公网 12 MB/s） -> mirrors.cloud.aliyuncs.com
香港（内网不可达，默认 2.8 MB/s，公网 3 MB/s）       -> （不覆盖）
hz4-2 爆发（内网不可达，默认 372 kB/s，公网 1.97 MB/s）-> mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn
两边都慢（默认 15 kB/s，公网 300 kB/s）              -> （不覆盖）
```

契约套件 `scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js`：164/164 绿。变异实证（每个先变红再恢复）：`fast_mirror` ÷10、`* 4` → `* 1`、重新引入 `slow_default` 闸门。`bash -n` 干净，prettier 干净。内网镜像的 Debian 树与持续速度正由上面的 fleet run 确认（VPC 外无法访问它）。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

本地：契约套件、shell 仿真、变异检查。Linux 标记未测试、等待 fleet run；hz4-2 的数字来自它的真实运行日志。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：内网候选在 VPC 外无法验证 Debian 树。探针容忍死端点（速率 0 → 跳过 → 公网镜像胜出），所以错误路径不会弄坏构建——fleet run 会实证确认。某台香港主机若默认采样偏低、镜像高出 4 倍以上可能换源；4 倍因子让这很少见，误判代价只是多重建一次、下次探测可切回。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：每台池内主机的持续内网吞吐（探针每次构建重测）；release docker lane 独立的冷 apt 缺陷仍是 #16214 上的后续事项。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。空的 `APT_MIRROR` 默认值让 release 与本地 sandbox 构建逐字节不变；没有 workflow YAML 或主机配置改动。

Refs #16214

prs.title: test(managed-agent): refresh concurrent membership snapshot
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Refresh the expected Workspace owner snapshot after the second Session acquires membership. Keep the full-row invariance assertions for refused handbacks, and explicitly check the member count at two active Sessions, after one handback, and after the final release: 2 → 1 → 0.

## Why it's needed

The full Hosted CI for #16212 failed because an existing test compared the two-member owner row with a snapshot captured when only one Session was present. The maps differ only in the legitimate count change from 1 to 2. This test defect predates #16212; rerunning the unchanged revision cannot fix it. The correction preserves the lifecycle checks that one Session must not release its neighbor's membership.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the independent-Session Hosted concurrency scenario. Both Sessions should execute work; busy or stale handbacks should return 409 and leave the complete two-member owner row unchanged. A valid handback should preserve the neighbor and leave count 1, and final release should leave count 0. The Runtime Session should remain READY after mount handback and become RELEASED after full release.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: [native Linux/MySQL full CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41671603438/job/126045319252) reports one failure among 167 tests, with zero errors and four skips. The expected owner count is 1 and actual count is 2; every other field matches. The failed test source is identical on that reviewed head and this PR's main baseline.
- After: The corrected failing scenario passes locally with real Broker/CLI processes and H2 on macOS, together with reactor Checkstyle; zero failures or errors.
- Full repaired-case Linux/MySQL and Hosted CI remains pending. A separate verification comment records the exact environment and evidence limitations.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Corrected real-process/H2 scenario and Checkstyle |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Failure reproduced in original native MySQL CI; corrected case pending CI |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: local execution uses H2 and the fixture's non-Linux storage identity; it does not qualify the Linux/MySQL path.
- Not validated / out of scope: full repaired Hosted suite and other platform acceptance. The previously built CLI bundle is reused for the local Java scenario; current main CLI integration remains for CI.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; only test assertions change. The complete owner-row comparisons remain intact.

## Linked Issues

CI follow-up to #16212. Separate from the capability-cache optimization in #16229.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

第二个 Session 获得成员资格后，重新保存预期的 Workspace owner 快照。保留拒绝 handback 后整行不变的断言，并显式检查两个 Session 活跃、一个交还占用、最终全部释放时的成员数：2 → 1 → 0。

## 为什么需要

#16212 的完整 Hosted CI 失败，是因为已有测试将双成员 owner 行与只有一个 Session 时保存的旧快照比较。两张映射仅在合理的成员数变化 1 → 2 上不同。这个测试缺陷早于 #16212，重跑同一版本不会修复它。此次修正继续验证一个 Session 不能释放相邻 Session 的成员资格。

## 审查者测试计划

### 验证方式

执行独立 Session 的 Hosted 并发场景。两个 Session 都应执行工作；busy 或 stale handback 应返回 409，并保持完整双成员 owner 行不变。有效 handback 应保留另一个 Session，计数为 1；最终释放后计数为 0。仅交还挂载时 Runtime Session 仍为 READY，完整释放后才为 RELEASED。

### 修改前后证据

- 修改前：[原生 Linux/MySQL 完整 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41671603438/job/126045319252) 的 167 项测试中有 1 项失败、0 项错误、4 项跳过。预期 owner 计数为 1，实际为 2，其余字段全部一致。失败版本与本 PR main 基线的测试源码完全相同。
- 修改后：修复后的单个失败场景在 macOS 上通过真实 Broker/CLI + H2 验证，整个 reactor Checkstyle 通过；0 失败、0 错误。
- 修正后的 Linux/MySQL 场景和完整 Hosted CI 仍待完成。独立验收评论记录具体环境及证据限制。

### 测试平台

| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 修复场景的真实进程/H2 验证及 Checkstyle |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | 原始原生 MySQL CI 已复现失败；修复版等待 CI |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本地执行使用 H2 和夹具的非 Linux 存储身份，不能代替 Linux/MySQL 验收。

prs.title: test(integration): give the ACP parity rig a scratch runtime directory
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Points the ACP agent-loop parity rig's `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` at the same scratch directory it already uses for `QWEN_HOME`, so neither surface writes session runtime state into the workspace the two surfaces are compared through.

## Why it's needed

Since 35aa4b76, every `TestRig` keeps `QWEN_HOME` and `QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR` at `<testDir>/.qwen-home`. The parity rig overrode only `QWEN_HOME` when spawning the shared and current ACP surfaces, so the runtime stayed at the rig path and wrote `tmp/<hash>` plus token-usage files inside the workspace. The request snapshot each surface embeds lists the workspace folder structure, so one surface saw `.qwen-home/tmp/<hash>` and the other did not:

```
@@ -179,11 +179,13 @@
   └───.qwen-home/
       ├───settings.json
-      └───trustedFolders.json
+      ├───trustedFolders.json
+      └───tmp/
+          └───27f816e5.../
```

`expect(shared.requests).toEqual(current.requests)` then failed whenever that ordering broke, and the retry went green: on 35aa4b76 the first attempt failed three parity cases and the retry passed ([run 41668631944](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41668631944)).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```
npm run build && npm run bundle
cd integration-tests && CI=true QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts
```

All 24 cases pass. To see the mechanism, rerun with `KEEP_OUTPUT=true` and inspect the case's test directory: on `main` the workspace `.qwen-home` also contains `tmp/<hash>`; with this change it holds only the two seeded files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Same parity case (`a model error`), test directory kept via `KEEP_OUTPUT=true`:

- `origin/main`: `.qwen-home/{settings.json, trustedFolders.json, usage/, tmp/81c53fd0.../}`
- this branch: `.qwen-home/{settings.json, trustedFolders.json}`

Full file on this branch: `Tests 24 passed (24)`, 205s.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status | Note |
| :--------: | :----: | :--- |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   | full build + bundle + the parity file above |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   | CI covers it; not run locally |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   | the failure reproduced on the Linux `sandbox:none` shard; fix not run locally there |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the parity rig now keeps runtime state in its scratch home instead of the test directory, so anything that inspected `<testDir>/.qwen-home/tmp` would stop seeing it. The parity file is the only consumer of this rig.
- Not validated / out of scope: the broader shape — every rig still nests the user home inside the workspace, which is what made `extensions install <testDir>` copy the store into itself (#16222 fixes that case). Moving the home out of the workspace is a larger harness change and is not part of this PR.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs the `E2E Tests` parity flake introduced by 35aa4b76.
