prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take turn admission off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Turn submit admission no longer takes the tenant placement guard, and storage migration's prepare step now checks idleness on committed data after it has locked the storage's fence row.

- Turn admission already locks its Session row first (which orders it against lifecycle begin), then takes locking reads of the storage's alias row (which is the migration fence row) and directory row (which orders it against migration fence installation and physical fencing), then inserts the Turn. Nothing later in that transaction takes the guard, so dropping the first acquisition removes a wait edge and adds none.
- Migration prepare locks the fence row inside `migrationSource`, but on MySQL its REPEATABLE READ snapshot could predate that lock because of an earlier nonlocking read. Without the guard, a Turn committed between that snapshot and the lock would be missed. Prepare now runs its idle check on a separate autocommit, read-only connection after the lock, the same pattern `LocalStorageOwners.lockCovered` uses for its inventory.

Other Session commands that take the same guard (rename, model and approval changes, MCP/extension management, cwd change, task cancel, context compression, Session and child insertion, actions), the user message queue's `startNext`, lifecycle operations, Journal writers and publication keep it; they are follow-up work.

Design ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-turn-admission-tenant-guard.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-turn-admission-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)). The #13800 tenant guard design gets a status note ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Every Turn of every Session in a tenant queued on one row behind Runtime placement, storage registration, fencing, migration, maintenance, CSI work and retention. Since #13800 the wait is bounded at five seconds, so a long holder turns submits into `tenant_guard_contended` instead of freezing them, but unrelated Sessions still fail. The guard was there to keep a Turn from being admitted between migration's idle check and its fence. The storage's own fence row can provide that ordering once the idle check reads committed data after locking it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In a REPEATABLE READ transaction whose snapshot is already pinned, commit an accepted Turn from another connection and then run migration prepare. It must refuse with `migration_work_unsettled` and install no fence.
2. While another transaction holds the tenant guards, Turn submit must not fail with `tenant_guard_contended` or wait on the guard.
3. Existing migration, Turn admission, lifecycle, user message queue and CSI session suites must pass, including the MySQL profiles in CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: prepare's idle check reads the transaction snapshot, so the new `WorkspaceMigrationStoreTest` case would pass the idle check and fail later on the bare Session's source check; `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` asserted that Turn submit fails with `tenant_guard_contended` under a held guard. After: not run locally. The machine that made this change has no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL, so the code has not been compiled or tested. `ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` is a MySQL test and the fast CI lane does not run it; acceptance is pending CI, including the full MySQL pipeline.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested (no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL locally) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Turn admission now waits on the storage's alias and directory rows instead of the tenant row, so Turns for one storage still serialize briefly there, and a migration or physical fence of that storage briefly blocks them. Lock order is Session row, alias, directory, as in lifecycle begin; a guard holder that locked an alias before a Session row could deadlock with it (InnoDB rolls one side back as a retryable failure). The audit found no such holder. Migration prepare uses one extra pooled connection for the idle check.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local compilation or tests. The other Session commands and lanes listed above keep the guard.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema, API or configuration changes. A held tenant guard no longer produces `tenant_guard_contended` on Turn submit.

## Linked Issues

Related to #13800. Independent of #16212, #16217 and #16221.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

Turn 提交准入不再获取租户 placement guard；存储迁移的 prepare 步骤在锁定存储的 fence 行之后，改为基于已提交数据检查是否空闲。

- Turn 准入本来就先锁定 Session 行（与生命周期 begin 排序），再以锁定读读取存储的别名行（即迁移 fence 行）和目录行（与迁移 fence 安装、物理 fencing 排序），然后插入 Turn。该事务后续步骤都不再获取 guard，因此去掉开头的获取只会删除一条等待边，不会新增等待边。
- 迁移 prepare 在 `migrationSource` 内锁定 fence 行，但在 MySQL 上，由于更早的一次非锁定读，它的 REPEATABLE READ 快照可能早于加锁时间。去掉 guard 后，在该快照与加锁之间提交的 Turn 会被漏掉。现在 prepare 在加锁之后，在独立的、自动提交的只读连接上执行空闲检查，与 `LocalStorageOwners.lockCovered` 检查其清单的方式相同。

其他使用同一 guard 的 Session 命令（改名、修改模型与审批、MCP/扩展管理、cwd 变更、任务取消、上下文压缩、Session 与子会话插入、actions）、用户消息队列的 `startNext`、生命周期操作、Journal 写者以及发布继续持有 guard，作为后续工作。

设计文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-turn-admission-tenant-guard.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-turn-admission-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)）。#13800 租户 guard 设计增加了状态说明（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/turn-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-10-11-managed-tenant-guard-wedge.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

一个租户内所有 Session 的每个 Turn 都在同一行上排队，排在 Runtime placement、存储注册、fencing、迁移、维护、CSI 工作和 retention 之后。自 #13800 起等待限时五秒，长时间持有者会让提交以 `tenant_guard_contended` 失败而不是卡住，但无关 Session 仍会失败。这把 guard 的作用是防止 Turn 在迁移的空闲检查与 fence 之间被准入。只要空闲检查在锁定存储自己的 fence 行之后读取已提交数据，这个排序就可以由该行提供。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在快照已固定的 REPEATABLE READ 事务内，由另一连接提交一个已接受的 Turn，然后执行迁移 prepare。它必须以 `migration_work_unsettled` 拒绝，并且不安装 fence。
2. 另一事务持有租户 guard 时，Turn 提交不得以 `tenant_guard_contended` 失败，也不得等待该 guard。
3. 现有迁移、Turn 准入、生命周期、用户消息队列和 CSI Session 测试必须通过，包括 CI 中的 MySQL profile。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前：prepare 的空闲检查读取事务快照，因此新增的 `WorkspaceMigrationStoreTest` 用例会通过空闲检查，随后在空 Session 的 source 检查处失败；`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` 断言持有 guard 时 Turn 提交以 `tenant_guard_contended` 失败。改后：未在本地运行。完成本改动的机器没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL，代码尚未编译或测试。`ManagedSessionGuardConvoyIT` 是 MySQL 测试，fast CI 不运行它；验收等待 CI，包括完整的 MySQL 流水线。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 未测试（本地没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL） |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

不适用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Turn 准入现在等待存储的别名行和目录行而不是租户行，因此同一存储的 Turn 仍会在这些行上短暂串行，该存储的迁移或物理 fence 也会短暂阻塞它们。锁顺序为 Session 行、别名行、目录行，与生命周期 begin 一致；若某个 guard 持有者先锁别名行再锁 Session 行，可能与之死锁（InnoDB 会回滚其中一方，表现为可重试的失败）。审计中没有发现这样的持有者。迁移 prepare 会为空闲检查额外使用一个连接池连接。
- 未验证或不在范围内：没有本地编译或测试。上面列出的其他 Session 命令与路径继续持有 guard。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无。没有 schema、API 或配置变化。租户 guard 被持有时，Turn 提交不再返回 `tenant_guard_contended`。

## 关联问题

与 #13800 相关。与 #16212、#16217、#16221 相互独立。

prs.title: test(integration): install the local extension fixture from a subdirectory
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the local-extension E2E fixture into its own subdirectory of the test directory so the install no longer copies the extension store into itself, and drops the stale `${rig.testDir}` install argument that made that copy self-referential.

## Why it's needed

`main` has been red on every E2E shard since 35aa4b76 (project-hook explicit trust). That commit gave every `TestRig` a `QWEN_HOME` at `<testDir>/.qwen-home`, and the local-extension case installed `<testDir>` itself. An install copies its source tree into the store staging directory, so the destination sat under the source and `fs.cp` refused it:

```
Invalid src or dest: cp returned EINVAL (cannot copy <testDir>
  to a subdirectory of self <testDir>/.qwen-home/extension-store/staging/transaction-*)
```

All three shards failed, and the case failed all three retries, so it is deterministic rather than flaky ([run 41668631944](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41668631944)).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the file against a built bundle from this branch and confirm both cases pass:

```
npm run build && npm run bundle
cd integration-tests && QWEN_SANDBOX=false npx vitest run cli/extensions-install.test.ts
```

On `origin/main` (without this change) the first case fails with the `EINVAL` above; with the change it passes. The case still exercises install, list, update and uninstall of a local extension, only from a nested directory instead of the test root.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before (worktree at origin/main 08922b2e, full build+bundle):

```
FAIL cli/extensions-install.test.ts > installs a local extension, verifies a command, and updates it
Error: Process exited with code 1:
Invalid src or dest: cp returned EINVAL (cannot copy .../extension-install-test-21113
  to a subdirectory of self .../extension-install-test-21113/.qwen-home/extension-store/staging/transaction-bQmlT9)
 Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

After:

```
✓ cli/extensions-install.test.ts (2 tests) 7036ms
  ✓ installs a local extension, verifies a command, and updates it  4087ms
  ✓ installs a local Qoder plugin  2949ms
 Tests  2 passed (2)
```

eslint, prettier and `tsc --noEmit -p integration-tests/tsconfig.json` are clean.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status | Note |
| :--------: | :----: | :--- |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   | full build + bundle + the E2E file above |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   | CI covers it; not run locally |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   | CI covers it; the failure reproduced identically on the Linux shards |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22, `QWEN_SANDBOX=false`, CLI from `dist/cli.js` built in a fresh worktree of `origin/main`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the fixture moves one level down; if the case was implicitly relying on the manifest living at the workspace root, it would now cover a nested source only. Install/list/update/uninstall are all still exercised.
- Not validated / out of scope: the same commit also made the ACP parity E2E flaky, because `<testDir>/.qwen-home/tmp/<hash>` now shows up in the workspace folder-structure snapshot and differs between the two surfaces. That needs the test home moved out of the workspace and will follow in its own PR. The product-side edge case (installing an extension from a directory that contains `QWEN_HOME`) is unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Refs the `E2E Tests` failure on 35aa4b76. No tracking issue was filed for it.

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take harness admission checks off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The standalone Harness checks in the Runtime binding repository (ordinary admission, recovery, cleanup and Hook admission, seven methods) no longer take the tenant placement guard. They only read the Session row and the Harness head row (phase, operation, claim generation and lease) and write nothing, so they now run those reads in a snapshot transaction without the guard. No verdict changes. The connection-taking variants used inside placement, session admission and tombstone transactions are unchanged.

Design ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/harness-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-harness-admission-tenant-guard.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/harness-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-harness-admission-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Tool dispatch calls the Harness admission check before every uncancelled dispatch, and the check took the tenant placement guard with no statement timeout. Every tool call of every Session in a tenant therefore queued on one row, behind Runtime placement, storage registration, fencing, migration, maintenance, CSI work and retention. For scopes the check does not cover, it returned immediately, but only after acquiring the guard.

The guard adds nothing to a check that writes no row. A drain or lifecycle claim that commits after the check's snapshot is ordered after the check, an order that was already possible with the guard, since each check committed before its caller acted. The protection after the check is unchanged: dispatch authorization still locks the binding row and requires it ready at the same generation, resident dispatch re-runs the Harness check inside that transaction, and lifecycle authority is fenced by the claim generation and lease.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the tenant placement guard in another transaction. Ordinary admission, Hook admission and recovery for an open Harness Session should complete without waiting.
2. Under the same guard, admission for a draining Harness Session and cleanup without a matching lifecycle claim must still be refused with `runtime_admission_closed`.
3. The existing Harness suites must pass: `SharedHarnessOwnershipTest`, `RuntimeHarnessDrainTest`, `WorkspaceLifecycleStoreTest` and `WorkspaceProfileLifecycleTest`, plus the MySQL and Hosted profiles in CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: every check takes the tenant guard, so the new `SharedHarnessOwnershipTest` case would wait on it and fail with a lock timeout instead of the expected verdicts. After: not run locally. The machine that made this change has no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL, so the code has not been compiled or tested. The fast CI lane does not run the MySQL profiles; acceptance is pending CI, including the full MySQL and Hosted pipelines.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested (no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL locally) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a check can pass on a snapshot taken just before a drain or claim commits. That ordering was already possible with the guard; the post-check protections are unchanged. An engine defaulting to READ COMMITTED evaluates the reads on separate snapshots; production MySQL and MariaDB use REPEATABLE READ.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local compilation or tests. Harness drain, lifecycle claim writes, dispatch authorization, placement, session admission and other guard holders keep the guard.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema, API or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue. Related to #13800 (tenant guard coupling of per-Session traffic), #16205, #16212 and #16217; independent of them.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

Runtime binding 仓库中的独立 Harness 检查（普通准入、recovery、cleanup 与 Hook 准入，共七个方法）不再获取租户 placement guard。它们只读取 Session 行和 Harness head 行（phase、operation、claim generation 与租约），不写任何行，因此现在在快照事务中执行这些读取，不再持有 guard。判定结果没有任何变化。在 placement、Session 准入和 tombstone 事务内部使用的、接收 connection 的版本保持不变。

设计文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/harness-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-harness-admission-tenant-guard.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/harness-admission-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-harness-admission-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

工具派发在每次未取消的派发前都会调用 Harness 准入检查，而该检查以无语句超时的方式获取租户 placement guard。因此，一个租户内所有 Session 的每次工具调用都在同一行上排队，排在 Runtime placement、存储注册、fencing、迁移、维护、CSI 工作和 retention 之后。对于检查不覆盖的 scope，它会立即返回，但前提是已经先拿到了 guard。

对一个不写任何行的检查来说，这把 guard 不提供保护。在检查快照之后提交的 drain 或生命周期 claim 会排在检查之后；由于每次检查都在调用方行动前提交，这种顺序在有 guard 时同样可能发生。检查之后的保护保持不变：派发授权仍会锁定 binding 行并要求其在同一 generation 下就绪，resident 派发在该事务内重新执行 Harness 检查，生命周期 authority 由 claim generation 与租约来 fence。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在另一事务中持有租户 placement guard。打开状态的 Harness Session 的普通准入、Hook 准入和 recovery 应直接完成，无需等待。
2. 在同一 guard 下，正在 drain 的 Harness Session 的准入，以及没有匹配生命周期 claim 的 cleanup，仍必须以 `runtime_admission_closed` 被拒绝。
3. 现有 Harness 测试必须通过：`SharedHarnessOwnershipTest`、`RuntimeHarnessDrainTest`、`WorkspaceLifecycleStoreTest` 与 `WorkspaceProfileLifecycleTest`，以及 CI 中的 MySQL 和 Hosted profile。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前：每次检查都获取租户 guard，因此新增的 `SharedHarnessOwnershipTest` 用例会等待该锁，并以锁超时失败，而不是得到预期的判定结果。改后：未在本地运行。完成本改动的机器没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL，代码尚未编译或测试。fast CI 不运行 MySQL profile；验收等待 CI，包括完整的 MySQL 与 Hosted 流水线。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 未测试（本地没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL） |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

不适用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：检查可能基于某次 drain 或 claim 提交前一刻的快照通过。这种顺序在有 guard 时就可能发生；检查后的保护保持不变。默认 READ COMMITTED 的引擎会让各读取使用不同快照；生产使用的 MySQL 和 MariaDB 为 REPEATABLE READ。
- 未验证或不在范围内：没有本地编译或测试。Harness drain、生命周期 claim 写入、派发授权、placement、Session 准入以及其他 guard 持有者继续持有 guard。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无。没有 schema、API 或配置变化。

## 关联问题

没有关联 issue。与 #13800（Session 流量与租户 guard 的耦合）、#16205、#16212、#16217 相关，但彼此独立。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): probe the apt mirror so mainland E2E hosts can build the sandbox image
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Before building the sandbox image, the docker end-to-end leg now measures how fast the runner can pull from the Debian mirror the image is built against, and points the build at a domestic mirror only when that default path is slow. Three independent gates hold the override back: the host's own measurement of `deb.debian.org` must be below 250 kB/s, the candidate mirror must clear 1 MB/s in absolute terms, and it must beat the default by 4x. The image keeps `deb.debian.org` as its built-in source, so release builds, local sandbox builds, and any host that already has a fast path are untouched.

## Why it's needed

The docker leg builds the sandbox image under a per-push tag, so any host whose image store no longer holds a recent build re-downloads both apt layers (~200 MB) before a single test runs. From the mainland-China hosts that path runs at 11-20 kB/s, which makes the build 2-3 hours against the job's 60-minute cap; from the Hong Kong hosts the same path runs at MB/s. Over the past week, 97 of the 127 docker legs that landed on the mainland hosts were cancelled this way — and because the job is cancelled rather than failed, the run reports `cancelled` and the main-CI failure tracker never sees it.

A single mirror cannot fix this: the Hong Kong hosts are fast on the default and would regress onto a cross-border path. A host-name map is also fragile — these hosts recover to MB/s at off-peak hours, which is why one cold build did complete at 2764 kB/s. Measuring per build is what keeps both regions correct without maintaining an inventory. The absolute 1 MB/s floor additionally prevents a "slow vs slower" override: on a host where both endpoints are slow, the build stays on the default instead of moving onto a mirror it never needed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Watch the docker end-to-end leg's log for two new lines and confirm they match the host the leg landed on:

- `apt probe: deb.debian.org=<n> B/s best=<n> B/s (<mirror>)` — the measurements.
- `apt mirror: <mirror> (probe measured deb.debian.org as slower)` on a mainland host, or `apt mirror: deb.debian.org (probe found no faster mirror)` on a Hong Kong host.

Expected: mainland hosts pick a mirror and their image build drops from hours to minutes; Hong Kong hosts keep the default and their timings do not move. A build that reuses an already-present image logs neither line, because the probe only runs when a build is needed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the 60 minutes are spent in apt, and the leg never reaches the tests:

```
05:04:23  DEPRECATED: The legacy builder is deprecated ...
05:17:59  Fetched 9296 kB in 13min 33s (11.4 kB/s)
05:18:02  Need to get 84.5 MB of archives
06:02:16  Get:46 ... [libasan8 2096 kB]      <- package 46 of 75
06:03:40  ##[error]The operation was canceled.
```

After — the selection logic exercised with the five host shapes that exist in the pool:

```
1) mainland shape (default 15 kB/s, mirror 12 MB/s)    -> mirrors.aliyun.com
2) Hong Kong shape (default 2.8 MB/s, mirror 3.0 MB/s) -> (no override)
3) both slow (15 kB/s vs 300 kB/s)                     -> (no override)
4) Hong Kong transient dip (200 kB/s vs 900 kB/s)      -> (no override)
5) broken default, fast mirror (200 kB/s vs 5 MB/s)    -> mirrors.aliyun.com
```

Verified on a real daemon with the legacy builder (the same builder the mainland hosts fall back to), arm64, running the two apt layers from this Dockerfile extracted verbatim against `node:22-slim`:

```
default (no APT_MIRROR)          index 9296 kB / 35s   84.5 MB / 4m13s   build 480.7s
APT_MIRROR=mirrors.aliyun.com    index 9296 kB / 26s   84.5 MB / 2m30s   build 188.3s
```

Both builds succeeded; the baked sources show the intended state — the default build keeps `URIs: http://deb.debian.org/debian` plus `/debian-security`, and the override rewrites both stanzas (classic `sources.list` and deb822 `debian.sources` layouts) while still installing the full package list. A 2.5x total-time reduction on a host where the default path already runs at 333 kB/s implies a much larger one on the hosts measuring 11-20 kB/s.

The flag path was exercised end to end as well: with the probe's output exported the way the leg does it, the build script emits `docker build --label org.qwen-code.ci.sandbox=true --build-arg APT_MIRROR=mirrors.aliyun.com --build-arg CLI_VERSION_ARG=... -f Dockerfile -t ... .`, so the value reaches the build and the existing CI label is preserved; an empty selection produces no `--build-arg` at all.

The contract suite pins the probe's position (before the build), all three gates including the threshold literals with a word boundary (a plain substring pin would still match a 10x-up mutation), and the log line; both threshold mutations were witnessed reddening the suite before the values were restored.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Local verification was the contract suite (`scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js`, 164 tests), the shell simulations above, and the real-daemon apt-layer builds. Linux is marked not-tested because the pool hosts themselves were not accessed; the first real confirmation there will be the leg's own `apt probe:` / `apt mirror:` log lines.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a short-sample probe can misjudge a host. The worst case is one extra image rebuild on the next push (the mirror changes the layer cache key), after which the probe re-runs and can flip back — never a permanent reroute. The three gates keep healthy hosts on the built-in source, and the measurements are logged so a misjudgment is visible in the run itself.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full image build (the install/build/bundle layers after the two apt layers) was not re-run locally — those layers are byte-identical to before. The actual mainland-host speedup awaits the first pool run. The `cancelled`-vs-`failure` tracker gap and any host-side apt caching are separate follow-ups, not part of this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The empty `APT_MIRROR` default keeps release builds and local sandbox builds byte-for-byte identical; no workflow YAML, runner configuration, or host inventory changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16214

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在构建 sandbox 镜像之前，docker 端到端 leg 现在会测量 runner 从镜像内置 Debian 源拉取的速度，只有当默认路径确实慢时才把构建指向国内镜像。三道独立的闸门挡住覆盖行为：主机自己测得的 `deb.debian.org` 速度必须低于 250 kB/s，候选镜像的绝对速度必须超过 1 MB/s，且必须比默认快 4 倍。镜像内置源仍然是 `deb.debian.org`，因此 release 构建、本地 sandbox 构建、以及任何本来就有快路径的主机都不受影响。

## 为什么需要

docker leg 按每次 push 的 tag 构建 sandbox 镜像，所以任何镜像库里没有近期构建的主机，都会在跑第一个测试之前重新下载两个 apt 层（约 200 MB）。在大陆主机上这条路径只有 11-20 kB/s，构建要 2-3 小时，而 job 上限是 60 分钟；在香港主机上同一条路径是 MB/s 级。过去一周，落在大陆主机上的 127 个 docker leg 有 97 个因此被取消——而且因为 job 是被取消而非失败，run 报告 `cancelled`，main CI 失败追踪器根本看不到它。

单一镜像修不了这个问题：香港主机走默认源本来就快，换成国内源反而会退化到跨境路径。按主机名映射也很脆弱——这些主机在非高峰时段会恢复到 MB/s，这正是有一次冷构建能以 2764 kB/s 完成的原因。每次构建实测，才能让两个区域都正确，且不需要维护任何主机清单。1 MB/s 的绝对下限还额外防止了"慢里挑更慢"的覆盖：在两个端点都慢的主机上，构建留在默认源，而不是搬到一个它根本不需要的镜像上。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

观察 docker 端到端 leg 日志里的两行新输出，确认它们与 leg 落到的主机一致：

- `apt probe: deb.debian.org=<n> B/s best=<n> B/s (<mirror>)` —— 测量值。
- 大陆主机上是 `apt mirror: <mirror> (probe measured deb.debian.org as slower)`，香港主机上是 `apt mirror: deb.debian.org (probe found no faster mirror)`。

预期：大陆主机选中镜像，镜像构建从小时级降到分钟级；香港主机保持默认源，耗时不变。复用已有镜像的构建两行都不打印，因为探测只在需要构建时才运行。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前——60 分钟全花在 apt 上，leg 从未跑到测试：

```
05:04:23  DEPRECATED: The legacy builder is deprecated ...
05:17:59  Fetched 9296 kB in 13min 33s (11.4 kB/s)
05:18:02  Need to get 84.5 MB of archives
06:02:16  Get:46 ... [libasan8 2096 kB]      <- 第 46/75 个包
06:03:40  ##[error]The operation was canceled.
```

之后——用池子里存在的五种主机形态演练选择逻辑：

```
1) 大陆形态（默认 15 kB/s，镜像 12 MB/s）    -> mirrors.aliyun.com
2) 香港形态（默认 2.8 MB/s，镜像 3.0 MB/s）  -> （不覆盖）
3) 两边都慢（15 kB/s 对 300 kB/s）           -> （不覆盖）
4) 香港瞬时抖动（200 kB/s 对 900 kB/s）      -> （不覆盖）
5) 默认坏、镜像快（200 kB/s 对 5 MB/s）      -> mirrors.aliyun.com
```

在真实 daemon 上用 legacy builder（大陆主机回退到的同一个构建器）、arm64 架构验证过：把本 Dockerfile 的两个 apt 层原文提取出来，对着 `node:22-slim` 构建：

```
默认（不传 APT_MIRROR）        索引 9296 kB / 35s   84.5 MB / 4m13s   构建 480.7s
APT_MIRROR=mirrors.aliyun.com  索引 9296 kB / 26s   84.5 MB / 2m30s   构建 188.3s
```

两次构建都成功；烧进镜像的源符合预期——默认构建保留 `URIs: http://deb.debian.org/debian` 和 `/debian-security`，覆盖时两个 stanza 都被改写（经典 `sources.list` 与 deb822 `debian.sources` 两种布局），完整包列表照常安装。在默认路径本来就有 333 kB/s 的机器上总耗时仍缩短 2.5 倍，意味着在实测 11-20 kB/s 的主机上收益会大得多。

参数传递链路也做了端到端验证：按 leg 的方式 export 探测输出后，构建脚本实际发出 `docker build --label org.qwen-code.ci.sandbox=true --build-arg APT_MIRROR=mirrors.aliyun.com --build-arg CLI_VERSION_ARG=... -f Dockerfile -t ... .`，值确实到达构建，且现有 CI label 被保留；选不出镜像时则完全不出现 `--build-arg`。

契约套件钉住了探测的位置（构建之前）、全部三道闸门（包括带单词边界的阈值字面量——纯子串钉法仍会匹配放大 10 倍的变异）、以及日志行；两个阈值变异都先被实测变红，再恢复原值。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

本地验证包括契约套件（`scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js`，164 个测试）、上述 shell 仿真、以及真实 daemon 的 apt 层构建。Linux 标记为未测试，因为没有直接访问池内主机；那里的第一次真实确认将是 leg 自己的 `apt probe:` / `apt mirror:` 日志行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：短样本探测可能误判主机。最坏情况是下一次 push 多重建一次镜像（镜像改变了层缓存键），之后探测重新运行、可以切回来——永远不会永久改道。三道闸门让健康主机留在内置源上，测量值会打进日志，误判在 run 本身就可见。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：完整镜像构建（两个 apt 层之后的 install/build/bundle 层）没有在本地重跑——那些层与之前逐字节一致。大陆主机的实际提速要等第一次池内运行。`cancelled` 与 `failure` 的追踪器缺口、以及任何主机侧 apt 缓存，都是独立的后续事项，不属于本次改动。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。空的 `APT_MIRROR` 默认值让 release 构建和本地 sandbox 构建逐字节不变；没有 workflow YAML、runner 配置或主机清单的改动。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #16214

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take resident claim off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Resident (CSI) Runtime Session acquisition and release no longer take the tenant placement guard. The resident branch of the Workspace execution store's claim and release only reads: it checks that the Runtime Session, its binding, the active slot and the reserved CSI directory row still match the configured resident registration, and that no other unreleased Runtime Session exists in the binding generation. It now runs those reads in a snapshot transaction without the guard. Which requests succeed does not change.

Design ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-resident-claim-tenant-guard.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-resident-claim-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)). The directory membership design's resident non-goal now links to it ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

PR #16205 removed the tenant guard from LOCAL and SSH_LOCAL membership and left the resident branch as a non-goal. Resident acquisition and release therefore still waited for any tenant transaction holding the guard: Runtime placement, CSI reservation and retirement, migration, maintenance and retention.

The guard adds nothing to a check that writes no row. A transition that commits after the check's snapshot is ordered after the check, an order that was already possible with the guard, and the transition observes the same state either way. Protection after acquisition never relied on it: the post-acquisition held check already runs the same reads without a transaction or the guard, and CSI reclamation uses locking reads to require released Runtime Sessions and settled tool executions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Hold the tenant placement guard in another transaction. Resident claim, the held check and release should complete without waiting.
2. Under the same guard, a second Runtime Session's claim in the same binding generation must still be refused.
3. The existing resident suites must pass: `ResidentWorkspacesTest`, `WorkspaceCsiReservationStoreTest`, `ResidentWorkspaceReuseConcurrencyTest`, and the resident retirement and reclamation suites, including their MySQL counterparts in CI.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the resident branch takes the tenant guard, so the new `ResidentWorkspacesTest` case would wait on it and fail with a lock timeout. After: not run locally. The machine that made this change has no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL, so the code has not been compiled or tested. The fast CI lane does not run the MySQL profiles; acceptance is pending CI, including the full MySQL pipeline.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested (no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL locally) |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

N/A

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a resident claim can pass on a snapshot taken just before a transition commits. That ordering was already possible with the guard; the post-acquisition held check and reclamation's locking reads are unchanged. An engine defaulting to READ COMMITTED evaluates the reads on separate snapshots; production MySQL and MariaDB use REPEATABLE READ.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local compilation or tests; CSI reservation, CSI retirement, resident admission and other guard holders keep the guard.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No schema, API or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue. Follow-up to merged PR #16205; independent of #16212.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

Resident（CSI）Runtime Session 的获取和释放不再获取租户 placement guard。Workspace 执行存储中 claim 和 release 的 resident 分支只读不写：检查 Runtime Session、其 binding、活动 slot 以及已预留的 CSI 目录行是否仍与配置的 resident 注册一致，并检查同一 binding generation 中没有其他未释放的 Runtime Session。现在这些读取在快照事务中执行，不再持有 guard。哪些请求能成功保持不变。

设计文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-resident-claim-tenant-guard.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-resident-claim-tenant-guard.zh-CN.md)）。目录成员设计中的 resident 非目标改为指向该文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/resident-claim-off-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

PR #16205 为 LOCAL 和 SSH_LOCAL 成员操作去掉了租户 guard，并把 resident 分支列为非目标。因此 resident 的获取和释放仍要等待当前持有该 guard 的任何租户事务：Runtime placement、CSI 预留与退役、迁移、维护和 retention。

对一个不写任何行的检查来说，这把 guard 不提供任何保护。在检查快照之后提交的转换会排在检查之后；这种顺序在有 guard 时同样可能发生，且两种情况下转换观察到的状态相同。获取之后的保护也从不依赖它：获取后的持有检查本来就在没有事务、没有 guard 的情况下执行相同的读取；CSI 回收通过锁定读要求 Runtime Session 已释放、工具执行已结束。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在另一事务中持有租户 placement guard。resident 的 claim、持有检查和 release 应直接完成，无需等待。
2. 在同一 guard 下，同一 binding generation 中第二个 Runtime Session 的 claim 仍必须被拒绝。
3. 现有 resident 测试必须通过：`ResidentWorkspacesTest`、`WorkspaceCsiReservationStoreTest`、`ResidentWorkspaceReuseConcurrencyTest`，以及 resident 退役和回收相关测试，包括 CI 中对应的 MySQL 测试。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前：resident 分支获取租户 guard，因此新增的 `ResidentWorkspacesTest` 用例会等待该锁并因锁超时失败。改后：未在本地运行。完成本改动的机器没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL，代码尚未编译或测试。fast CI 不运行 MySQL profile；验收等待 CI，包括完整的 MySQL 流水线。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 未测试（本地没有 JDK 21、Maven 和 MySQL） |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

不适用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：resident claim 可能基于某个转换提交前一刻的快照通过。这种顺序在有 guard 时就可能发生；获取后的持有检查和回收的锁定读保持不变。默认 READ COMMITTED 的引擎会让各读取使用不同快照；生产使用的 MySQL 和 MariaDB 为 REPEATABLE READ。
- 未验证或不在范围内：没有本地编译或测试；CSI 预留、CSI 退役、resident 准入以及其他 guard 持有者继续持有 guard。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：无。没有 schema、API 或配置变化。

## 关联问题

没有关联 issue。本次为已合并 PR #16205 的后续改动，与 #16212 相互独立。

</details>

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): narrow EmbeddedRuntimeBroker to SessionQueryStore
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Narrows `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker`'s store dependency from the `AgentStateStore` composite to `SessionQueryStore` — the field and all eight constructor overloads. The broker holds the store only to forward it into `WorkspaceRuntimeResolver` and `ManagedRuntimeCoordinator` (both its `resolver(...)` static and its constructor), and both of those already take `SessionQueryStore`; the broker makes no direct call on the store itself. This is the narrowing the structure-review ledger named as the next candidate after the four deferred consumers (#16121). The ledger is updated in the same change: the broker moves from "candidate" into the single-role audit (query group), raising the tally from 22 to 23, in both languages.

## Why it's needed

Interface segregation: a consumer should depend only on the role it uses. `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` forwards the store exclusively into query-role dependencies, so depending on the full composite overstates its needs and keeps the broker wiring listed among the consumers that still hold the composite. Narrowing it makes the dependency honest and shrinks the set of composite holders, continuing the role-split work (#15962, #16121).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Type-only change — no method body, behavior, SQL or wire-format changes. Confirm the broker's only uses of `store` are `this(...)` delegations and forwarding into the two query-role dependencies, and that the focused build is green:

```
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=<isolated> \
  -Dtest=ModuleArchitectureTest,ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest,RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false test checkstyle:check
```

Local result on head `88277867b0` (JDK 21.0.9, isolated task repository, sibling SDK rebuilt from current source):

```
Tests run: 61, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS   (all modules)
```

The broker-wiring proof is `RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest`: it sets `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled=true`, boots the full real Spring context, asserts the `RuntimeWarmer` bean `isInstanceOf(EmbeddedRuntimeBroker.class)`, and the log shows the narrowed broker actually created and serving (`Embedded Runtime Broker listening at http://127.0.0.1:27769/`). Its 3 tests pass — the broker resolves the same `ManagedAgentStore` bean through `SessionQueryStore` with no `NoUniqueBeanDefinitionException` / `NoSuchBeanDefinitionException`. Note `ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest` (57 tests) runs with `runtime-broker.enabled=false`, so it is a general context/regression check and does **not** exercise broker wiring; it is not cited as such. `ModuleArchitectureTest` (ArchUnit, 1 test) keeps the module boundaries intact. The sole production caller, `RuntimeBrokerConfiguration`, still declares its `@Bean` factory parameter as `AgentStateStore` and passes it — assignable to `SessionQueryStore`, so it compiles untouched and Spring's injection candidate type at that factory method is unchanged; the narrowing is the broker constructor's own declared parameter type. The ledger tally was verified mechanically: both languages parse to 23 names with `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` in the query group, matching its injected type.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal injection type, no user-visible change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21.0.9, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated local repository. Focused unit + ArchUnit + full-context integration + Checkstyle; the full MySQL/Hosted profiles remain CI-owned.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none functional — static injection type only. Spring resolves the same bean through the role interface (the composite extends every role, and `ManagedAgentStore` is the sole implementor); `RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest` (broker enabled) confirms wiring.
- Not validated / out of scope: the caller (`RuntimeBrokerConfiguration`) is unchanged; the physical aggregate split of `ManagedAgentStore` and the `ManagedSessionStore`/connector slices remain separate future work. Full CI suites are CI-owned.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none on the published surface — no HTTP API, route, schema or setting changes (the class is absent from the OpenAPI contract). Precision note: the constructors are `public` and a Java method descriptor includes parameter types, so retyping them is source-compatible but binary-incompatible for anything linked against the old descriptor. There is no practical exposure — every consumer lives in the same Maven reactor and is recompiled together, and no Java reference to `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` exists outside `packages/managed-agent-server/`.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Continues the role-split narrowing of #15962 and #16121.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

把 `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` 的 store 依赖从 `AgentStateStore` 组合接口收窄到 `SessionQueryStore`——字段与全部 8 个构造器重载。broker 持有 store 只是为了转发给 `WorkspaceRuntimeResolver` 与 `ManagedRuntimeCoordinator`（后者的 `resolver(...)` 静态方法与构造器），而这两个都已收 `SessionQueryStore`；broker 自身不直接调用 store 的任何方法。这正是结构评审账本在四个暂缓消费方（#16121）之后点名的下一个收窄候选。账本在同一次改动中双语更新：broker 从「候选」并入单角色审计（query 组），计数 22→23。

## 为什么需要

接口隔离：消费方只应依赖它用到的角色。`EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` 只把 store 转发给 query 角色依赖，依赖完整组合接口夸大了它的需求，也让 broker 接线仍列在持有组合接口的消费方中。收窄它使依赖诚实、缩小复合接口持有者集合，延续角色拆分工作（#15962、#16121）。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

纯类型改动——无方法体、行为、SQL 或线格式变化。确认 broker 对 `store` 的唯一用法是 `this(...)` 委托与转发给两个 query 角色依赖，且聚焦构建绿：

```
cd packages/managed-agent-server
mvn -Dmaven.repo.local=<隔离仓库> \
  -Dtest=ModuleArchitectureTest,ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest,RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest \
  -DfailIfNoTests=false test checkstyle:check
```

head `88277867b0` 上的本地结果（JDK 21.0.9，隔离任务仓库，sibling SDK 已从当前源码重装）：

```
Tests run: 61, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0
[INFO] You have 0 Checkstyle violations.
[INFO] BUILD SUCCESS   （全部模块）
```

broker 装配的证据是 `RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest`：它设 `qwen.managed-agent.runtime-broker.enabled=true`，启动完整真实 Spring context，断言 `RuntimeWarmer` bean `isInstanceOf(EmbeddedRuntimeBroker.class)`，日志显示收窄后的 broker 真实创建并监听（`Embedded Runtime Broker listening at http://127.0.0.1:27769/`）。其 3 个测试通过——broker 通过 `SessionQueryStore` 解析到同一个 `ManagedAgentStore` bean，无 NoUniqueBean/NoSuchBean。注意 `ManagedAgentServerIntegrationTest`（57 个测试）以 `runtime-broker.enabled=false` 运行，只是一般 context/回归检查，**不**触发 broker 装配，故不作为装配证据引用。`ModuleArchitectureTest`（ArchUnit，1 个测试）保持模块边界。唯一生产调用方 `RuntimeBrokerConfiguration` 的 `@Bean` 工厂参数仍声明为 `AgentStateStore` 并传入——可赋值给 `SessionQueryStore`，故无需改动即可编译，该工厂方法处 Spring 的注入候选类型不变；收窄的是 broker 构造器自身声明的参数类型。账本计数经机械校验：双语各解析出 23 个名字、`EmbeddedRuntimeBroker` 在 query 组，与其注入类型一致。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A —— 内部注入类型，无用户可见变化。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

JDK 21.0.9、Maven 3.9.11，任务隔离本地仓库。聚焦单测 + ArchUnit + 全 context 集成 + Checkstyle；完整 MySQL/Hosted profile 仍归 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：无功能风险——仅静态注入类型。Spring 通过角色接口解析到同一 bean（组合接口继承每个角色，且 `ManagedAgentStore` 是唯一实现者）；`RuntimeBrokerConfigurationIntegrationTest`（开启 broker）证实装配。
- 未验证/范围外：调用方（`RuntimeBrokerConfiguration`）未改；`ManagedAgentStore` 的物理聚合拆分与 `ManagedSessionStore`/connector 切片仍是独立的未来工作。完整 CI 套件归 CI。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：已发布表面无变更——无 HTTP API、路由、schema 或设置变化（该类不在 OpenAPI 契约中）。精确说明：构造器为 `public`，Java 方法描述符包含参数类型，故重定其类型源码兼容、但对已链接旧描述符的代码二进制不兼容。无实际暴露面——全部消费方都在同一 Maven reactor 内一并重新编译，且 `packages/managed-agent-server/` 之外没有任何 Java 引用 `EmbeddedRuntimeBroker`。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-10-31-managed-agent-structure-review.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

延续 #15962 与 #16121 的角色拆分数窄。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): allow concurrent workspace uploads
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Workspace uploads now share directory membership with ordinary execution and other uploads. Admission and terminal settlement update the operation ledger and shared count atomically; retries and restart reconciliation retain the original target and release each upload's membership once. Rewind, directory recovery, migration and physical collection retain their occupancy protections. Uploads still reject occupied destinations without overwriting them.

Upload admission and settlement also no longer take the tenant placement guard. Admission locks the alias, directory and new operation rows in the directory-membership lock order, and its count update requires the `mount_revision` behind the scope revision, so a fence, restore or re-registration after the scope read rejects the receipt. Concurrent first receipts for one upload ID are decided by the unique operation key; the loser rereads and replays the committed receipt. Settlement locks the directory row before its operation row.

Designs: shared uploads ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-shared-workspace-uploads.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-shared-workspace-uploads.zh-CN.md)); upload behavior ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-10-26-managed-workspace-upload.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-10-26-managed-workspace-upload.zh-CN.md)); directory membership ([English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/workspace-concurrent-uploads/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

An upload previously required an empty directory membership set and held the directory exclusively until its file process settled. A running command could therefore block an unrelated upload, and one upload blocked other uploads even when they targeted different files. Shared membership removes that restriction while retaining exclusion for operations that replace or delete directory contents. Upload receipts also serialized on the tenant guard, so uploads to unrelated directories, and uploads alongside Runtime placement in the same tenant, waited for each other; PR #16205 already removed that guard from Runtime membership.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start two uploads to different paths in the same LOCAL or SSH_LOCAL directory. Both should be admitted without waiting for the other upload to finish.
2. Start an upload while ordinary execution holds directory membership, and repeat in the opposite order. Both should coexist; settling either participant must leave the other counted.
3. Attempt rewind, maintenance or physical fencing while an upload remains pending. These should be refused. After the upload settles, the exclusive operation should succeed and prevent new uploads while active.
4. Retry an upload ID, restart reconciliation, and query terminal status repeatedly. Pending uploads must keep their original target, changed requests must conflict, and repeated completion must not decrement another participant's count.
5. Hold the tenant placement guard in another transaction and upload. Admission and settlement should complete without waiting.
6. Send concurrent first receipts with one upload ID. The file is written once, one operation remains, and membership is released once.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the baseline gated-process regression confirmed that a second upload received `workspace_busy`. After (commit `d95936b40e`, shared membership only): two independent gated Node processes enter concurrently, with two shared members; physical fencing is refused until they finish. The selected suite passed 15 cases on H2 and 15 on native MySQL 8.4.11, including Runtime/upload admission in both orders, independent release, restart/idempotency, rewind and maintenance protections. Reactor Checkstyle and documentation checks passed. This is Java/process-harness evidence, not a production CLI or public HTTP E2E run. Full CI acceptance is pending.

Commit `07d0a6c742` (tenant guard removal) has not been compiled or tested locally: the machine used for it has no JDK 21, Maven or MySQL. The results above predate it. It adds two cases to `WorkspaceFileUploadStoreTest`, which `WorkspaceFileUploadMySqlIT` also runs on MySQL; acceptance of this commit is pending CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 15 H2 cases, 15 native MySQL cases, Checkstyle and documentation checks on `d95936b40e`; ⚠️ `07d0a6c742` not run locally, pending CI |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16, Node 22.14.0 and disposable MySQL 8.4.11 with strict mode, binary logging disabled and a 128 MiB packet limit. The database was shut down and removed. Rebase onto current main preserved the verified Java source, tests, schema and sibling SDK inputs.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: ordinary participants may edit the same directory concurrently; there is no cross-session file merge guarantee. Upload publication keeps its existing no-clobber behavior. Unconfirmed uploads retain shared membership and continue blocking destructive directory operations.
- Not validated / out of scope: production CLI file writes, public HTTP/model/SSH end-to-end execution, full recovery/migration/collection scenarios, Linux/Windows, and full Java/SpotBugs/MySQL/Hosted/fault CI. CSI uploads remain unsupported. Receipts for one directory still serialize briefly on its alias and directory rows. Session worktree removal is now ordered against uploads only by its maintenance hold (zero members, unfinished uploads re-checked while held) rather than the tenant guard.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no API changes or new columns. The pre-release baseline comment now describes the combined membership count; follow the existing development-catalog recreation policy. No V2 migration is added.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue. Follow-up to merged PR #16205.

prs.title: fix(vscode): keep the embedded-bundle guard failure a readable assertion
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The embedded-webview bundle guard now reports a readable assertion when it fires. Instead of asking the test framework to diff the entire ~32 MB bundle string against a forbidden marker, the guard checks for the marker's presence and asserts a boolean, with a failure message naming the marker. The pass/fail contract is unchanged: the same two markers still fail the test exactly when they appear in the bundle.

## Why it's needed

This closes the last open finding on #10695 (`ic:5503336042`, the deferred review items from #10672). The reviewer's probe verified that when the guard fires on the large bundle, vitest tries to build a diff over the ~32 MB string and dies with `RangeError: Invalid array length` instead of a readable AssertionError. The run still exits 1 on every lane (verified even with the non-Linux unhandled-error exemption), so no signal is swallowed — but the developer reading the failure gets a crash instead of "the bundle embeds forbidden marker X". A boolean presence check keeps the failure a plain, named AssertionError.

The companion small-bundle guard in the same file keeps the substring assertion: its output is a few KB, where a diff is both cheap and useful context. Only the large-bundle exposure is changed.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the guard file in the companion package (requires the workspace dist outputs, i.e. a prior `npm run build`):

```
cd packages/vscode-ide-companion && npx vitest run src/utils/imageSupport.bundle.test.ts
```

Expected: 2 tests passing. To see the failure mode, temporarily add `banner: { js: '/* @qwen-code/qwen-code-core */' }` to the embedded-app build options in the test: before this change the run dies with `RangeError: Invalid array length` while diffing the bundle; after it, the run fails with a named AssertionError (`embedded webview bundle embeds @qwen-code/qwen-code-core: expected true to be false`). Exit code is 1 in both cases. Remove the banner afterwards.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change; the observable surface is the test reporter on a guard failure. Witness runs on the same tree, only the assertion mechanism differs (banner mutation forces the guard to fire).

Before (original substring assertions, banner forces the guard):

```
 ❯ src/utils/imageSupport.bundle.test.ts (2 tests) 8410ms
   ✓ ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the webview bundle 161ms
     ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the embedded webview bundle
⎯⎯⎯⎯ Unhandled Error ⎯⎯⎯⎯
RangeError: Invalid array length
 ❯ Uint8Array.toJSON node:buffer:1158:15
 ❯ writeChannelMessage node:internal/child_process/serialization:164:20
 ❯ process.target._send node:internal/child_process:851:17
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (2)
     Errors  1 error
close timed out after 10000ms
```

Exit 1 — and the failing test never renders an assertion at all: the worker dies serializing the multi-megabyte failure payload, then the Vite server close hangs.

After (boolean presence checks, same banner):

```
 × ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the embedded webview bundle 1117ms
   → embedded webview bundle embeds @qwen-code/qwen-code-core: expected true to be false
AssertionError: embedded webview bundle embeds @qwen-code/qwen-code-core: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
- Expected
+ Received
- false
+ true
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

Exit 1, clean rendered failure, no hang. A banner carrying the second marker fails with its own message: `embedded webview bundle embeds tokenLimits.js: expected true to be false`.

Baseline (no banner):

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

`npx eslint` and `npx prettier --check` on the changed file: exit 0. Package `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS verified locally (node v22.23.4, vitest 3.2.7); Windows/Linux lanes run the same file in CI. The changed mechanism has no platform-conditional code.

### Environment (optional)

`npx vitest run` in `packages/vscode-ide-companion`, esbuild bundle of the embedded webview app (~32 MB).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none for the guard contract — the same markers fail under the same condition; only the failure-reporting mechanism changes. A failing guard now names the marker instead of attempting a multi-megabyte diff.
- Not validated / out of scope: the full monorepo suite was not run; the change is confined to one test file's assertion mechanism. The small-bundle guard keeps its existing substring assertions deliberately. UI verification: N/A — inspected consumer path: this file is a vitest guard exercised by CI and local package tests; its only output surface is the test reporter, not any product CLI/TUI/Web UI/Web Shell.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #10695 — the last open item (F2). The maxWorkers finding (F1) was resolved by #15940 (released in v0.26.5) and the web-shell timeout finding was resolved earlier; both are recorded in the issue's status comments.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

内嵌 webview 的 bundle 守卫触发时现在会报一条可读的断言。不再让测试框架对整个约 32 MB 的 bundle 字符串做 diff，而是检查禁用的标记是否出现、断言一个布尔值，失败信息里点名是哪个标记。通过/失败的契约不变：同样两个标记，出现在 bundle 里就同样让测试失败。

## 为什么需要

## 复核方式

### 如何验证

### 证据（Before & After）

非 UI 改动；可观察面是守卫失败时的测试报告器。见证运行在同一棵树上，只有断言机制不同（banner 变异强制守卫触发）。

改动前（原始子串断言，banner 强制触发守卫）：

```
 ❯ src/utils/imageSupport.bundle.test.ts (2 tests) 8410ms
   ✓ ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the webview bundle 161ms
     ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the embedded webview bundle
⎯⎯⎯⎯ Unhandled Error ⎯⎯⎯
RangeError: Invalid array length
 ❯ Uint8Array.toJSON node:buffer:1158:15
 ❯ writeChannelMessage node:internal/child_process/serialization:164:20
 ❯ process.target._send node:internal/child_process:851:17
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 passed (2)
     Errors  1 error
close timed out after 10000ms
```

退出码 1——而且失败的测试根本没有渲染出断言：worker 在序列化数 MB 的失败载荷时死去，随后 Vite server 关闭挂起。

改动后（布尔存在性检查，同一个 banner）：

```
 × ... does not leave qwen-code-core runtime imports in the embedded webview bundle 1117ms
   → embedded webview bundle embeds @qwen-code/qwen-code-core: expected true to be false
AssertionError: embedded webview bundle embeds @qwen-code/qwen-code-core: expected true to be false // Object.is equality
- Expected
+ Received
- false
+ true
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed (2)
```

退出码 1，失败渲染干净，无挂起。带第二个标记的 banner 失败于它自己的消息：`embedded webview bundle embeds tokenLimits.js: expected true to be false`。

基线（无 banner）：

```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  2 passed (2)
```

改动文件的 `npx eslint` 与 `npx prettier --check`：exit 0。包级 `tsc --noEmit`：exit 0。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS 本地验证（node v22.23.4，vitest 3.2.7）；Windows/Linux lane 在 CI 跑同一个文件。改动的机制没有平台条件代码。

### 环境（可选）

在 `packages/vscode-ide-companion` 里 `npx vitest run`，esbuild 打包内嵌 webview 应用（约 32 MB）。

## 范围与风险

- 主要风险或取舍：守卫契约无风险——同样标记、同样条件失败，只改失败报告机制。失败的守卫现在点名标记，不再尝试数 MB 的 diff。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): keep workspace execution off the tenant lock
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Ordinary Workspace execution no longer takes the tenant-wide placement guard on tool admission, release, or file rewind. Occupancy of a directory is recorded on that directory's storage row as a member count and an exclusive-rewind key, and admission is a pre-check followed by one short conditional update of that row. The same transaction keeps the count aligned when a member is released, when a lost worker is cleaned up, and when a stopped Session is released. Maintenance, uploads, registration, fencing, and restore read the count instead of scanning member rows. Recovery preparation, maintenance release, and shared-binding execution admission now lock the directory row before the binding or work row, so dropping the tenant guard does not open a lock cycle.

Design: [English](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/workspace-membership-without-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/workspace-membership-without-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

Every tool call on every directory of a tenant queued on one placement-guard row, so a long holder stalled turns it had nothing to do with. The member scan also took gap locks on a non-unique index, which makes unrelated tenants wait on the same record when the clustered index changes shape. The directory row is the only row every writer of that directory must touch, and holding it for the length of the update is enough.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Recreate a development catalog from the shared baseline. Expect the storage owner row to carry a member count and an exclusive-rewind key, with checks that the count is nonnegative and that an exclusive key implies at least one member.
2. Admit, rewind, and release execution on a LOCAL directory while another transaction holds that tenant's placement guard. All three should finish, and the member count should return to zero after release.
3. Two Sessions on one directory can both hold ordinary membership. Rewind is refused while the neighbor is present and succeeds once the neighbor has released. Maintenance and upload admission are refused while the count is above zero.
4. A binding that is draining or lost cannot gain a new member. Releasing one Session does not clear another Session's membership on the same directory.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI behavior. The review follow-up passed 7 dedicated real MySQL 8.4.11 concurrency cases, 22 affected storage-guard regressions and 3 shared recovery-fixture regressions. These cover a held tenant guard, independent directories in one/two tenants with live pre-commit lock snapshots, operator preparation lock order and deadlock observation, fencing/maintenance/rewind contenders, positive controls, and summary equality with live membership rows. The initial fence contender reproduced a stale REPEATABLE READ count that allowed fencing after a member committed; mutation/authority checks now use current locking count reads, and the same test passes. Final committed reactor Checkstyle passed. Earlier focused evidence is reused where its inputs remain applicable. Full Java/SpotBugs, complete MySQL and Hosted/fault acceptance remains pending CI on the accepted revision.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ focused H2/unit tests, 7 dedicated MySQL concurrency cases, 2 earlier MySQL cases and Checkstyle |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.16, H2 2.4.240 and disposable native MySQL 8.4.11. The database was shut down and its temporary data directory removed after validation.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the member count can drift from the member rows if a writer updates membership without the count. A decrement that the count cannot cover rolls the transaction back. The holder column is intentionally not forbidden while members exist, because release and held-checks use a planted holder as a refusal signal; production writers still require a zero count before they set a holder.
- Not validated / out of scope: full Java/SpotBugs, complete MySQL profile, Hosted/fault process runs, CSI reservation and retirement, and the tenant guard held by placement, publication, migration, and lifecycle. The focused MySQL snapshots establish no member-scan range locks or unrelated-directory waits in the selected scenarios; writes still acquire record locks and other session indexes can retain gap/supremum locks. H2 tests take an exclusive lock on the binding row because H2 has no share-lock syntax; MySQL and MariaDB take a shared lock.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the shared pre-release baseline changes in place. Recreate development catalogs. There is no V2 migration.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

普通 Workspace 执行在工具准入、释放和文件 rewind 时不再获取租户级 placement guard。目录的占用记在该目录自己的存储行上，包括成员数和独占 rewind 的键。准入先做预检查，再对该行做一次短的条件更新。释放成员、清理丢失的 worker、释放已停止的 Session 时，在同一个事务里维护这个计数。维护、上传、注册、fence 和 restore 改为读取计数，不再扫描成员行。运维恢复的准备、维护释放，以及共享 binding 的执行准入，改为先锁目录行再锁 binding 或 work 行，避免去掉租户 guard 之后形成死锁。

设计文档：[英文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/workspace-membership-without-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/doudouOUC/qwen-code/blob/fix/workspace-membership-without-tenant-lock/docs/design/2026-11-03-managed-workspace-membership-cas.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

一个租户的每个目录、每次工具调用都排在同一行 placement guard 上，持有时间长的事务会拖住与它无关的轮次。成员扫描还会在非唯一索引上加间隙锁，聚簇索引的形状一变，不同租户就会等在同一条记录上。目录行是这个目录每个写入者都必须碰到的那一行，只在更新语句期间持有它就够了。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 用共享基线重建开发库。存储所有者行应带有成员数和独占 rewind 键，并有检查：计数非负，存在独占键时至少有一个成员。
2. 另一个事务持有该租户的 placement guard 时，对一个 LOCAL 目录做准入、rewind 和释放。三者都应完成，释放后成员数回到零。
3. 同一目录上的两个 Session 可以同时持有普通成员身份。邻居还在时 rewind 被拒绝，邻居释放后 rewind 成功。计数大于零时，维护和上传准入被拒绝。
4. 正在 drain 或已经丢失的 binding 不能再加入新成员。释放一个 Session 不会清掉同一目录上另一个 Session 的成员身份。

### 证据（改前与改后）

界面行为不适用。评审跟进已通过 7 项专门的真实 MySQL 8.4.11 并发用例、22 项受影响的存储 guard 回归，以及 3 项共享恢复 fixture 回归。覆盖持有租户 guard、同/跨租户不同目录的提交前活动锁快照、运维准备锁序和死锁观测、fence/维护/rewind 竞争、正向对照，以及汇总字段与真实成员行的一致性。首次 fence 竞争复现了旧 REPEATABLE READ 计数导致成员提交后仍允许 fence 的缺陷；修改和权限检查现使用当前锁定读，同一用例已通过。最终提交的 reactor Checkstyle 通过。输入仍然适用的早期验证证据继续复用；完整 Java/SpotBugs、MySQL 和 Hosted/fault 验收仍待接受版本的 CI。

### 测试环境

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :------: | :--: |
| macOS | 已通过聚焦 H2/单元测试、7 项专门 MySQL 并发用例、此前 2 项 MySQL 用例和 Checkstyle |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.16、H2 2.4.240，以及可丢弃的原生 MySQL 8.4.11。验证完成后已关闭数据库并删除临时数据目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：如果有写路径改了成员身份却没改计数，成员数会和成员行偏离。计数不够减时事务回滚。有成员时并不禁止 holder 列，因为释放和持有检查把人为写入的 holder 当作拒绝信号；生产写路径在设置 holder 之前仍然要求计数为零。
- 未验证或不在范围内：完整 Java/SpotBugs、完整 MySQL profile、Hosted/fault 进程运行、CSI 预留与退役，以及 placement、publication、迁移和 lifecycle 仍然持有的租户 guard。针对性 MySQL 快照证明所选场景没有成员扫描范围锁和无关目录等待；写入仍获取记录锁，其他 session 索引仍可能持有间隙/supremum 锁。H2 没有共享锁语法，测试对 binding 行加的是排他锁；MySQL 和 MariaDB 加的是共享锁。
- 破坏性变更与迁移说明：共享的发布前基线被原地修改。请重建开发库。没有 V2 迁移。

## 关联问题

无。

prs.title: fix(serve): address remote-access review findings R1-6/R1-7/R1-9/R1-11
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to #15887. That PR was merged with 17 review threads still unresolved; only the single labeled-Critical (R1-1) had been addressed. Several findings labeled "Suggestion" were in fact real functional/security defects. This PR fixes the four I verified as real bugs, each with a red→green regression test, and records an explicit per-finding triage of the rest below (no en-masse dismissal).

- **R1-6** (security): the remote-access route catch-all echoed the raw internal `error.message` (e.g. an absolute server path from a cert `ENOENT`) to any caller with `canManage`, and logged nothing. It now logs the stack to daemon stderr and returns a generic message; `RemoteAccessError` keeps its intentional 409 code/message.
- **R1-7** (UI): a successful status poll never cleared a prior error, so the `role="alert"` banner stayed on screen indefinitely. `accept()` now clears the error on a successful refresh.
- **R1-9** (data loss): the polling effect was keyed on daemon availability and reset the entire draft on every transient blip, wiping typed origins/port and the revealed token mid-edit. The identity-scoped reset is now split from polling, so an availability blip preserves the operator draft.
- **R1-11** (UI): the interface `Select` guard `!== 1` admitted zero interfaces and rendered an empty dropdown. It now renders only for `> 1` (zero interfaces shows the existing `noNetwork` copy).

## Why it's needed

These are real defects (path disclosure, persistent error banner, draft wipe, empty select) that shipped in #15887 because the closeout treated the bot's "Suggestion" severity label as "non-blocking" without triaging substance. This corrects that.

## Per-finding triage (all 17 threads from #15887)

| Finding | Disposition |
| --- | --- |
| R1-1 (Critical, permission-blocked prompt preserved forever) | Fixed in #15887 (`942cc902`), merged. Code resolved; bot thread left open (not resolved by author per repo rule). |
| R1-6 / R1-7 / R1-9 / R1-11 | **Fixed here**, red→green regression tests. |
| R1-2 / R1-3 (promptSettled teardown robustness) | Deferred: needs lifecycle analysis of the finally-path guard; not a confirmed live defect. Follow-up. |
| R1-4 (preserve branch lacks stderr breadcrumb) | Deferred: observability nicety, no functional impact. |
| R1-5 (post-activation listener error discarded) | Deferred: needs verification of the post-activation error path before changing teardown. |
| R1-8 (mixed-content Retry button no-op) | Deferred: needs reproduction of the mixed-content submit path. |
| R1-10 / R1-13 (copy mismatches: non-loopback / redaction) | Deferred: copy clarifications, no functional defect. |
| R1-12 (10s deadline abort surfaced verbatim) | Deferred: UX of the abort message; related to error handling, needs a small design decision. |
| R1-14 (cross-origin remediation only in settings card) | Deferred: needs a decision on where externally-configured products surface remediation. |
| R1-15 / R1-16 (docs contradictions) | Deferred: documentation corrections, tracked separately from code. |
| R1-17 (15 guards untested) | Partially addressed: 4 new regression tests here pin the fixed behaviors; remaining guards follow up. |

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Each fix has a regression test that fails without the fix and passes with it:
- `RemoteAccessSettingsCard.test.tsx`: R1-7 (error cleared on successful refresh), R1-11 (no Select for 0 interfaces, Select for >1), R1-9 (origins draft survives an availability blip).
- `remote-access.test.ts`: R1-6 (unexpected failure returns a generic message, no internal path in the response body).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Local: `RemoteAccessSettingsCard` 6/6 pass, `remote-access` route 4/4 pass. Removing each fix turns its test red (verified). eslint exit 0, prettier clean. CI to confirm on this head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🐧 Linux | CI |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: R1-9 splits one effect into two (identity reset vs polling); the epoch counter still fences stale responses, and the existing suite plus the new blip test cover it. R1-6 changes the 500 response body to a generic message (clients must not rely on the raw internal error text).
- Not validated / out of scope: the deferred findings in the triage table (R1-2/3/4/5/8/10/12/13/14/15/16/17) are tracked as follow-up, not changed here. Windows path not exercised locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The 500 error string becomes generic; the 409 `RemoteAccessError` contract is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15887 (review threads R1-6/R1-7/R1-9/R1-11). No auto-close keyword.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

本 PR 是 #15887 的补救。#15887 合入时仍有 17 个评审线程未解决，当时只处理了唯一标为 Critical 的 R1-1；若干被标为「Suggestion」的发现其实是真实的功能/安全缺陷。本 PR 修复其中我已核实为真实 bug 的四条，每条都带红→绿回归测试，并在上方对其余发现逐条给出明确分诊（不再一笔勾销）。

- **R1-6**（安全）：remote-access 路由的 catch-all 把原始内部 `error.message`（例如证书 ENOENT 暴露的服务器绝对路径）回显给任何有 canManage 的调用方，且不记日志。现改为把堆栈记到 daemon stderr，并对客户端返回通用消息；`RemoteAccessError` 仍保留其有意的 409 code/message。
- **R1-7**（UI）：成功轮询从不清除此前的错误，导致 `role="alert"` 横幅永久停留。`accept()` 现在成功刷新时清除错误。
- **R1-9**（数据丢失）：轮询 effect 以可用性为依赖，每次瞬时抖动都重置整个草稿，抹掉运维已输入的 origins/port 和已揭示的 token。现将「身份级重置」与「轮询」拆成两个 effect，可用性抖动不再抹掉草稿。
- **R1-11**（UI）：接口 `Select` 守卫 `!== 1` 会放行 0 个接口、渲染空下拉。现仅在 `> 1` 时渲染（0 接口显示既有 noNetwork 文案）。

验证：每个修复都有回归测试，去掉修复即红、加上即绿。本地 RemoteAccessSettingsCard 6/6、remote-access 路由 4/4 通过；eslint exit 0、prettier 干净。其余发现的分诊与延期理由见上表。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): avoid composer focus after touch navigation
prs.body:
## What this PR does Restore focus to the chat pane on touch devices after switching to an existing session, leaving a panel or cockpit, and folding split view. Preserve composer focus for desktop navigation and explicit typing actions such as starting a new session. Check the current focus owner before restoring focus so a delayed session load cannot take focus from a newly opened panel or dialog. ## Why it's needed Navigation currently focuses the composer even when a phone user only wants to read a conversation. The issue reports that Android then opens the soft keyboard and covers the transcript. The composer already guards its own automatic focus on touch devices, but the application-level navigation paths bypass that protection. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. On a touch device or with touch emulation, select an existing session from the sidebar, return from Settings, and open Plugins followed by browser Back. Focus should land on the chat pane without activating the composer. 2. Where available, leave the cockpit or shrink an open split view. Chat should regain a non-editable focus target unless another surface or an approval owns focus. 3. Start switching sessions, open Settings before the transcript finishes loading, then let loading finish. Settings should retain focus on its Back button. Also check opening another surface before a queued focus callback runs. 4. Start a new session, then tap the input and type. Composer focus and normal editing should work. Repeat navigation with a desktop pointer; it should still restore composer focus. 5. Trigger an approval while a panel is open. The approval should own focus until it resolves, after which touch devices should return to the chat pane. ### Evidence (Before & After) | Behavior | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | | Touch session switch / panel return | Composer receives focus | Chat pane receives focus; zero composer focus events in browser checks | | Desktop navigation / explicit new-session action | Composer receives focus | Composer focus is preserved | | Open Settings while a session is loading | Settings retains focus when hidden composer focus has no effect | Settings retains focus; delayed callbacks respect the current focus owner | Validation passed: full build and bundle, root typecheck, ESLint, and Prettier. All 1,368 App tests and 24 additional matched tests passed, including eight focused touch-navigation regressions. Two review rounds completed: the first identified a delayed-load focus race, which was fixed and covered before the second clean round. The following screenshots show actual UI states after browser actions against the built frontend, with **simulated daemon responses**. They were visually inspected. Focus assertions supply the behavioral evidence; screenshots do not establish physical soft-keyboard behavior or real session persistence/Git operations. Images live only on a separate asset branch in the fork and use immutable commit URLs. **Touch: return after switching sessions / 触屏：切换会话后返回聊天** **Touch: Settings keeps focus when session loading finishes / 触屏：会话加载结束后 Settings 保留焦点** **Desktop: composer focus after Settings return / 桌面：从 Settings 返回后输入框保留焦点** ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :---: | :---: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ build, typecheck, unit tests, browser E2E | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested | ### Environment (optional) macOS, Node.js 22.14.0, Playwright Chromium 149.0.7827.55. Built frontend served through `node dist/cli.js serve`; the browser fixture provides deterministic daemon responses. Touch profile: 390×844, touch enabled, `(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` true. Desktop profile: 1280×900, touch disabled. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: navigation now uses a focusable chat container on touch devices; panels, dialogs, full-page views, fullscreen surfaces, and approvals keep their focus ownership. - Not validated / out of scope: physical Android/iOS keyboard and screen-reader behavior, real session persistence/Git operations. Split folding, cockpit return, and approval resolution were verified with unit regressions rather than browser E2E. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the change stays within Web Shell focus restoration. ## Linked Issues Fixes #15996
中文说明 ### 本 PR 做了什么 触屏设备在切换到已有会话、退出面板或 cockpit、折叠分栏后，将焦点恢复到聊天区域。桌面导航和新建会话等明确准备输入的操作仍聚焦输入框。恢复焦点前检查当前焦点归属，避免延迟完成的会话加载从新打开的面板或对话框抢走焦点。 ### 为什么需要 当前导航会自动聚焦输入框，即使手机用户只是想阅读会话。Issue 报告 Android 会因此弹出软键盘并遮挡聊天记录。输入组件内部已有触屏自动聚焦保护，但应用层的导航路径绕过了这层保护。 ### Reviewer Test Plan：如何验证 1. 使用触屏设备或触屏模拟，从侧边栏选择已有会话、从 Settings 返回，以及打开 Plugins 后通过浏览器后退返回。焦点应落在聊天区域，输入框不应获得焦点。 2. 在支持相应布局时，退出 cockpit 或缩小已打开的分栏。若没有其他界面或审批占用焦点，聊天区域应获得一个不可编辑的焦点目标。 3. 开始切换会话，在聊天记录加载完成前打开 Settings，再让加载结束。焦点应保留在 Settings 的返回按钮上。同时检查：已排队的聚焦回调执行前打开其他界面，也不应被抢走焦点。 4. 新建会话，再点击输入框并输入文字。自动聚焦和正常编辑应可用。使用桌面指针重复导航，仍应恢复输入框焦点。 5. 在面板打开时触发审批。审批结束前应保留焦点控制权，结束后触屏设备应回到聊天区域。 ### 证据（修复前后） | 行为 | 修复前 | 修复后 | | --- | --- | --- | | 触屏切换会话 / 从面板返回 | 输入框获得焦点 | 聊天区域获得焦点；浏览器检查中的输入框焦点事件数为零 | | 桌面导航 / 明确新建会话 | 输入框获得焦点 | 保留输入框聚焦 | | 会话加载期间打开 Settings | 隐藏的输入框聚焦无效，Settings 保留焦点 | Settings 保留焦点；延迟回调遵守当前焦点归属 | 验证通过：完整构建与打包、根目录类型检查、ESLint 和 Prettier。1368 项 App 测试及另外 24 项匹配的相关测试通过，其中包含 8 项触屏导航聚焦回归测试。两轮 review 已完成：第一轮发现延迟加载抢焦点的问题，修复并补充回归覆盖后，第二轮未发现新问题。 上方截图分别展示实际浏览器操作后的触屏会话返回、加载完成后仍保留焦点的 Settings，以及桌面 Settings 返回后的输入框。截图来自构建后的前端，使用**模拟 daemon 响应**，均已目视检查。行为证据来自焦点断言；截图不能证明真机软键盘、真实会话持久化或 Git 后端行为。图片仅存放在用户 fork 的独立素材分支，链接固定到素材 commit。 ### 测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :---: | :---: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、类型检查、单元测试、浏览器 E2E | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 | ### 环境 macOS、Node.js 22.14.0、Playwright Chromium 149.0.7827.55。构建后的前端通过 `node dist/cli.js serve` 提供，浏览器测试夹具提供确定性的 daemon 响应。触屏配置为 390×844、启用 touch、`(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` 匹配；桌面配置为 1280×900、关闭 touch。 ### 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：触屏导航改为聚焦可接收焦点的聊天容器；面板、对话框、整页视图、全屏界面和审批保留各自的焦点控制权。 - 未验证 / 范围外：Android/iOS 真机键盘和读屏软件、真实会话持久化与 Git 后端操作。分栏折叠、cockpit 返回和审批结束通过单元回归测试验证，未做浏览器 E2E。 - 兼容性 / 迁移：无破坏性变化；改动限于 Web Shell 焦点恢复。 ### 关联 Issue 修复 #15996。
