prs.title: fix(core): require explicit trust for settings-file project hooks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Settings-file project hooks (a repository's `.qwen/settings.json`) now follow the Claude Code trust model. In interactive sessions they load only with explicit folder trust: the user enables `security.folderTrust.enabled` and trusts the directory, or grants workspace trust through the IDE; a disabled folder-trust feature no longer silently authorizes them, and when they are withheld the TUI shows a startup warning naming the remedy. In non-interactive sessions (`--prompt`/`-p`, piped stdin, ACP/SDK embeddings) trust is implicit — the caller chose the directory and there is no prompt surface — so project hooks load as before and platform embedders need no migration. The hooks documentation states both halves of this contract.

## Why it's needed

An external security report (matching #14746) showed that on v0.25.3, with a fresh home directory and the trust feature off by default, a repository's `SessionStart` hook executed at startup with no prompt — a repository someone opens could run a command of its choosing. The project-hooks getter still consulted the legacy trust check, which returns "trusted" whenever the trust feature is disabled. #16182 already closed the same gap for skill/agent frontmatter hooks and LSP servers; this change closes it for settings-file hooks with the same predicate, scoped to interactive sessions.

The interactive/non-interactive split follows Claude Code's documented behavior (verified against its latest release): interactive startups gate every hook behind workspace trust, while `-p`/non-TTY runs treat trust as implicit with a documented "only use directories you trust" caveat. This keeps headless platforms embedding the CLI working without trust-file migration, and the startup warning removes the silent failure mode. The reporter has a 90-day disclosure window; the richer per-project approval dialog stays in #14748 as a follow-up.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

In a fresh home directory (no `trustedFolders.json`, trust feature off), open a repository whose `.qwen/settings.json` declares a `SessionStart` hook that writes a marker file. Interactive before: the marker appears with no prompt. Interactive after: no marker, and the session shows a warning that project hooks were not loaded because the folder is not explicitly trusted. Enable `security.folderTrust.enabled` and trust the directory (or grant IDE workspace trust), restart, and the hook runs again. Running the same repository headlessly (`-p 'say hi'`) writes the marker even in the fresh home — non-interactive trust is implicit by design. User-level and system-level hooks are unaffected in every case; `--safe-mode` and `--bare` still load no hooks in either mode.

### Evidence (Before & After)

See the verification comment on this PR for tmux before/after captures at the current head: interactive untrusted (withheld + warning), interactive trusted (runs), and headless fresh home (runs, implicit trust). Unit evidence pins the interactive trust states, the headless implicit-trust states, and safe/bare withholding in both modes; integration suites pass with unmodified fixtures.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run build && npm run bundle`; `vitest run` for core config/hookRegistry (1050 passed), cli hooks suites (153 passed), and 13 tool-hook/subagent integration tests against the bundle; tmux 120×34 real-terminal A/B against the merge base.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: interactive users who relied on project hooks without ever enabling folder trust must now trust the folder once (or grant IDE trust); the startup warning names the remedy. Headless runs keep repo-hook execution by design — the documented contract is to only run non-interactive sessions in directories you trust, matching Claude Code.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux local runs (CI covers them); the approval dialog and hash-pinned approvals remain in #14748; an always-on trust dialog (full Claude model) is a separate product decision.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: interactive sessions no longer load project hooks in untrusted or undecided folders. Migration: enable `security.folderTrust.enabled` and trust the folder. Non-interactive/embedded usage is unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14746
Related: #14748 (approval dialog follow-up), #16182 (frontmatter/LSP explicit trust)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

项目设置文件（仓库的 `.qwen/settings.json`）中的 hooks 现在遵循 Claude Code 的信任模型。交互式会话中只在显式目录授信后加载：用户启用 `security.folderTrust.enabled` 并信任目录，或通过 IDE 授予工作区信任；信任功能默认关闭时不再默默放行，且扣留时 TUI 显示启动警告并指明补救方式。非交互会话（`--prompt`/`-p`、管道 stdin、ACP/SDK 嵌入）信任隐式成立——调用方自己选择了目录且没有弹窗表面——项目 hooks 照常加载，平台嵌入方无需迁移。hooks 文档写明了契约的两半。

## 为什么需要

外部安全报告（与 #14746 相同）表明：v0.25.3 在全新 home、信任功能默认关闭时，仓库的 `SessionStart` hook 会在启动时无提示执行——打开一个仓库就可能执行其任意命令。项目 hooks 的读取口仍走旧的信任判断，而该判断在功能关闭时返回"受信任"。#16182 已用相同的显式授信谓词堵住了 skill/agent frontmatter hooks 和 LSP 的同类缺口；本 PR 用同一谓词堵住设置文件 hooks，作用域限定为交互式会话。

交互/非交互的划分遵循 Claude Code 的文档化行为（已对照其最新发行版核实）：交互式启动把所有 hooks 挡在工作区信任之后，而 `-p`/非 TTY 运行信任隐式成立，并文档化"只在你信任的目录里使用"的告诫。这让 headless 平台嵌入无需信任文件迁移，启动警告消除了静默失败。报告者有 90 天披露窗口；更完整的逐项目审批对话框留在 #14748 作为后续。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在全新 home（无 `trustedFolders.json`、信任功能关闭）打开一个 `.qwen/settings.json` 声明了写标记文件的 `SessionStart` hook 的仓库。交互式修复前：无提示出现标记文件。交互式修复后：无标记，且会话显示"目录未显式信任，项目 hooks 未加载"的警告。启用 `security.folderTrust.enabled` 并信任目录（或 IDE 授信）后重启，hook 恢复执行。同一仓库以 headless（`-p 'say hi'`）运行时即使全新 home 也会写标记——非交互信任按设计隐式成立。用户级与系统级 hooks 不受影响；`--safe-mode` 与 `--bare` 在两种模式下都仍不加载任何 hooks。

### 证据（前后对比）

见本 PR 的验证评论：当前 head 的 tmux 前后捕获——交互式未授信（扣留 + 警告）、交互式授信（执行）、headless 全新 home（执行，隐式信任）。单测固定交互式信任状态、headless 隐式信任状态、以及两种模式下 safe/bare 的拦截；集成套件在夹具未修改的情况下通过。

### 测试平台

macOS ✅ 本地验证；Windows/Linux ⚠️ 未本地验证（由 CI 覆盖）。

### 环境

本地 `npm run build && npm run bundle`；core config/hookRegistry 单测 1050 通过，cli hooks 套件 153 通过，13 个 tool-hook/subagent 集成测试基于 bundle 通过；tmux 120×34 真终端与 merge base 做 A/B。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：从未启用目录信任却依赖项目 hooks 的交互式用户需要信任一次目录（或 IDE 授信）；启动警告指明补救方式。headless 运行按设计保留仓库 hook 执行——文档化契约是"只在你信任的目录里跑非交互会话"，与 Claude Code 一致。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows/Linux 本地运行（CI 覆盖）；审批对话框与哈希绑定审批留在 #14748；always-on 信任弹窗（完整 Claude 模型）是独立的产品决策。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：交互式会话不再加载未信任或未决定目录中的项目 hooks。迁移方式：启用 `security.folderTrust.enabled` 并信任目录。非交互/嵌入用法不变。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14746；相关：#14748（审批对话框后续）、#16182（frontmatter/LSP 显式授信）

</details>

prs.title: docs(release): explain hosted-runner queueing for publish
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a short operator note to the release documentation explaining why a release can sit in the GitHub-hosted queue for a long time without being broken, and why the two hosted steps of the release pipeline cannot be moved onto the ECS pools. It links the existing pool design record instead of repeating that analysis.

## Why it's needed

A manual release looked stuck: its publish step stayed queued for 2h33m with an empty log and no runner assigned, while every other job in the same run had already finished on ECS within seconds. Reading the workflow alone does not explain this, and the natural conclusion — "publish was never migrated, let's move it to the release pool" — is wrong. npm trusted publishing supports cloud-hosted runners only, so a self-hosted publisher cannot authenticate and would emit no provenance. The macOS and Windows audio prebuild legs are hosted for a separate reason: they build against native toolchains.

The existing design record already covers the pool saturation and which jobs were moved off hosted runners, but it is a design document, not the page an operator opens when a release appears frozen. This note puts the two hard constraints and the "queued is not failed" expectation next to the release failure-handling guidance, where that question actually gets asked.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Documentation-only change; no workflow, script, or runtime behavior is touched.

- Confirm the npm constraint against the upstream documentation linked in the note: trusted publishing lists GitHub-hosted runners, GitLab.com shared runners, and CircleCI cloud, and states self-hosted runners are not currently supported.
- Confirm the audio prebuild routing claim by reading the `build` job's `runs-on` expression in `audio-capture-prebuilds.yml`: the ECS branch is gated on `startsWith(matrix.os, 'ubuntu')`, so the `macos-14` and `windows-latest` matrix entries fall through to their hosted `runner` values.
- Confirm the timing numbers against the cited runs: in run 41209751466 the publish job was queued at 00:44:21Z, started 03:17:19Z, and completed 03:22:56Z (2h33m queued, 5m37s executed). The nightly runs 41350426673 and 41525732352 started their publish 4s and 3s after `Build Release Artifacts` completed.
- Confirm the relative link resolves to `docs/design/2026-10-16-release-jobs-off-hosted-pool.md`.

Local checks: `npx prettier --check docs/developers/development/npm.md` passes, and the linked design document exists at the referenced path. No test suite parses this page.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — documentation only, no user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     |              Status               |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ formatting and reference checks |
| 🪟 Windows |                N/A                |
|  🐧 Linux  |                N/A                |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — no runtime involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the queue timings are measurements from specific runs, not a service guarantee; they are dated in the text so they read as observations rather than expected behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: this PR does not change any runner routing. Reducing the queue itself needs either a higher hosted concurrency allowance or less automation traffic on the hosted pool; the bot jobs that dominate that traffic carry PATs and react to fork-raised events, so moving them to persistent runners is a separate credential-isolation decision, not a docs change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

None. Follow-up from investigating the queued publish in run 41209751466; related design record: [Release Jobs Off the Hosted Pool](docs/design/2026-10-16-release-jobs-off-hosted-pool.md).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在发布文档里补了一小段面向操作者的说明：为什么一次发布可能长时间停在 GitHub 托管队列里却并没有失败，以及发布流水线里那两个托管步骤为什么不能挪到 ECS 池。池子本身的分析已有设计文档，这里只做链接，不重复。

## 为什么需要

一次手动发布看起来卡死了：publish 步骤排队 2h33m，日志为空、没有分配 runner，而同一个 run 里其他 job 早就在 ECS 上几秒内跑完了。只看 workflow 文件无法解释这件事，而由此很自然会得出的结论——“publish 漏迁了，把它挪到 release 池吧”——是错的。npm 可信发布只支持云端托管 runner，自建机会认证失败，也不会产出 provenance。macOS 和 Windows 的音频预编译留在托管机则是另一个原因：它们要针对原生工具链构建。

已有设计文档记录了池子饱和的情况以及哪些 job 已经迁走，但那是设计记录，不是操作者在发布看起来冻住时会打开的页面。这段说明把两条硬约束和“排队不等于失败”的判断放在发布失败处理指引旁边，也就是这个问题真正被问到的位置。

## 评审验证方式

纯文档改动，不涉及任何 workflow、脚本或运行时行为。

- 对照文中链接的 npm 上游文档确认约束：可信发布列出的是 GitHub 托管 runner、GitLab.com 共享 runner 和 CircleCI cloud，并明确写着当前不支持自建 runner。
- 阅读 `audio-capture-prebuilds.yml` 里 `build` job 的 `runs-on` 表达式确认音频预编译的路由说法：ECS 分支的条件是 `startsWith(matrix.os, 'ubuntu')`，因此 `macos-14` 和 `windows-latest` 两个矩阵项会落到各自的托管 `runner` 值。
- 对照引用的 run 确认时间数字：run 41209751466 的 publish job 在 00:44:21Z 入队、03:17:19Z 起跑、03:22:56Z 完成（排队 2h33m，执行 5m37s）。nightly run 41350426673 和 41525732352 的 publish 分别在 `Build Release Artifacts` 完成后 4s 和 3s 起跑。
- 确认相对链接指向 `docs/design/2026-10-16-release-jobs-off-hosted-pool.md`。

本地检查：`npx prettier --check docs/developers/development/npm.md` 通过，链接的设计文档在引用路径上存在。没有测试套件解析这个页面。

### 前后证据

N/A —— 纯文档，没有用户可见界面。

### 测试环境

macOS 上完成格式与引用检查；Windows 与 Linux 不涉及。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：排队时间来自具体 run 的实测，不是服务承诺；文中写明了日期，读起来是观测结果而不是预期行为。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：这个 PR 不改任何 runner 路由。要真正缩短队列，需要提高托管并发额度，或者减少托管池上的自动化流量；而占大头的那些 bot job 持有 PAT 且响应 fork 触发的事件，把它们挪到持久 runner 属于独立的凭据隔离决策，不是文档改动能解决的。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

无。来自对 run 41209751466 中 publish 排队的排查；相关设计记录见 [Release Jobs Off the Hosted Pool](docs/design/2026-10-16-release-jobs-off-hosted-pool.md)。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): honor Anthropic transport timeout configuration
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Anthropic-compatible requests now pass the selected Undici dispatcher directly through their custom fetch. Session and custom headers, SDK timeout, caller cancellation, and the configured proxy/TLS policy continue through the same request path. A regression test exercises the real Anthropic SDK rather than only checking its constructor options.

## Why it's needed

The shipped Anthropic SDK ignores the client `fetchOptions` option. Although Qwen creates a dispatcher with disabled headers/body timeouts, that dispatcher never reaches the request, so the default transport can abort while waiting for headers after about 300 seconds despite a configured 600-second API timeout. Binding the existing dispatcher at the fetch boundary restores the intended timeout policy without changing the SDK dependency.

## Reviewer Test Plan

[Detailed local acceptance report: 8 A/B runs and all 32 assertions](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/16193#issuecomment-6598664796) — includes correlated wire/CLI logs, the regression red/green output, full replay scripts, runtime provenance and unverified boundaries.

### How to verify

Follow the local Anthropic endpoint reproduction in #16187 with the API timeout set to 600 seconds and response headers delayed for 330 seconds. The request should finish once with `OK`, without a five-minute transport error or retry. Confirm that a shorter SDK timeout and user cancellation still close the pending connection, and that an explicit HTTPS CONNECT proxy preserves the built-in session header and a custom header with TLS verification enabled.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Matched local CLI/wire verification uses the merge-base build and the candidate build, the same scripted provider, and real elapsed time. This verifies the CLI and network behavior with a controlled provider; it is not a production-model acceptance run.

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Headers delayed 330 seconds; API timeout 600 seconds | Connection closes at 301.060s with `UND_ERR_HEADERS_TIMEOUT`, then retries | First and only request completes at 330.007s; CLI returns `OK`, `is_error: false`, exit 0 |
| HTTPS CONNECT proxy, session/custom headers, trusted TLS | Pass | Pass |
| SDK timeout 2 seconds | Connection closes at 1.997s | Connection closes at 1.995s |
| SIGINT after request receipt | Connection closes 2ms after signal | Connection closes 3ms after signal |

The new dispatcher regression fails on the original code (`undefined` reaches fetch) and passes after the fix. Final focused run: 255 tests across the transport, Anthropic generator, and outbound session-header suites passed. Build, repository typecheck, bundle, changed-file ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` passed. Independent correctness and security reviews were clean. The local full review completed with no remaining findings after adding a request-method assertion and rejecting an unsupported future-SDK double-dispatch claim.

The review engine also ran broader checks: core reported 10 failures across extension, memory latency, cron cleanup, and shell commit tests; CLI and Web Shell checks exceeded their time budgets. These broader results are not claimed as passing or proven baseline failures. Local review used `deepseek-v4-pro`; CI is configured for `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017`, and its private endpoint was not reproduced locally. The final composed review used the worktree-built CLI 0.26.6; earlier timed-out runs and a mismatched-helper summary were excluded as passing evidence.

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Anthropic transport now applies the dispatcher already selected by Qwen, including its proxy and TLS settings. The matched proxy, header, timeout, and cancellation controls passed.

prs.title: ci(e2e): run the nightly suite with the unified agent loop on
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the scheduled signal that the unified agent loop's default change waits on (#15327). The nightly E2E run, and one started by hand, gets one more Linux leg: `sandbox:none` with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1`. It runs the same whole integration suite as the existing `sandbox:none` leg, so every headless and ACP session the tests start runs on the shared loop.

- The leg is a new `agent-loop` matrix dimension of `e2e-test-linux`: `current` on a push, `current` and `unified` on the schedule and on `workflow_dispatch`. Docker is excluded for `unified`, so a push still runs the two legs it runs today and the nightly run adds one.
- The leg's name ends in "unified agent loop".
- The parity suites still set the variable per run themselves, and the tests that pin it to `0` keep doing so.
- `Main CI Failure Issue` files issues for `E2E Tests` failures on pushes only, so a red nightly leg reports in the run without opening issues.

It also updates the setting's description, which still said that only the model rounds of ACP user prompts use the shared loop. The new text says headless and ACP sessions use it, and the interactive TUI and subagents keep their own loop for now. It is updated in the schema, the generated VS Code schema, the settings doc and the Web Shell's Chinese string. The description assumes #16190, which moves ACP's cron and background-notification turns, the last ACP turns still on the old loop.

The design doc's parity section now describes this job in place of a scheduled job that did not exist.

## Why it's needed

The design changes a surface's default only after a scheduled job has run its integration suite with the setting on and passed on main for two weeks. No such job existed, so the two weeks could not start, for headless or for ACP.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `actionlint .github/workflows/e2e.yml` and `yamllint .github/workflows/e2e.yml` pass.
- After merge, start `E2E Tests` with `workflow_dispatch` on main. The Linux matrix shows three legs: `sandbox:none`, `sandbox:docker`, and `sandbox:none` ending in "unified agent loop". A push to main still shows the first two.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: CI configuration and description text.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Locally: actionlint 1.7.12 and yamllint 1.38.0 (the repo's `.yamllint.yml`) pass on the workflow, and prettier is clean on the changed files. The new leg itself first runs after merge: a fork cannot run it, because the suite uses the repository's model secrets.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the nightly run uses one more pool runner, for about as long as the existing `sandbox:none` leg, and makes that many more real model calls. Pushes are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: whether the whole suite passes with the setting on is what the leg is for. A failure there is a finding for #15327, not a reason to change the leg. Changing a default is a later step.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为统一 agent loop 的默认值修改加上它要等待的定时信号（#15327）。每晚的 E2E 运行，以及手动触发的运行，多出一个 Linux 分支：设置 `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` 的 `sandbox:none`。它运行的完整集成测试和现有的 `sandbox:none` 分支相同，因此测试启动的每个 headless 和 ACP 会话都运行在共享循环上。

- 这个分支是 `e2e-test-linux` 新增的 `agent-loop` 矩阵维度：push 时只有 `current`，定时运行和 `workflow_dispatch` 时有 `current` 和 `unified`。`unified` 排除了 docker，所以 push 仍然只跑现在的两个分支，每晚的运行多跑一个。
- 这个分支的名字以 "unified agent loop" 结尾。
- 对拍测试仍然在每次运行中自己设置这个变量，把它固定为 `0` 的测试也保持不变。
- `Main CI Failure Issue` 只为 push 触发的 `E2E Tests` 失败开 issue，所以每晚的这个分支变红时只在运行里报告，不会开 issue。

同时更新了设置的描述：旧描述还写着只有 ACP 用户 prompt 的模型轮使用共享循环。新描述说明 headless 和 ACP 会话使用共享循环，交互式 TUI 和子代理暂时保留自己的循环。更新的位置包括 schema、生成的 VS Code schema、设置文档和 Web Shell 的中文文案。新描述以 #16190 为前提：它迁移 ACP 的 cron 和后台通知轮次，也就是最后两类还在旧循环上的 ACP 轮次。

设计文档的对拍测试一节改为描述这个任务，取代原来写的、实际并不存在的定时任务。

## 为什么需要

按设计，一个入口要等定时任务在设置开启的情况下运行它的集成测试、并在 main 上连续通过两周后，才修改默认值。这个任务此前并不存在，所以 headless 和 ACP 的两周观察期都无法开始。

## 验证方法

- `actionlint .github/workflows/e2e.yml` 和 `yamllint .github/workflows/e2e.yml` 通过。
- 合入后，在 main 上用 `workflow_dispatch` 启动 `E2E Tests`。Linux 矩阵显示三个分支：`sandbox:none`、`sandbox:docker`，以及名字以 "unified agent loop" 结尾的 `sandbox:none`。push 到 main 时仍然只有前两个。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：每晚的运行多占用一个 pool runner，时长和现有的 `sandbox:none` 分支相当，真实模型调用也相应增加。push 不受影响。
- 未验证/不在范围内：完整测试在设置开启时能否通过，正是这个分支要回答的问题；那里的失败是 #15327 的发现，不是修改这个分支的理由。修改默认值是后续步骤。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(acp): run cron and background-notification turns on the shared loop
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, ACP's cron turns and background-notification turns now run on the shared round, the shared tool batch and the client's stop point. This is PR 2c-4 of #15327, the last of ACP's turn kinds.

- A **cron turn** (loop ticks included) is a `Cron` round. As on the other surfaces, the client resets the turn's memory state, adds its system and todo reminders and recalls memory. ACP records the prompt once its request reached history, as today, ahead of the response the client records.
- A **background-notification turn** is a `Notification` round. ACP records the notification and adds its system and todo reminders, as today, and shows each response as one background message once it ended.

ACP keeps the scheduling around the turn as today: the queues, the admission of a notification turn, the echo of a cron prompt, the start and end notifications, and the channel delivery of a scheduled reply. As today, a cron turn that loop protection or a declined approval stopped is not delivered, and a cron or notification turn the session aborts ends as cancelled, without StopFailure.

The prompt loop's shared round becomes a method, `#runSharedRound`, that the three loops share. The prompt loop passes it what only a prompt has: putting a re-entered turn back when its request never went out, the Goal marks, and the loop stop that pauses a Goal. The cron and notification loops run their tool batches around it as the prompt loop does. The move changes no behavior of a prompt turn; `git diff --color-moved` shows the moved block.

Both kinds of turn run the Todo Stop Guard as their stop policy, after the Stop hook. Queued input does not cut their responses short, as today, and is taken at a tool boundary. It no longer continues a notification turn at its stop point; it starts the next turn, as on a prompt since PR 2c-1.

Core change: `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` also covers a `Cron` and a `Notification` send, whose prompt or notification the host records.

With the setting on, these behaviors differ from today, as the design's Compatibility section lists. They match headless and the TUI:

- A cron or notification turn runs what a prompt runs on the shared path:
  - the client's loop heuristics and session turn cap;
  - the Stop hook and its continuations;
  - StopFailure when its model request fails;
  - the shared tool batch with the client's tool-call guards, where a tool that ends the turn ends it, unless the cron job delivers its reply to a channel.
- A cron turn's system reminders are the client's, and it carries the client's memory recall. A notification turn gets an interaction span.
- Input queued during a notification turn, and the turn's own background results, no longer continue it at its stop point; they start the next turn.
- A cron turn cancelled between rounds keeps the results of its last tool batch in history, as a prompt does. A notification turn whose response is retried shows only the retried text.
- A cron turn cancelled after its echo and before its first request keeps its prompt in history and in the record, as a cron turn cancelled while its request is going out does today.

## Why it's needed

Cron and notification turns were the last ACP turns with loop bodies of their own, each with its own copy of the model round and tool step. Several fixes made in the prompt loop never reached them: a tool that ends the turn, StopFailure, and the tool results kept on a cancel.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `npm run bundle`, then `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`.
  - The new scenario "a background shell whose result starts a notification turn" starts a shell in the background that outlasts the prompt. Its result then starts a notification turn on both loops. With the setting off and on, the scenario must send the model the same requests, and produce the same `session/update` notifications, stop reasons and notification turn ends. The suite now normalizes the background task id, its pid and the run's home directory.
  - The other scenarios must be unchanged.
  - Cron fires on a minute schedule, so no parity scenario covers it; the unit tests below do.
- Unit tests:
  - `packages/core` `client.test.ts`: a `Cron` or `Notification` send leaves its record to a host that records it, and records it otherwise.
  - `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts`, "cron and background-notification turns" under "shared agent loop round":
    - a cron fire sent as a `Cron` round with the Todo Stop Guard, its prompt recorded once sent;
    - a cron prompt recorded before the response its round records;
    - a cron prompt whose request never went out, kept out of the record;
    - a scheduled cron turn that ended on its own delivered, and one that loop protection stopped not delivered;
    - a cron turn cancelled mid-response ended as cancelled, without StopFailure;
    - a cron fire's tool results sent back as a `ToolResult` round;
    - a background notification sent as a `Notification` round, its response shown once as a background message and not streamed;
    - a notification turn that loop protection stopped, ended as partial.
  - The 2c-1 test of a turn's late background results now expects their notification turn on the shared round.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: the change is behind an off-by-default setting, and the parity suite compares both loops.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local results on Linux:

- ACP parity suite 24/24 and headless parity suite 12/12, from a fresh `npm run bundle`
- root `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces and `typecheck:integration`) passes
- core `src/core/`: 6,107 passed
- cli `Session.test.ts`: 1,398 passed after the review fixes; cli `tsc --noEmit` passes
- cli `src/acp-integration/` and `nonInteractiveCli.test.ts`: all pass except `acp-output.test.ts`, a Node stream test this PR does not touch, which fails the same way without this PR
- the cron-record, record-order, scheduled-delivery, cancelled-cron and loop-stop cases fail when the change they cover is reverted, and the core case asserts both sides of its option
- eslint and prettier clean on the changed files

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the prompt loop's shared round moved into a method. A prompt turn runs the same code with its own parts passed in, and the ACP parity suite covers it unchanged. With the setting off, nothing changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: making the setting the default for ACP and removing ACP's current loops (PR 2d).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) and [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md). Both have the new PR 2c-4 section, the widened `userTurnRecordedByHost` row, the new ACP scenario and the intended differences.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，ACP 的 cron 轮次和后台通知轮次改为使用共享模型轮、共享工具批和 client 的 stop 点。这是 #15327 的 PR 2c-4，也是 ACP 最后两类轮次。

- **cron 轮次**（包括 loop tick）是 `Cron` 模型轮。和其他界面一样，由 client 重置这一轮的记忆状态、加上它的系统提醒和 todo 提醒并召回记忆。ACP 和现在一样，在请求进入历史后记录 prompt，早于 client 记录的响应。
- **后台通知轮次**是 `Notification` 模型轮。ACP 和现在一样记录通知、加上它的系统提醒和 todo 提醒，并在每个响应结束后把它作为一条后台消息显示。

轮次外围的调度和现在一样留在 ACP：队列、通知轮次的准入、cron prompt 的回显、开始和结束通知，以及定时回复的 channel 投递。和现在一样，被循环保护或拒绝授权停下的 cron 轮次不投递；被 session 中止的 cron 或通知轮次以取消结束，不触发 StopFailure。

prompt 循环里的共享模型轮改为三个循环共用的方法 `#runSharedRound`。prompt 循环把只有 prompt 才有的部分传给它：请求没有发出时把重新进入的轮次放回原样、Goal 标记，以及暂停 Goal 的循环停止。cron 和通知循环像 prompt 循环一样，在它外面运行自己的工具批。这次搬移不改变 prompt 轮次的任何行为；`git diff --color-moved` 可以看到被搬移的代码块。

两类轮次都在 Stop hook 之后运行 Todo Stop Guard 作为 stop 策略。排队的输入和现在一样不会打断它们的响应，在工具边界取入；在 stop 点它不再让通知轮次继续，而是启动下一轮，和 PR 2c-1 以来的 prompt 一样。

core 的改动：`SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` 也覆盖 `Cron` 和 `Notification` 发送，表示由宿主记录 prompt 或通知。

开启设置后，以下行为和现在不同，列在设计文档的兼容性一节，和 headless、TUI 一致：

- cron 或通知轮次运行 prompt 在共享路径上运行的内容：
  - client 的循环启发式检查和会话轮次上限；
  - Stop hook 及其续发；
  - 模型请求失败时的 StopFailure；
  - 带 client 工具调用守卫的共享工具批，其中结束轮次的工具会结束这一轮，除非这个 cron 任务把回复投递到 channel。
- cron 轮次的系统提醒改为 client 的，并带上 client 的记忆召回；通知轮次有了交互 span。
- 通知轮次期间排队的输入，以及这一轮自己的后台结果，不再在 stop 点让它继续，而是启动下一轮。
- 在两个模型轮之间被取消的 cron 轮次，和 prompt 一样把最后一个工具批的结果保留在历史中；响应被重试的通知轮次只显示重试后的文本。
- 在回显之后、第一个请求发出之前被取消的 cron 轮次，会把 prompt 保留在历史和记录中，和现在请求发出过程中被取消的 cron 轮次一样。

## 为什么需要

cron 和通知轮次是 ACP 最后两个有自己循环体的轮次，各自复制了一份模型轮和工具步骤。prompt 循环里做过的几项修复一直没有到达它们：结束轮次的工具、StopFailure，以及取消时保留的工具结果。

## 验证方法

- 运行 `npm run bundle`，然后 `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`。
  - 新场景 "a background shell whose result starts a notification turn" 在后台启动一个持续时间超过 prompt 的 shell，它的结果在两个循环上都会启动一个通知轮次。设置关闭和开启时，这个场景必须向模型发送相同的请求，产生相同的 `session/update` 通知、stop reason 和通知轮次结束。套件现在会归一化后台任务 id、它的 pid 和这次运行的 home 目录。
  - 其余场景必须不变。
  - cron 按分钟触发，parity 没有覆盖它的场景，由下面的单元测试覆盖。
- 单元测试：
  - `packages/core` 的 `client.test.ts`：`Cron` 或 `Notification` 发送在宿主负责记录时不由 client 记录，否则由 client 记录。
  - `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts`，"shared agent loop round" 下的 "cron and background-notification turns"：
    - cron 触发作为 `Cron` 模型轮发出，带 Todo Stop Guard，prompt 在发出后记录一次；
    - cron prompt 记录在它这一轮记录的响应之前；
    - 请求一直没有发出的 cron prompt 不被记录；
    - 自行结束的定时 cron 轮次会投递，被循环保护停下的不投递；
    - 响应途中被取消的 cron 轮次以取消结束，不触发 StopFailure；
    - cron 触发的工具结果作为 `ToolResult` 模型轮发回；
    - 后台通知作为 `Notification` 模型轮发出，响应作为一条后台消息显示一次，不逐段流式输出；
    - 被循环保护停下的通知轮次以 partial 结束。
  - 2c-1 中关于本轮迟到后台结果的测试，现在期望它们的通知轮次走共享模型轮。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：prompt 循环的共享模型轮搬进了一个方法。prompt 轮次运行同一段代码，只是把自己的部分作为参数传入，ACP parity 套件覆盖它不变。设置关闭时没有任何变化。
- 未验证/不在范围内：让设置成为 ACP 的默认值，并删除 ACP 当前的循环（PR 2d）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: feat(acp): run cron and background-notification turns on the shared loop (#16190)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(acp): run cron and background-notification turns on the shared loop

With experimental.unifiedAgentLoop on, ACP's cron turns (loop ticks
included) run as Cron rounds and its background-notification turns as
Notification rounds on the shared round, the shared tool batch and the
client's stop point, with the Todo Stop Guard as their stop policy.

The prompt loop's shared round moves into #runSharedRound, which the
prompt, cron and notification loops share; the prompt loop passes in
what only a prompt has. ACP keeps the scheduling around these turns,
records the cron prompt once it reached history and the notification
with its task, and shows each notification response as one background
message.

userTurnRecordedByHost also covers Cron and Notification sends, whose
record the host writes.

The ACP parity suite gains a background-shell scenario whose result
starts a notification turn.

Part of #15327.

* fix(acp): settle shared cron and notification turns as the current path does

A cron turn that loop protection or a declined approval stopped is no
longer delivered to its channel, as the current path returns before
delivery. The cron prompt is recorded as the first event of its response
arrives, before the client records the response, so the record keeps the
prompt ahead of its answer. A cron or notification round that threw on
its aborted signal, which only the session aborts, ends as cancelled
rather than firing StopFailure. The cron turn counts its rounds as they
start, so a round that throws still counts.

The automatic loop emits a response's usage through the shared round's
emitResponseUsage instead of repeating it, and the shared round
destructures what it aliased.

* docs(design): list the cron prompt a cancel before its first request keeps

prs.title: feat(mods): run prompt.submit hooks in the Ink terminal
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This is step 2 of the prompt submission design (`docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md`): Mods' `prompt.submit` hooks now run in the Ink terminal, for each prompt the person types. Step 1 (#15905) added the event in headless runs; the OpenTUI terminal follows in step 3.

- **The hooks run before anything reads the prompt.** That is before the input history records it, before its row is added, before `@` references are read and before UserPromptSubmit. The hook receives the typed text with pasted text expanded, `wait: false` and `origin: {kind: 'composer'}`.
  - Slash commands, shell-mode commands, scheduled prompts, notifications, teammate messages and retries raise no event.
  - A prompt queued while a turn runs raises it when it is sent. While a Mod hooks `prompt.submit`, queued prompts are not steered into the running turn at a tool boundary: they wait for the turn to end, so steering cannot bypass the hooks.
- **A rewrite stands wherever the typed text would.** That covers the model's prompt, the prompt's row, the input history the Up key recalls, the restore after a cancel, workflow keywords and `turn.start`.
  - Attachment references and the one-shot notices the terminal adds ahead of a prompt for the model alone, such as a resumed worktree, stay ahead of the rewrite. The hooks never hear them.
  - A paste the rewrite keeps whole stays collapsed in the row and framed for the model. An answer that differs only in surrounding whitespace is no rewrite.
- **Context reaches the model the same way as in headless runs.** It goes in the hidden block after the prompt, through the `promptContext` send option from step 1.
- **A drop shows its reason as an error line, and the prompt is kept out of the transcript and the input history.**
  - The input history is written to disk and comes back in later sessions, and a guard usually drops a prompt for what it holds, such as a credential.
  - The prompt comes back to the input box with its paste placeholders, ahead of anything typed since, so the person can edit it and send it again.
- **Esc while the hooks run cancels the prompt.** It hands the prompt back the same way.
- **Only the Ink terminal opts in.** `InteractiveModSession.initialize` takes `{ prompts: true }`, and the terminal host passes it to the load request. The OpenTUI terminal still skips these hooks with the startup line, so a guard is never silently bypassed there.

## Why it's needed

After #15905, a `prompt.submit` guard ran in headless runs but was skipped in the interactive terminal. There the prompts it is meant to stop went to the model, and into the input history and the session transcript on disk.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Install a Mod with a `prompt.submit` hook that drops a prompt holding `AKIA` followed by 16 capitals or digits, and otherwise rewrites `prod` to `production` and adds the context `Mod context: be brief`. Start `qwen` and:
  - send `deploy prod now`: the row reads `deploy production now`, and the model receives that text with the context in the hidden block;
  - send `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`: an error line `Prompt dropped by a hook: …` appears, no request is sent, and the prompt is back in the input box;
  - clear the input box and press Up: it recalls `deploy production now`, not the dropped prompt.
- `npx vitest run src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts` in `packages/cli`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive Ink session in tmux (170×50), with the Mod above installed through `qwen extensions install` and a loopback OpenAI-compatible fixture that records each request. Before is `main` at `90eb13e4c6`, After is this PR. Both bundles were built locally.

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Startup | `Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit` | no skip line |
| `deploy prod now`: row | `> deploy prod now` | `> deploy production now` |
| `deploy prod now`: model's text | `deploy prod now` | `deploy production now`, then `<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>Mod context: be brief</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>` |
| `key AKIA…`: screen | `> key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`, then the answer | `✕ Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key`, with the prompt back in the input box |
| `key AKIA…`: model requests | 3 | 0 |
| Up key after clearing the input box | `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP` | `deploy production now` |
| Files under `HOME` that hold the key | `logs.json` (input history) and the session transcript | none |

Automated checks:

- New hook tests cover:
  - the rewritten prompt in the send, the row, the input history, the workflow input and `turn.start`;
  - notices kept ahead of a rewrite;
  - an attachment, a notice and a framed paste around a rewrite, and a whitespace-only answer;
  - a drop: error line, no row, no input history, no request, the prompt handed back;
  - a prompt cancelled while its hooks run;
  - no event for a slash command or a scheduled prompt.
- An AppContainer test covers the `prompts: true` opt-in, the steer drain held while hooks hear prompts, and handing a prompt back with its placeholders ahead of the box's text. Mod session tests cover a terminal that opts in, and an owner that lets prompts through once it closes.
- 22 of 23 mutants are caught by the tests. They cover which prompts raise the event, both hand-backs and their placeholders, the error line, finding the typed text, re-collapsing pastes, the input history, the context, the workflow input, `turn.start`, the display text, the opt-in links, the closed owner, prepending to the box and the held steer drain. The survivor, an untrimmed comparison, gives the same output now that pastes are re-collapsed.
- The touched test files pass: 5 files, 769 tests.
- The cli `tsc --noEmit`, and the scoped ESLint and Prettier checks pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 24.21.0, tmux, bundles built with `npm run bundle`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a slow hook delays the prompt by up to its budget, 10 seconds a hook, before its row appears. Sessions with a `prompt.submit` hook lose mid-turn steering: a prompt typed during a turn waits for it to end. A dropped prompt also uses up the one-shot notices the terminal had added to it.
- Not validated / out of scope: the OpenTUI terminal (step 3) and `$.prompt.submit` (step 4).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. A Mod with `prompt.submit` hooks now runs them in the Ink terminal instead of having them skipped.

## Linked Issues

Part of #13749.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这是提示提交设计（`docs/design/2026-10-30-mod-prompt-submit.md`）的第 2 步：Mod 的 `prompt.submit` hook 现在在 Ink 终端中运行，覆盖用户输入的每个提示。第 1 步（#15905）在 headless 运行中加入了该事件；OpenTUI 终端在第 3 步跟进。

- **hook 在任何地方读取提示之前运行。** 即在输入历史记录它之前、添加它的消息行之前、读取 `@` 引用之前，以及 UserPromptSubmit 之前。hook 收到的是用户输入的文本（粘贴内容已展开）、`wait: false` 和 `origin: {kind: 'composer'}`。
  - 斜杠命令、shell 模式命令、定时提示、通知、队友消息和重试都不触发该事件。
  - 回合进行中排队的提示在真正发送时触发。有 Mod 挂了 `prompt.submit` 时，排队的提示不会在工具边界被插进运行中的回合，而是等回合结束，因此中途插话无法绕过 hook。
- **改写替换所有原本使用输入文本的地方。** 包括模型收到的提示、消息行、按上键调出的输入历史、取消后的恢复、工作流关键字和 `turn.start`。
  - 附件引用和终端为模型放在提示前面的一次性提醒（例如恢复的 worktree）仍保留在改写结果前面，hook 不会听到它们。
  - 改写后仍完整保留的粘贴内容在消息行中保持折叠，发给模型时仍被包裹。只差首尾空白的答复不算改写。
- **上下文与 headless 运行一样进入模型。** 通过第 1 步的 `promptContext` 发送选项，放在提示之后的隐藏块中。
- **丢弃时以一行错误显示原因，提示不进入 transcript，也不进入输入历史。**
  - 输入历史会写入磁盘并在之后的会话中恢复，而守卫丢弃提示通常正是因为其中的内容，例如凭据。
  - 提示会带着粘贴占位符回到输入框，放在之后输入的内容前面，方便修改后重新发送。
- **hook 运行时按 Esc 会取消该提示。** 提示以同样方式回到输入框。
- **只有 Ink 终端声明触发该事件。** `InteractiveModSession.initialize` 接收 `{ prompts: true }`，终端宿主再把它传给加载请求。OpenTUI 终端仍在启动时跳过这些 hook 并给出提示，守卫在那里不会被悄悄绕过。

## 为什么需要

#15905 之后，`prompt.submit` 守卫在 headless 运行中生效，但在交互式终端里被跳过。它本应拦下的提示仍会发给模型，并写入磁盘上的输入历史和会话 transcript。

## 评审验证

### 如何验证

- 安装一个带 `prompt.submit` hook 的 Mod：提示中含有 `AKIA` 加 16 位大写字母或数字时丢弃，否则把 `prod` 改写为 `production` 并加上上下文 `Mod context: be brief`。启动 `qwen`，然后：
  - 发送 `deploy prod now`：消息行显示 `deploy production now`，模型收到该文本，隐藏块中带有上下文；
  - 发送 `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`：出现错误行 `Prompt dropped by a hook: …`，没有发出请求，提示回到输入框；
  - 清空输入框后按上键：调出的是 `deploy production now`，而不是被丢弃的提示。
- 在 `packages/cli` 中运行 `npx vitest run src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx src/services/mod-session.test.ts src/services/interactive-mod-session.test.ts`。

### 证据（前后对比）

tmux 中的交互式 Ink 会话（170×50），上面的 Mod 通过 `qwen extensions install` 安装，使用记录每个请求的本地回环 OpenAI 兼容 fixture。Before 为 `main` 的 `90eb13e4c6`，After 为本 PR。两个 bundle 都在本地构建。

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启动 | `Hooks for unsupported events will not run: prompt.submit` | 无跳过提示 |
| `deploy prod now`：消息行 | `> deploy prod now` | `> deploy production now` |
| `deploy prod now`：模型收到的文本 | `deploy prod now` | `deploy production now`，之后是 `<qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>Mod context: be brief</qwen:user-prompt-submit-context>` |
| `key AKIA…`：屏幕 | `> key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP`，然后是回答 | `✕ Prompt dropped by a hook: the prompt holds an AWS access key`，提示回到输入框 |
| `key AKIA…`：模型请求数 | 3 | 0 |
| 清空输入框后按上键 | `key AKIAABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP` | `deploy production now` |
| `HOME` 下含有该密钥的文件 | `logs.json`（输入历史）和会话 transcript | 无 |

自动化检查：

- 新增的 hook 测试覆盖：
  - 改写后的提示出现在发送内容、消息行、输入历史、工作流输入和 `turn.start` 中；

prs.title: fix(web-shell): handle image URL pastes and unavailable files
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Web Shell attaches an image when the clipboard contains exactly one image and its accompanying plain text is a single HTTP(S) URL. Editable office text still takes priority over its bitmap representation, and command drafts keep pasted URL arguments as text. A paste that advertises files without exposing any file objects or plain text now shows the existing unavailable-file warning.

## Why it's needed

The previous text-first behavior treated a copied image's source URL as the intended content and silently ignored the bitmap. A second path ignored clipboard file declarations when no file object was available, leaving the user with no attachment or explanation. Simply preferring every file would regress the existing PowerPoint text workflow, so this change uses a narrow URL heuristic and preserves text handling elsewhere.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Paste a clipboard containing one PNG and a single HTTP(S) URL into a normal conversation draft. Expect an image attachment and no inserted URL text. Image-only paste should also continue to attach an image.
2. Paste multiline PowerPoint-like text accompanied by a bitmap. Expect editable text, preserved line breaks, and no redundant image attachment. A URL-only clipboard or a mixed payload with a caption or multiple images should keep its text behavior.
3. Start a command draft such as `/fork ` and paste the same URL-plus-image payload. Expect the complete URL argument to remain editable, with no image attachment. Check collapsed and expanded touch editors as well as desktop.
4. Paste a payload advertising `Files` but exposing no file objects or plain text. Expect one unavailable-file warning. Ordinary text paste should not produce that warning.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: synthetic DOM reproductions at the original main showed URL text without an image for URL-plus-PNG, and neither an attachment nor a notice for an empty advertised file payload.

After: Chromium browser tests on the merged PR head verify image attachment, editable PPT text, complete command URL arguments, and the unavailable-file warning. The screenshots below use a mock daemon and synthetic clipboard events. They demonstrate rendered UI state, not actual operating-system clipboard formats or real backend attachment submission or command execution.

One image with its source URL becomes an attachment, with no URL inserted into the editor.

![Image attachment from URL-plus-image paste](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/image-url-paste.png)

An advertised file payload without a file object produces a visible warning.

![Unavailable clipboard file warning](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/unavailable-file-paste.png)

A command draft retains the complete URL argument and has no image attachment.

![Command URL argument retained as text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/command-url-paste.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Vitest/jsdom, Chromium browser E2E, build and type checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.14.0, local source and bundled CLI, Chromium with a mock daemon. Post-merge verification: full build and bundle, repository typecheck, 340 focused Vitest tests, 3 Chromium E2E tests (including one temporary evidence flow), and changed-file lint/format checks passed. The browser screenshots are stored on a separate assets branch at a fixed commit and are not part of the implementation branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the URL rule is a heuristic. Outside command drafts, an office selection consisting only of an HTTP(S) URL and one bitmap will also prefer the image. Captions, non-HTTP(S) text, multiple images, disabled attachments, and shell mode retain text priority.
- Not validated / out of scope: native Linux/WebKitGTK, actual PowerPoint or screenshot-tool clipboard formats, real backend attachment submission, and backend command execution. The unrelated upstream Java changes are inherited from main and are not part of this PR's effective diff or verification claims.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no public API, dependency, daemon route, or configuration changes; no migration required.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e7a08929f3180e6790aeba6161bfb5edb5e61815/docs/design/web-shell-image-url-paste.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/e7a08929f3180e6790aeba6161bfb5edb5e61815/docs/design/web-shell-image-url-paste.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16088

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

当剪贴板恰好包含一张图片，且附带纯文本为单个 HTTP(S) URL 时，Web Shell 会添加图片附件。办公软件的可编辑文字继续优先于其位图表示，命令草稿中的 URL 参数继续按文字粘贴。对于声明了文件却既不提供文件对象也不提供纯文本的粘贴，现在会显示现有的不可用文件警告。

## 为什么需要

此前的文字优先行为会把所复制图片的源 URL 当作目标内容，静默忽略位图。另一条路径在无法取得文件对象时忽略剪贴板的文件声明，用户既得不到附件，也看不到说明。直接让所有文件优先会破坏已有的 PowerPoint 文字粘贴流程，因此本改动使用范围有限的 URL 启发式判断，并在其他情况下保留文字处理。

## 审阅者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在普通对话草稿中粘贴同时包含一张 PNG 和单个 HTTP(S) URL 的剪贴板。应生成图片附件，不插入 URL 文字。纯图片粘贴也应继续生成附件。
2. 粘贴附带位图的多行 PPT 风格文字。应保留可编辑文字和换行，不生成冗余图片附件。仅含 URL 的剪贴板，或带说明文字、多张图片的混合载荷，应保留文字行为。
3. 输入 `/fork ` 等命令草稿，再粘贴同样的 URL 加图片载荷。应保留完整、可编辑的 URL 参数，不生成图片附件。除桌面端外，也检查触屏折叠和展开编辑器。
4. 粘贴声明 `Files` 却既不提供文件对象也不提供纯文本的载荷。应显示一次不可用文件警告。普通文字粘贴不应触发该警告。

### 修复前后证据

修复前：原始 main 上的合成 DOM 复现显示，URL 加 PNG 只留下 URL 文字而没有图片；空文件声明既不生成附件，也不显示提示。

修复后：合并最新 main 后的 PR 提交已通过 Chromium 浏览器测试，验证图片附件、可编辑 PPT 文字、完整命令 URL 参数和不可用文件警告。以下截图使用模拟 daemon 和合成剪贴板事件，只证明实际渲染的 UI 状态，不代表真实操作系统剪贴板格式、真实后端附件提交或命令执行验证。

- [URL 加一张图片生成图片附件，编辑器不插入 URL 文字](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/image-url-paste.png)。
- [声明了文件却取不到文件对象时，显示可见警告](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/unavailable-file-paste.png)。
- [命令草稿保留完整 URL 参数，不生成图片附件](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/6ae911a03f85645d0231e1ea4510039bb0946a3a/pr-evidence/issue-16088/command-url-paste.png)。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Vitest/jsdom、Chromium 浏览器 E2E、构建和类型检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

Node.js 22.14.0，本地源码和 bundle CLI，Chromium 配合模拟 daemon。合并后验证结果：全量构建和 bundle、仓库类型检查、340 项相关 Vitest 测试、3 项 Chromium E2E 测试（含一项临时证据采集流程）及改动文件的 lint/格式检查均通过。浏览器截图保存在独立素材分支的固定提交中，不进入实现分支。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：URL 规则属于启发式判断。在命令草稿之外，从办公软件复制的单个 HTTP(S) URL 如果附带一张位图，也会优先图片。带说明文字、非 HTTP(S) 文字、多张图片、附件禁用及 shell 模式继续优先文字。

prs.title: fix(core): attribute monitor and workflow notifications to the registering turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Monitor and workflow completion notifications now record the turn that registered the task. The ACP Session forwards that turn onto the queued notification, so a result that finishes while the original turn is still active can be included in the next model request instead of waiting for the end-of-turn drain or a separate automatic turn.

`MonitorRegistry.register()` and `WorkflowRunRegistry.register()` capture the turn once, using the same `getInvocationContext()?.promptId ?? promptIdContext.getStore()` rule as background agents and shells. A registration with no turn context remains unattributed. A model-started workflow resume is attributed to the turn that requested it; loading workflow history does not call `register()`, and a UI-driven resume without turn context remains unattributed.

## Why it's needed

#16125 fixed the shell path, but the monitor and workflow paths still emitted completion metadata without `sourceTurnId`. `Session.#takeCurrentTurnBackgroundParts` therefore skipped those notifications until the turn ended. This closes the remaining notification-class gap identified in #16125's review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused registry and Session tests:

```bash
cd packages/core
npx vitest run src/services/monitorRegistry.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
npx vitest run src/agents/workflow-run-registry.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false

cd ../cli
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'consumes same-turn monitor and workflow results' \
  --coverage.enabled=false
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'earlier-turn' \
  --coverage.enabled=false
```

The Session tests verify both directions: same-turn monitor and workflow results reach the second model request without `_qwencode/start_turn`, while earlier-turn results still use a separately admitted automatic execution.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current fix:

```text
MonitorRegistry:  61 passed
WorkflowRegistry: 160 passed
Session same-turn: 1 passed
Session earlier-turn: 3 passed
```

As a bounded negative control, removing only the two new Session forwarding lines makes the same-turn test fail at the intended boundary:

```text
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Vitest 3.2.7. The worktree reused existing dependency directories and base build artifacts; no install, build, typecheck, lint, or broad suite was run. A live Web Shell monitor/workflow session was not run locally. Cross-platform coverage remains with CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: attribution is captured at `register()`. A workflow resume started by the model belongs to the resuming turn; one started from UI state without turn context remains unattributed. This keeps earlier and restored work on the existing automatic-admission path.
- Not validated / out of scope: local Windows/Linux execution and a live long-running Web Shell session.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `sourceTurnId` is optional on the task and notification metadata; absent context preserves existing behavior.

## Linked Issues

Closes the monitor/workflow follow-up described in #16119. Follows #16125 and #16176.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Monitor 和 workflow 的完成通知现在会记录注册该任务的 turn。ACP Session 会把这个 turn 继续写入后台通知队列，因此任务在原始 turn 仍运行时结束后，结果可以进入下一次模型请求，而不是等到 turn 末才排空，或另起一个自动 turn。

`MonitorRegistry.register()` 和 `WorkflowRunRegistry.register()` 会在注册时一次性捕获 turn，规则与后台 agent、shell 一致：`getInvocationContext()?.promptId ?? promptIdContext.getStore()`。没有 turn 上下文时保持未归属。模型在当前 turn 发起的 workflow resume 会归属当前 turn；读取历史 workflow 不会调用 `register()`，而 UI 发起且没有 turn 上下文的 resume 仍保持未归属。

## 为什么需要

#16125 已修复 shell 路径，但 monitor 和 workflow 的完成 metadata 仍没有 `sourceTurnId`。因此 `Session.#takeCurrentTurnBackgroundParts` 会跳过这些通知，直到 turn 结束。本 PR 补上 #16125 review 中指出的同一类剩余缺口。

## 验证方式

按上面的四组命令运行聚焦用例。Session 层同时验证两个方向：当前 turn 的 monitor/workflow 结果进入第二次模型请求且不触发 `_qwencode/start_turn`；更早 turn 的结果仍通过单独准入的自动执行送达。

当前代码结果为：MonitorRegistry 61/61、WorkflowRegistry 160/160、Session 同 turn 1/1、Session earlier-turn 3/3。

有界负向对照中只删除本 PR 新增的两行 Session 透传，同 turn 用例会在预期边界失败：

```text
AssertionError: expected "spy" to be called 2 times, but got 1 times
```

## 风险与范围

- 主要权衡：归属在 `register()` 时捕获。模型发起的 workflow resume 归属 resume 所在 turn；UI 在无 turn 上下文时发起的 resume 仍不归属。更早或恢复后的任务继续走原有自动准入路径。
- 未验证 / 范围外：本地 Windows/Linux 执行，以及真实长时间运行的 Web Shell 场景。
- 破坏性变更：无。任务与通知 metadata 上的 `sourceTurnId` 都是可选字段，缺少上下文时保持原行为。

本 PR 收口 #16119 中 monitor/workflow 的后续缺口，并跟进 #16125、#16176。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds a Session-level regression test for same-turn background shell delivery. The test completes a shell notification while the registering turn's first model stream is active, then verifies that the result reaches the next model request without starting an automatic notification turn or leaving an active-work hold behind.

The production fix was merged in #16125. This test closes the remaining review gap by pinning the consumer-side wiring that makes that fix effective.

## Why it's needed

The existing registry tests verify that completed shells carry the registering turn in notification metadata. They do not exercise the Session callback that forwards that value or the current-turn consumer that decides when to deliver the result. Removing the one-line forwarding from Session restores the delayed-delivery bug while the registry tests remain green.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the focused Session test:

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts \
  -t 'consumes a same-turn shell result without an automatic rerun'
```

Expected: one test passes. The test observes two model calls, finds `SAME_TURN_SHELL_RESULT` in the second request, and confirms `_qwencode/start_turn` was not called.

### Evidence (Before & After)

With the current Session shell callback, the focused test passes:

```text
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests       1 passed | 1380 skipped (1381)
```

As a bounded negative control, removing `sourceTurnId: meta.sourceTurnId` from the Session shell enqueue makes the same test fail at the intended assertion:

```text

```

### Tested on

| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS, Vitest 3.2.7, one focused test with coverage disabled. Existing workspace dependencies were reused; no install or build was run.

## Risk & Scope

prs.title: test(managed-agent): reserve Hosted gate ports below the ephemeral range
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The Hosted integration tests now take every port they hand to a process before that process is up from one shared allocator, `HostedGateTestSupport.reservePort()`. It hands out numbers from 20000–27999, below the ephemeral ranges Linux (32768–60999 by default) and macOS (49152–65535) use, from one counter per test JVM, and probes each number so one that some process already listens on is skipped.

26 Hosted classes move onto it. They reserved a port by binding port 0, closing the socket and passing the number to Spring, the Harness, a Spring fixture child or the Runtime Broker, which bound it seconds later. The two classes that kept their probe sockets open across part of the boot (`HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT`, `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT`) keep doing so, on reserved numbers. `HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT` already used this scheme privately (#14522); its copy is removed so the fork has one counter.

On Linux the allocator reads `/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range` once. (An integer sysctl only answers a read at offset 0, and `Files.readString` starts a size-0 file with a one-byte read, so it would see `3`; the file is read with a full-size buffer.) On a host whose ephemeral range starts below 28000 the window would no longer help, so there it falls back to kernel-chosen numbers, never handing out the same one twice in a fork, and says so once on stderr.

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT`'s boot retry recognised a lost Harness port only by the move message `port N is in use, trying`. Since #15244 `--profile hosted-harness` exits with `port N is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port` instead, and Node's lowercase `address already in use` misses the class's case-sensitive check, so that retry could no longer fire for the Harness. It now matches the exit message, and the boot's teardown still deletes the attempt's rows when settling the tenant's work fails, so the retry does not trip over its own rows.

The retries from #15432 (`bootWithFreshPorts`) and #14153/#15224 stay for a listener outside the fork. No production code changes.

## Why it's needed

A port probed with port 0 is in the ephemeral range. Once the probe socket closes, the kernel can give the same number to anyone else binding port 0, or to the local end of an outgoing connection, before the intended process binds it. That process then fails with `Address already in use`; the Harness exits rather than moving, because Spring already names its exact port.

The 240 CI runs whose `hosted-harness-mysql-reports` artifact was still retained (10-26 to 11-02, `main` and pull requests) include 9 runs that each lost one cell this way, in four classes, none of them covered by #15432:

| run | branch | cell | what could not bind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [40319736811](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40319736811) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringKillBeforeWatermarkNeverFiresTwice` | Harness, port 46697 |
| [40628289562](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40628289562) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 39845 |
| [40827534316](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40827534316) | PR | `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT.fg11eRunListCursorHoldsAcrossAnInsertOnMySql` | Runtime Broker listener |
| [40835806118](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40835806118) | PR | `HostedHookCancelFaultGatesIT.fg13dCancelWithStoppedWorkerStaysUnknownAndKeepsTheHoldOnMySql` | Spring (Tomcat) |
| [40839441566](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40839441566) | PR | `HostedChannelProcessCrashIT.fg7cProcessCrashesNeverReplayChannelEffectsOnMySql` | Harness, port 38035 |
| [40844574764](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40844574764) | PR | `HostedAutomationFaultGatesIT.fg11bStoreFaultsNeverFireTwiceOnMySql` | Spring (Tomcat) |
| [40899091327](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40899091327) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 43151 |
| [41235909018](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41235909018) | `main` nightly | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2SpringFixtureBootsAndScansOnMySql` | Harness, port 41973 |
| [41315953818](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/41315953818) | PR | `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT.fg11c2TwoScannerRaceFiresOnce` | fixture Tomcat, ports 41401/39259 |

That is one Hosted run in 27 going red for a reason unrelated to the change under test. The `main` row is the 10-31 nightly; its other two failures were fixed by #16074. Below the ephemeral range the kernel never picks a number on its own, so only a bind by that exact number can take one, and within the fork only `reservePort` hands numbers out.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `HostedGateTestSupportTest` (default surefire lane) covers the allocator: distinct numbers inside the window, skipping a number someone listens on, wrapping from 27999 to 20000, the fallback skipping a repeated kernel number, parsing the range file (cross-checked against the real procfs file), and the window decision on both sides of 28000. 13 mutants of the allocator each turn the case aimed at them red.
- On a Linux box with Docker, MySQL 8.4.6 and a delegated cgroup v2 root, run the Hosted lane as the CI step does. To see the race itself, run `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` while another process keeps binding port 0 on loopback.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Rig: aarch64 Linux, JDK 21, Node 22, MySQL 8.4.6, `ip_local_port_range` 32768–60999, the CI step's `mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql ... clean verify checkstyle:check`. "Port stealer" is a process that keeps about 4000 loopback sockets bound to port 0, replacing them every 2 seconds, which is what any process in the job binding port 0 does at a higher rate.

| arm | tree | condition | result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B0 | `main` | no stealer, `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` | 5/5 pass |
| B1 | `main` | stealer, same class | 3 of 5 error: Harness `port 44733 is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port`, fixture Tomcat `Address already in use` ×2 |
| B2 | `main` | stealer, same class | 5 of 5 error, all bind conflicts (`BindException`, `Port 43401 was already in use`, …) |
| P1, P2, P3 | this branch (P3 is the final commit) | stealer, same class | 5/5 pass each, no bind conflict |
| TLB | `main` | Harness port held during boot attempt 0, `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT#leadRunsATeamThroughTwoNamedMembers` | error: `Hosted Harness exited: … port 46527 is in use; …`, no retry |
| TLP | this branch | same | pass: `boot attempt 0 lost its ports, retrying: … HarnessPortConflict: Hosted Harness lost the port race on 20560`, attempt 1 on 20563 |
| full | this branch | no stealer, whole Hosted lane | 167 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, 4 skipped, `BUILD SUCCESS`; 35 report classes as in CI; no fallback note; 222 of the Tomcat ports bound were in the window, and the other 62 came from listeners that bind port 0 themselves |

The TLB/TLP hold was a test-only probe applied on the rig, not part of this PR.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux: unit tests, the mutants and checkstyle on x86_64 (JDK 25); the Hosted lane and the A/B arms on aarch64 (JDK 21). macOS was not run; its default ephemeral range starts at 49152, above the window. The Hosted ITs refuse to run on Windows.

### Environment (optional)

`-Phosted-harness-mysql clean verify checkstyle:check` with the CI step's arguments, a fresh `hosted_harness_test` database and a delegated cgroup root.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the guarantee needs the window below the host's ephemeral range. GitHub's Ubuntu runners and every test machine checked use 32768–60999; a Linux host tuned lower falls back to today's behavior with a one-time note. A process outside the fork that binds a window number by name can still collide; the probe skips one that is already listening, and the existing retries remain for that case.
- Not validated / out of scope: `EventTransportMultiNodeGate` (its own job; #14860 covered its RocketMQ ports), `Issue13180*`, `preflight/*` and `SshRuntimeInteropTest` (surefire tests, none seen failing this way), the TypeScript drivers (they listen on port 0 and keep the socket open), and production `SshConnectionManager`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; test code only.

## Linked Issues

Related to #15432, #14522, #14153 and #15224, the earlier per-class fixes for the same race. The `main` failure was filed on #15744 along with two fg10 cells, which #16074 fixed; the fg11c2 cell in that report is this race.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Hosted 集成测试在子进程起来之前要把端口号交给它。现在这些端口统一从一个共享分配器 `HostedGateTestSupport.reservePort()` 取。它只发 20000–27999 的号，低于 Linux（默认 32768–60999）和 macOS（49152–65535）的临时端口范围；每个测试 JVM 共用一个计数器，并且逐个探测，已经有进程监听的号会跳过。

26 个 Hosted 类改用它。这些类原来的做法是先 bind 0、关掉 socket，再把号码交给 Spring、Harness、Spring fixture 子进程或 Runtime Broker，几秒后由对方去 bind。`HostedMonitorRunFaultGatesIT` 早就私下用了同样的做法（#14522）；它的私有副本已删除，整个 fork 只保留一个计数器。

在 Linux 上，分配器会读一次 `/proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range`。整数型 sysctl 只响应偏移 0 处的读，而 `Files.readString` 对大小为 0 的文件会先读 1 个字节，读到的只有 `3`，所以这里改用足够大的缓冲区一次读完。如果宿主的临时端口范围从 28000 以下开始，这个窗口就不再起作用，这时退回由内核选端口，同一个 fork 内不会重复发号，并在 stderr 上提示一次。

`HostedSessionRelayFaultGatesIT` 和 `HostedPublicWorkspaceIT` 原来会在启动的一部分过程中一直持有探测 socket，现在照样持有，只是绑定的是预留的号码。

`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` 的启动重试原来只靠换端口提示 `port N is in use, trying` 来识别 Harness 端口被占。自 #15244 起，`--profile hosted-harness` 改为打印 `port N is in use; --profile hosted-harness does not move to another port` 后直接退出；Node 报的又是小写的 `address already in use`，匹配不上这个类区分大小写的检查。所以对 Harness 来说，这个重试已经不可能触发。现在改为匹配退出提示。另外，即使结算租户工作失败，启动清理也会照常删除本次尝试插入的行，重试不会撞上自己留下的数据。

#15432 的 `bootWithFreshPorts` 和 #14153/#15224 的重试都保留，用来应对 fork 外的监听者。生产代码没有改动。

## 为什么需要

用 port 0 探测到的端口在临时端口范围内。探测 socket 一关，内核就可能在目标进程 bind 之前，把同一个号交给别的 bind 0 的进程，或者分给某条出站连接作本端端口。目标进程随后就会报 `Address already in use`。Harness 不会换端口，因为 Spring 已经记下了它的确切端口，所以它直接退出。

`hosted-harness-mysql-reports` 产物还保留着的 CI 运行共有 240 次（10-26 至 11-02，包括 `main` 和各个 PR）。其中 9 次运行各有一个用例因此失败，分布在 4 个类，都不在 #15432 的覆盖范围内（明细见英文部分的表格）。也就是说，大约每 27 次 Hosted 运行就有 1 次因为与改动无关的原因变红。表中 `main` 那一行是 10-31 的夜跑，它的另外两个失败已由 #16074 修复。在临时端口范围以下，内核从不自行选号，只有按这个确切号码 bind 才会占用它；而在 fork 内部，只有 `reservePort` 会发号。

## 评审验证方式

### 如何验证

- `HostedGateTestSupportTest`（默认 surefire lane）覆盖分配器：
  - 发出的号互不相同且都在窗口内；
  - 跳过有人监听的号；
  - 从 27999 回绕到 20000；
  - 回退路径跳过内核重复给出的号；
  - 解析范围文件，并与真实的 procfs 文件交叉校验；
  - 28000 两侧的窗口判断。
- 针对分配器的 13 个变异，每个都会让它针对的用例变红。
- 在装有 Docker、MySQL 8.4.6 和委派 cgroup v2 根的 Linux 机器上，按 CI 步骤的方式跑 Hosted lane。想直接看到这个竞争，可以在另一个进程不断往 loopback bind 0 的同时运行 `HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT`。

### 证据（前后对比）

rig：aarch64 Linux，JDK 21，Node 22，MySQL 8.4.6，`ip_local_port_range` 为 32768–60999，按 CI 步骤运行 `mvn -Phosted-harness-mysql ... clean verify checkstyle:check`。“端口窃取进程”会始终在 loopback 上保持约 4000 个 bind 0 的 socket，每 2 秒轮换一次，相当于以更高频率模拟 job 里任何 bind 0 的进程。

| 组 | 代码 | 条件 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| B0 | `main` | 不开窃取，`HostedAutomationSpringCrashIT` | 5/5 通过 |
| B1 | `main` | 开窃取，同一个类 | 5 个用例中 3 个报错：Harness 报 `port 44733 is in use; …`，fixture 的 Tomcat 两次报 `Address already in use` |
| B2 | `main` | 开窃取，同一个类 | 5 个全部报错，都是端口冲突 |
| P1、P2、P3 | 本分支（P3 为最终提交） | 开窃取，同一个类 | 每组 5/5 通过，没有端口冲突 |
| TLB | `main` | 第 0 次启动期间占住 Harness 端口，`HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT#leadRunsATeamThroughTwoNamedMembers` | 报错：Harness 因 `port 46527 is in use` 退出，没有重试 |
| TLP | 本分支 | 同上 | 通过：第 0 次在 20560 上识别为 `HarnessPortConflict`，第 1 次换到 20563 |
| 全量 | 本分支 | 不开窃取，整条 Hosted lane | 167 项，0 失败，0 错误，4 跳过，`BUILD SUCCESS`；报告覆盖 35 个类，与 CI 一致；没有回退提示；Tomcat 绑定的端口中 222 个落在窗口内，其余 62 个来自自己 bind 0 的监听 |

TLB/TLP 中占住端口的做法只是在 rig 上临时打的测试探针，不属于本 PR。

### 测试平台

Linux：单测、变异和 checkstyle 在 x86_64（JDK 25）上通过；Hosted lane 和 A/B 对比在 aarch64（JDK 21）上跑。macOS 没有跑，它的默认临时端口范围从 49152 开始，高于窗口。Hosted IT 本身拒绝在 Windows 上运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：这个保证要求窗口位于宿主临时端口范围以下。GitHub 的 Ubuntu runner 和查过的每台测试机都是 32768–60999；如果某台 Linux 机器把范围调低了，会退回今天的行为，并提示一次。fork 外的进程按号 bind 到窗口内的号码，仍可能撞上；对已经在监听的号，探测会跳过，其余情况由原有的重试兜底。
- 未验证或不在范围内：
  - `EventTransportMultiNodeGate`：它有自己的 job，#14860 已经处理了它的 RocketMQ 端口；
  - `Issue13180*`、`preflight/*`、`SshRuntimeInteropTest`：都是 surefire 测试，没见过因此失败；
  - TypeScript 驱动：它们 listen 0 后一直保持监听，没有这个问题；
  - 生产代码 `SshConnectionManager`。
- 破坏性变更：无，只改测试代码。

## 关联 Issue

与 #15432、#14522、#14153、#15224 相关，它们都是针对同一竞争的按类修复。`main` 上那次失败记录在 #15744，同一份报告里还有两个 fg10 用例，已由 #16074 修复；其中的 fg11c2 用例就是这个竞争。

</details>

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): compact live tool-result displays for session replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Compacts tool-result displays on the live ACP emission path, at the single point where a result display becomes wire content and raw output, reusing the same recording-purpose compaction the transcript recorder already applies. Large-file edit results now degrade to the saved-session preview instead of carrying the entire old and new file contents, while small diffs stay byte-for-byte intact. Because transcript records can carry leaner displays than the live producer emits (a blocked spawn has no task prompt, older versions recorded fewer fields), the shared compaction utility is also hardened to pass non-string fields and malformed list entries through untouched instead of throwing; well-formed displays compact exactly as before.

## Why it's needed

Opening a Web Shell session whose in-flight turn edited large files could take tens of seconds while other sessions opened instantly. The session-open response embeds the daemon's replay journal, and every edit result event carried the whole old and new file contents twice — once as the diff content, once as raw output. On the incident session this produced a 39.6 MB open response although the on-disk transcript was only 4.3 MB: the recording path truncates file-diff displays before persisting them, but the live path emitted them raw, so the journal breached its default caps, adaptive journal growth kept doubling them, and each open re-downloaded, parsed, and replayed the entire snapshot. Warm replay also disagreed with cold replay, which rebuilds from the sanitized transcript and already shows truncated previews. This change bounds the per-event replay payload independent of edited file size and makes warm and cold replay consistent. Fixes #16171.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the new and existing suites: the acp-bridge transcript-replay suite (165 tests, 5 new covering bounded large edits, small-diff identity, cold-replay equivalence, oversized-diff raw-output drop, and non-diff bounding), the core compaction suite (58 tests, 8 new partial-display cases across both purposes), the full acp-bridge suite (2,866), the core recording-service suite (187), and the cli tool-call-emitter suite (72). All pass on this head.
2. Replay-journal A/B against the built output: feed 9 edits of an ~870 KB file plus 1,350 streaming chunks through the real turn-boundary compaction engine with daemon-style adaptive growth, once with the exact pre-fix wire shape measured on the incident and once with the fixed builder. The pre-fix arm grows the journal caps from 8 MiB to 32 MiB and retains a 31,746,415-byte journal; the fixed arm never breaches the default caps and retains 65,560 bytes — a ~484x smaller replay snapshot.
3. Optional manual check on a daemon built from this branch: have the agent (or a background subagent) repeatedly edit a file larger than ~100 KB, reload the Web Shell session page while the turn runs, and confirm the session-open response stays bounded and the edit cards render the same preview a post-restart replay shows.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no UI layout change. Wire-level measurements on the incident session (qwen 0.26.5): session-open response 39,592,547 bytes with a 37,790,970-byte live journal, of which 27,519,121 bytes came from just 9 edit events; the read-only transcript page API answered 260,941 bytes in 0.19 s. After the fix, the same scenario through the real journal machinery yields a 65,562-byte replay snapshot. A real-daemon A/B (branch dist vs released 0.26.5, isolated daemons, real model turns editing an ~870 KB file) measured during-turn session-open peaks of 61,955,300 → 185,373 bytes, browser-level /load of 72,830,493 bytes / 1,474 ms → 217,480 bytes / 99 ms, and first tool-card render of 2,931 → 821 ms; after a daemon restart the warm and cold edit-result events are identical in content, rawOutput, and status. The exported-document renderer is byte-identical with and without the change (1,978,365 bytes; the replay module is unreachable from the document entry), and the browser bundle's Node-free constraint is preserved.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux (Node v24): unit suites, a built-output journal probe, and a real-daemon A/B (branch dist vs released 0.26.5, isolated daemons with real model turns editing an ~870 KB file) including headless-browser session-open measurement and a restart-based cold-replay comparison.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: live viewers of a large-file edit now see the truncated preview instead of the full diff. This is the same display cold replay and the TUI history already show; the full change remains available from the file itself and file history. Small diffs (the common case) are unaffected.
- Not validated / out of scope: permission-request payloads keep their full diff (the approval UI needs the complete change); tool-call start arguments are unchanged; sessions journaled by older daemons keep their oversized events until the turn boundary folds them into the capped compacted replay.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The compaction call is idempotent for the already-sanitized displays cold replay passes in, and the utility hardening only adds pass-through for inputs that previously threw.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/compact-live-tool-result-replay/docs/design/compact-live-tool-result-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/compact-live-tool-result-replay/docs/design/compact-live-tool-result-replay.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16171

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 ACP 实时发射路径上、结果显示变成 wire content 与 raw output 的唯一咽喉点压缩工具结果显示，复用转录录制器已经在用的 recording 用途压缩。大文件编辑结果现在降级为保存会话预览，而不再携带完整的新旧文件内容；小 diff 保持逐字节不变。由于 transcript 记录可能携带比实时生产者更精简的显示（blocked spawn 没有 task prompt，旧版本录制的字段更少），共享压缩工具同时被加固：非字符串字段与畸形列表元素原样通过而不是抛异常；良构显示的压缩行为与之前完全一致。

## 为什么需要

打开一个进行中 turn 编辑过大文件的 Web Shell 会话可能要几十秒，而其他会话秒开。会话打开响应内嵌 daemon 的回放 journal，每个编辑结果事件都携带完整新旧文件内容各一份——diff content 一份，raw output 又一份。事故会话上这产生了 39.6 MB 的打开响应，尽管磁盘 transcript 只有 4.3 MB：录制路径落盘前会截断文件 diff 显示，实时路径却原样发出，于是 journal 突破默认上限、自适应增长不断翻倍，每次打开都要重新下载、解析并重放整个快照。热回放还与冷回放不一致——后者从已净化的 transcript 重建，本来就显示截断预览。本改动让单事件回放 payload 与所编辑文件大小无关地有界，并让热回放与冷回放一致。Fixes #16171。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 运行新增与现有套件：acp-bridge transcript-replay 套件（165 个测试，5 个新增，覆盖大编辑有界、小 diff 不变、与冷回放等价、超大 diff 丢弃 raw output、非 diff 有界）、core 压缩套件（58 个测试，8 个新增的不完整显示用例 × 两种用途）、acp-bridge 全套（2,866）、core 录制服务套件（187）、cli tool-call-emitter 套件（72）。全部在本 head 通过。
2. 针对构建产物的回放 journal A/B：把 9 次约 870 KB 文件的编辑加 1,350 条流式 chunk 喂给真实的 turn 边界压缩引擎（带 daemon 式自适应增长），一臂用事故上实测的修复前 wire 形状，一臂用修复后的构建器。修复前臂把 journal 上限从 8 MiB 撑到 32 MiB、保留 31,746,415 字节的 journal；修复臂从不突破默认上限、只保留 65,560 字节——回放快照缩小约 484 倍。
3. 可选的人工验证（用本分支构建的 daemon）：让 agent（或后台子代理）反复编辑一个大于约 100 KB 的文件，在 turn 运行时刷新 Web Shell 会话页，确认会话打开响应保持有界，且编辑卡片渲染的预览与重启后回放一致。

### 证据（修复前后）

N/A —— 无 UI 布局变化。事故会话（qwen 0.26.5）的 wire 级实测：会话打开响应 39,592,547 字节，live journal 37,790,970 字节，其中 27,519,121 字节仅来自 9 个编辑事件；只读 transcript 分页接口 0.19 s 返回 260,941 字节。修复后，同一场景经过真实 journal 机器得到 65,562 字节的回放快照。真实 daemon A/B（分支 dist 对已发布 0.26.5，隔离 daemon，真实模型 turn 编辑约 870 KB 文件）实测：turn 运行中会话打开峰值 61,955,300 → 185,373 字节，浏览器级 /load 72,830,493 字节 / 1,474 ms → 217,480 字节 / 99 ms，首个工具卡片渲染 2,931 → 821 ms；重启 daemon 后热回放与冷回放的编辑结果事件在 content、rawOutput、status 上完全一致。导出文档 renderer 在改动前后逐字节一致（1,978,365 字节；回放模块从文档入口不可达），浏览器 bundle 的 Node-free 约束保持不变。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux（Node v24）：单测套件、构建产物 journal 探针，以及真实 daemon A/B（分支 dist 对已发布 0.26.5，隔离 daemon + 真实模型 turn 编辑约 870 KB 文件），含无头浏览器的会话打开计时与重启后的冷回放对比。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：大文件编辑的实时观看者现在看到截断预览而非完整 diff。这与冷回放和 TUI 历史已经显示的完全一致；完整变更仍可从文件本身与 file history 获得。小 diff（常见情形）不受影响。
- 未验证/超出范围：permission_request 的 payload 保留完整 diff（审批界面需要完整变更）；工具调用开始参数不变；旧 daemon 已记入 journal 的超大事件会保留到 turn 边界把它们折进有上限的 compacted replay。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。压缩调用对冷回放传入的已净化显示是幂等的；工具加固只是为此前会抛异常的输入增加原样通过。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/compact-live-tool-result-replay/docs/design/compact-live-tool-result-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/compact-live-tool-result-replay/docs/design/compact-live-tool-result-replay.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #16171

</details>
